examples.en: The train will arrive shortly, so please wait behind the yellow line.
examples.zh: 火車即將進站，請在黃線後方等候。

examples.en: Shortly after lunch, it began to rain heavily.
examples.zh: 午餐後不久，天空就下起大雨。

examples.en: She answered the question shortly and sat down.
examples.zh: 她不耐煩地回答了問題，然後就坐下了。

examples.en: Dad used a shovel to dig a hole for the new tree.
examples.zh: 爸爸用鏟子替新樹挖了一個洞。

examples.en: Please put the shovel back in the garage when you finish.
examples.zh: 用完後請把鏟子放回車庫。

examples.en: The children brought a small plastic shovel to the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們帶了一支小塑膠鏟子去海邊。

examples.en: We had to shovel the snow off the driveway.
examples.zh: 我們得把車道上的雪鏟掉。

examples.en: Workers shovel gravel into the truck every morning.
examples.zh: 工人每天早上把碎石鏟進卡車裡。

examples.en: She shoveled the dirt into a big bucket.
examples.zh: 她把泥土鏟進一個大水桶裡。

examples.en: My new sweater will shrink if you wash it in hot water.
examples.zh: 如果用熱水洗，我的新毛衣會縮水。

examples.en: The company's profits began to shrink last year.
examples.zh: 那家公司的利潤去年開始減少。

examples.en: The puddle started to shrink under the hot sun.
examples.zh: 水坑在大太陽下開始縮小。

examples.en: She sighed when she saw the long line at the bank.
examples.zh: 她看到銀行裡的長長人龍時嘆了口氣。

examples.en: Dad sighed and put down his newspaper.
examples.zh: 爸爸嘆了口氣，放下了報紙。

examples.en: The students sighed with relief when the exam ended.
examples.zh: 考試結束時，學生們鬆了一口氣。

examples.en: He let out a long sigh and closed his book.
examples.zh: 他長長嘆了一口氣，闔上了書。

examples.en: There was a sigh of relief from the whole team.
examples.zh: 整個團隊都發出如釋重負的嘆息。

examples.en: Mom gave a quiet sigh after a busy day.
examples.zh: 媽媽忙碌了一天後輕輕嘆了口氣。

examples.en: The traffic signal turned green, so we crossed the street.
examples.zh: 交通號誌轉為綠燈，所以我們過了馬路。

examples.en: I can't get a signal on my phone in the basement.
examples.zh: 我的手機在地下室收不到訊號。

examples.en: A nod from the teacher was the signal to start.
examples.zh: 老師點個頭就是開始的暗示。

examples.en: Drivers should signal before they turn so others can react safely.
examples.zh: 駕駛人轉彎前應打方向燈示意，讓其他用路人能安全應對。

examples.en: She signaled the waiter to bring the bill.
examples.zh: 她向服務生示意把帳單拿來。

examples.en: The bell signals the end of each class.
examples.zh: 鐘聲表示每堂課的結束。

senses.zh: 重大的；顯著的；有意義的

examples.en: There has been a significant increase in the price of eggs.
examples.zh: 雞蛋的價格有顯著的上漲。

examples.en: Graduating from college was a significant moment in her life.
examples.zh: 大學畢業是她人生中意義重大的時刻。

examples.en: The test showed no significant difference between the two groups.
examples.zh: 測驗結果顯示兩組之間沒有顯著差異。

examples.en: The scarf is made of pure silk.
examples.zh: 這條圍巾是純絲製成的。

examples.en: Silk is soft and smooth, but it is also expensive.
examples.zh: 絲綢柔軟光滑，但價格也很貴。

examples.en: She bought a silk dress for her sister's wedding.
examples.zh: 她為姊姊的婚禮買了一件絲綢洋裝。

examples.en: There is a strong similarity between the twins' voices.
examples.zh: 這對雙胞胎的聲音非常相似。

examples.en: The two languages share many similarities in grammar.
examples.zh: 這兩種語言在文法上有許多相似之處。

examples.en: Despite some similarity in price, the two phones are very different.
examples.zh: 儘管價格有些相近，這兩支手機仍然很不一樣。

examples.en: Many religions teach that cheating is a sin.
examples.zh: 許多宗教教導人欺騙是一種罪。

examples.en: The old man asked God to forgive his sins.
examples.zh: 那位老先生祈求上帝原諒他的罪。

examples.en: My grandmother thinks wasting food is a sin.
examples.zh: 我奶奶認為浪費食物是一種罪過。

examples.en: She sipped her hot tea slowly while reading.
examples.zh: 她邊看書邊慢慢啜飲熱茶。

examples.en: Please sip the soup carefully because it is hot.
examples.zh: 湯很燙，請小心地小口喝。

examples.en: He sat by the window and sipped his coffee.
examples.zh: 他坐在窗邊啜飲著咖啡。

examples.en: Can I have a sip of your juice?
examples.zh: 我可以喝一小口你的果汁嗎？

examples.en: He took a sip of water before the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演講前喝了一小口水。

examples.en: One sip of the soup told me it needed more salt.
examples.zh: 喝了一小口湯，我就知道它需要加點鹽。

examples.en: What would you do in this situation?
examples.zh: 在這種情況下你會怎麼做？

examples.en: The manager explained the financial situation of the company.
examples.zh: 經理說明了公司的財務狀況。

examples.en: The traffic situation near the stadium is terrible tonight.
examples.zh: 今晚體育場附近的交通狀況很糟。

examples.en: Don't skip breakfast; it gives you energy for the morning.
examples.zh: 不要跳過早餐，它能給你一早的精力。

examples.en: Some students skip class when they are tired.
examples.zh: 有些學生累的時候會蹺課。

examples.en: The little girl skipped happily down the street.
examples.zh: 小女孩開心地沿著街道蹦蹦跳跳。

examples.en: In history class, we learned about the lives of slaves.
examples.zh: 在歷史課上，我們學到了奴隸的生活。

examples.en: The writer was born a slave but later became a teacher.
examples.zh: 那位作家生來是奴隸，後來成為老師。

examples.en: Don't become a slave to your phone.
examples.zh: 不要變成手機的奴隸。

examples.en: She rolled up her sleeves and started washing the dishes.
examples.zh: 她捲起袖子開始洗碗。

examples.en: This shirt has a small hole in the sleeve.
examples.zh: 這件襯衫的袖子上有一個小洞。

examples.en: I prefer shirts with short sleeves in the summer.
examples.zh: 夏天我比較喜歡穿短袖的襯衫。

examples.en: Be careful; the floor is slippery after the rain.
examples.zh: 小心，雨後的地板很滑。

examples.en: The fish was so slippery that I almost dropped it.
examples.zh: 那條魚太滑了，我差點讓牠從手中滑落。

examples.en: Wear shoes with good grip on slippery roads.
examples.zh: 在濕滑的路面上要穿抓地力好的鞋子。

examples.en: The children slid down the grassy slope.
examples.zh: 孩子們從長滿草的斜坡上滑下來。

examples.en: Our house is built on a gentle slope.
examples.zh: 我們的房子蓋在一個平緩的斜坡上。

examples.en: Many people go skiing on the snowy slopes in winter.
examples.zh: 許多人冬天會到積雪的雪坡上滑雪。

examples.en: The road slopes down toward the river.
examples.zh: 這條路向下傾斜通往河邊。

examples.en: The floor of the old classroom slopes slightly toward the door.
examples.zh: 那間舊教室的地板朝門口微微傾斜。

examples.en: The roof slopes steeply so that the snow can slide off.
examples.zh: 屋頂斜度很大，雪才能滑落。

senses.zh: 折斷；快速拍照；厲聲斥責

examples.en: The branch snapped under the weight of the snow.
examples.zh: 樹枝被積雪的重量壓斷了。

examples.en: He snapped a photo of the sunset with his phone.
examples.zh: 他用手機快速拍下了夕陽的照片。

examples.en: Sorry I snapped at you; I was tired.
examples.zh: 抱歉我剛才對你大小聲，我累了。

examples.en: I heard a sharp snap from the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我聽到廚房傳來清脆的啪的一聲。

examples.en: With a snap of his fingers, the magician made the coin disappear.
examples.zh: 魔術師彈了一下手指，硬幣就消失了。

examples.en: The snap of the lid told me the box was closed.
examples.zh: 蓋子啪的一聲，讓我知道盒子已經蓋好了。

senses.zh: 固態的；堅固的；實心的；紮實的

examples.en: Water becomes solid when it freezes in the freezer.
examples.zh: 水在冷凍庫裡結冰時，會變成固態。

examples.en: The table is made of solid wood.
examples.zh: 這張桌子是用實木做的。

examples.en: She has a solid understanding of math.
examples.zh: 她對數學有紮實的理解。

examples.en: Ice is a solid, but steam is a gas.
examples.zh: 冰是固體，而水蒸氣是氣體。

examples.en: Babies start eating solids at around six months.
examples.zh: 嬰兒大約在六個月大時開始吃固體食物。

examples.en: Scientists study how solids change into liquids.
examples.zh: 科學家研究固體如何變成液體。

examples.en: Somehow, my keys ended up in the refrigerator.
examples.zh: 不知怎的，我的鑰匙跑進了冰箱裡。

examples.en: We will get to the airport somehow, even if the bus is late.
examples.zh: 就算公車誤點，我們也會設法趕到機場。

examples.en: She somehow managed to finish the report in one hour.
examples.zh: 她不知怎麼地在一小時內完成了報告。

examples.en: Let's have lunch together sometime next week.
examples.zh: 我們下週找個時間一起吃午餐吧。

examples.en: I will call you sometime this evening.
examples.zh: 我今晚會找個時間打電話給你。

examples.en: He plans to visit Japan sometime in the spring.
examples.zh: 他打算在春天的某個時候去日本。

examples.en: She felt deep sorrow when her old teacher passed away.
examples.zh: 她的老師過世時，她感到深深的悲痛。

examples.en: The whole town shared the family's sorrow.
examples.zh: 全鎮的人都分擔了這個家庭的悲傷。

examples.en: Joy and sorrow are both parts of life.
examples.zh: 喜悅與悲傷都是人生的一部分。

examples.en: Please give me a specific example to support your opinion.
examples.zh: 請舉一個具體的例子來支持你的看法。

examples.en: Do you have a specific time in mind for the meeting?
examples.zh: 你心中有開會的特定時間嗎？

examples.en: The teacher gave us specific instructions for the project.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們這個專案明確的指示。

examples.en: Curry is made with many different spices.
examples.zh: 咖哩是用許多不同的香料做成的。

examples.en: Add a little spice to the soup if you like it hot.
examples.zh: 如果你喜歡辣，就在湯裡加一點辣味香料。

examples.en: A new hobby can add spice to your free time.
examples.zh: 新的嗜好可以為你的休閒時間增添樂趣。

examples.en: Be careful not to spill your milk on the table.
examples.zh: 小心不要把牛奶灑在桌上。

examples.en: The coffee spilled all over my homework.
examples.zh: 我的作業上灑滿了咖啡。

examples.en: Water spilled out of the bucket as I carried it.
examples.zh: 我提水桶的時候，水從桶子裡溢了出來。

examples.en: Please clean up the spill in the hallway.
examples.zh: 請把走廊上灑出來的東西清乾淨。

examples.en: A small spill of oil made the floor slippery.
examples.zh: 一小攤灑出來的油讓地板變得很滑。

examples.en: There was a spill in the cafeteria at lunch.
examples.zh: 午餐時間，餐廳裡有東西灑了出來。

examples.en: The wheel began to spin faster and faster.
examples.zh: 輪子開始越轉越快。

examples.en: The children spin around until they feel dizzy.
examples.zh: 孩子們一直轉圈圈，直到覺得頭暈。

examples.en: Long ago, women used to spin wool into thread.
examples.zh: 很久以前，女性常把羊毛紡成線。

examples.en: The dancer finished her performance with a quick spin.
examples.zh: 舞者以一個快速的旋轉結束了表演。

examples.en: Let's go for a spin in my new car.
examples.zh: 我們開我的新車去兜個風吧。

examples.en: The washing machine is on its final spin.
examples.zh: 洗衣機正在進行最後的旋轉脫水。

examples.en: Spinach is rich in iron and vitamins.
examples.zh: 菠菜富含鐵質和維生素。

examples.en: I added some spinach to the omelet this morning.
examples.zh: 我今天早上在蛋捲裡加了一些菠菜。

examples.en: My mother cooked spinach with garlic for dinner.
examples.zh: 我媽媽晚餐用大蒜炒了菠菜。

examples.en: Please do not spit in public places.
examples.zh: 請不要在公共場所吐口水。

examples.en: The baby spat out the carrots again.
examples.zh: 寶寶又把紅蘿蔔吐了出來。

examples.en: The hot oil began to spit when I dropped the fish in the pan.
examples.zh: 我把魚放進鍋裡時，熱油開始噴濺。

examples.en: He broke her toy out of spite.
examples.zh: 他出於惡意弄壞了她的玩具。

examples.en: Jealousy and spite ruined their friendship after years of trust.
examples.zh: 嫉妒與怨恨毀了他們多年互信的友誼。

examples.en: There was no spite in her criticism of my report.
examples.zh: 她對我報告的批評並無惡意。

examples.en: The children splashed in the pool all afternoon.
examples.zh: 孩子們整個下午都在游泳池裡玩水。

examples.en: A passing bus splashed muddy water on my shoes.
examples.zh: 一輛經過的公車把泥水濺到我的鞋子上。

examples.en: Don't splash paint on the floor while painting the walls.
examples.zh: 粉刷牆壁時，不要把油漆濺到地板上。

examples.en: We heard a big splash when the dog jumped into the lake.
examples.zh: 狗跳進湖裡時，我們聽到一聲巨大的濺水聲。

examples.en: The ball landed in the water with a splash.
examples.zh: 球濺起水花落進水裡。

examples.en: A splash of lemon juice makes the tea taste better.
examples.zh: 加一點檸檬汁會讓茶更好喝。

examples.en: The rain spoiled our picnic plans, so we ate indoors.
examples.zh: 這場雨破壞了我們的野餐計畫，所以我們改在室內用餐。

examples.en: Grandparents often spoil their grandchildren with candy.
examples.zh: 祖父母常用糖果寵壞孫子孫女。

examples.en: Milk will spoil quickly if you leave it outside the fridge.
examples.zh: 牛奶放在冰箱外很快就會變質。

examples.en: Please spray the plants with water every morning.
examples.zh: 請每天早上對植物噴水。

examples.en: He sprayed some perfume on his wrist.
examples.zh: 他在手腕上噴了一些香水。

examples.en: Mom sprayed the window with cleaner and wiped it.
examples.zh: 媽媽在窗戶上噴了清潔劑然後擦拭乾淨。

examples.en: Pack some insect spray for the camping trip.
examples.zh: 露營時要帶一些防蟲噴霧。

examples.en: The waterfall's spray wet our jackets as we crossed the bridge.
examples.zh: 我們過橋時，瀑布的水花打溼了外套。

examples.en: She bought a cleaning spray for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 她買了一瓶廚房用的清潔噴霧。

examples.en: The movie is about a spy who travels around the world.
examples.zh: 這部電影是關於一名環遊世界的間諜。

examples.en: In the story, the spy hides a message in a book.
examples.zh: 故事裡，間諜把訊息藏在一本書裡。

examples.en: Children like to play spy with toy binoculars.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡拿著玩具望遠鏡玩間諜遊戲。

examples.en: The company hired a man to spy on its rivals.
examples.zh: 那家公司僱了一個人去刺探對手的情報。

examples.en: I spied my brother hiding behind the door.
examples.zh: 我發現我弟弟躲在門後。

examples.en: Birdwatchers spy rare birds with their binoculars.
examples.zh: 賞鳥的人用望遠鏡發現了稀有的鳥。

examples.en: Squeeze a lemon into the tea to add a fresh flavor.
examples.zh: 把一顆檸檬的汁擠進茶裡，增添清新風味。

examples.en: Too many people tried to squeeze onto the small bus.
examples.zh: 太多人想擠上那輛小公車。

examples.en: She squeezed my hand to show she cared.
examples.zh: 她緊握我的手表示她很關心我。

examples.en: It was a tight squeeze with six people in the small elevator.
examples.zh: 六個人擠在小電梯裡，真的很擁擠。

examples.en: Give the sponge a firm squeeze to remove the water.
examples.zh: 用力擠壓海綿把水擠出來。

examples.en: A squeeze of lime makes the fish taste fresher.
examples.zh: 擠一點萊姆汁會讓魚吃起來更清爽。

examples.en: A squirrel ran up the tree with a nut in its mouth.
examples.zh: 一隻松鼠嘴裡叼著堅果跑上樹。

examples.en: Squirrels store food in hidden places to prepare for the winter.
examples.zh: 松鼠把食物藏在隱密的地方，準備過冬。

examples.en: We saw a squirrel jumping from branch to branch.
examples.zh: 我們看到一隻松鼠在樹枝間跳來跳去。

examples.en: The ladder is not stable, so please hold it.
examples.zh: 這個梯子不穩，請扶著它。

examples.en: He wants a stable job with a regular income.
examples.zh: 他想要一份收入固定的穩定工作。

examples.en: The patient's condition is stable now after receiving emergency treatment.
examples.zh: 病人接受緊急治療後，現在狀況已經穩定。

examples.en: The horses are kept in the stable at night.
examples.zh: 馬匹晚上都養在馬廄裡。

examples.en: She cleans the stable before breakfast and feeds the horses.
examples.zh: 她早餐前會打掃馬廄，並餵馬。

examples.en: The farmer built a new stable next to the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫在穀倉旁蓋了一間新馬廄。

examples.en: Thousands of fans filled the stadium for the final game.
examples.zh: 數千名球迷擠滿了體育場觀賞決賽。

examples.en: The new stadium can hold fifty thousand people.
examples.zh: 這座新體育場可以容納五萬人。

examples.en: We took the MRT to the stadium for the concert.
examples.zh: 我們搭捷運去體育場看演唱會。

examples.en: The hotel staff were friendly and helpful.
examples.zh: 飯店的工作人員親切又樂於幫忙。

examples.en: Our school has a staff of fifty teachers.
examples.zh: 我們學校有五十位教師。

examples.en: Please ask a staff member at the front desk.
examples.zh: 請向櫃檯的工作人員詢問。

examples.en: The clinic is staffed by three nurses.
examples.zh: 這間診所配有三位護理師。

examples.en: We need to staff the booth on Saturday.
examples.zh: 我們週六需要有人顧攤位。

examples.en: Many convenience stores are staffed all night.
examples.zh: 許多便利商店整晚都有人值班。

examples.en: Don't stare at people; it is rude.
examples.zh: 不要盯著別人看，這樣很沒禮貌。

examples.en: The little boy stared at the huge cake.
examples.zh: 小男孩盯著那個超大蛋糕看。

examples.en: She stared out the window during the lesson.
examples.zh: 上課時她呆呆地望著窗外。

examples.en: He gave me a long stare without saying a word.
examples.zh: 他一言不發地久久盯著我看。

examples.en: She ignored the stares of the crowd.
examples.zh: 她不理會人群的盯視。

examples.en: A cold stare from the teacher made us quiet.
examples.zh: 老師冷冷地盯著我們，讓我們安靜下來。

examples.en: I'm starving after the long hike; can we eat soon?
examples.zh: 健行這麼久，我餓壞了；我們可以快點吃飯嗎？

examples.en: Some wild animals starve when winter is too long.
examples.zh: 冬天太長時，有些野生動物會挨餓。

examples.en: A good owner would never starve a pet.
examples.zh: 好的主人絕不會讓寵物挨餓。

examples.en: There is a bronze statue in front of the library.
examples.zh: 圖書館前面有一座銅像。

examples.en: Tourists took photos next to the famous statue.
examples.zh: 遊客在那座有名的雕像旁拍照。

examples.en: The statue of the king stands in the middle of the square.
examples.zh: 國王的雕像矗立在廣場中央。

examples.en: Hold the ladder steady while I climb up.
examples.zh: 我爬上去的時候，請把梯子扶穩。

examples.en: She has a steady job at a bank.
examples.zh: 她在銀行有一份穩定的工作。

examples.en: The team made steady progress this season.
examples.zh: 這支球隊這個球季穩定地進步。

examples.en: He put out a hand to steady the ladder.
examples.zh: 他伸出一隻手穩住梯子。

examples.en: A deep breath helps steady your nerves before a speech.
examples.zh: 演講前深呼吸有助於平復緊張的情緒。

examples.en: Please steady the camera while I press the button.
examples.zh: 我按下按鈕時，請把相機拿穩。

examples.en: The path up the hill was very steep.
examples.zh: 通往山丘的小徑非常陡峭。

examples.en: There has been a steep rise in vegetable prices.
examples.zh: 蔬菜價格急遽上漲。

examples.en: The price of the hotel is too steep for students.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的價格對學生來說太高了。

senses.zh: 黏的；黏答答的；悶熱潮濕的

examples.en: My hands are sticky from the candy.
examples.zh: 我的手因為糖果而黏答答的。

examples.en: Sticky rice is often used in Taiwanese snacks.
examples.zh: 糯米常被用來製作台灣小吃。

examples.en: It was a hot and sticky afternoon in the city.
examples.zh: 那是城裡一個又熱又悶的午後。

examples.en: My neck feels stiff after sleeping on the sofa.
examples.zh: 在沙發上睡過後，我的脖子覺得很僵硬。

examples.en: Beat the egg whites until they are stiff.
examples.zh: 把蛋白打到硬挺為止。

examples.en: The company faces stiff competition from new stores.
examples.zh: 這家公司面臨新商店的激烈競爭。

examples.en: The soap made my eyes sting when I washed my face.
examples.zh: 我洗臉時，肥皂讓眼睛刺痛。

examples.en: A bee stung my arm at the park.
examples.zh: 一隻蜜蜂在公園裡叮了我的手臂。

examples.en: Some jellyfish can sting swimmers in the summer.
examples.zh: 有些水母在夏天會螫傷游泳的人。

examples.en: I felt a sharp sting on my leg.
examples.zh: 我感覺到腿上一陣尖銳的刺痛。

examples.en: The cream will take away the sting of the bite.
examples.zh: 這個藥膏可以緩解叮咬的刺痛。

examples.en: A bee loses its sting after it stings someone.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂螫人之後就會失去螫針。

examples.en: Stir the soup so it doesn't burn.
examples.zh: 把湯攪一攪，才不會燒焦。

examples.en: She stirred sugar into her coffee before taking a sip.
examples.zh: 她把糖攪進咖啡裡，再喝了一小口。

examples.en: The speech stirred strong feelings in the audience.
examples.zh: 這場演講激起了觀眾強烈的情感。

examples.en: The doctor put five stitches in his knee.
examples.zh: 醫生在他的膝蓋上縫了五針。

examples.en: She learned a new stitch in knitting class.
examples.zh: 她在編織課學了一種新針法。

examples.en: There was a loose stitch on the sleeve.
examples.zh: 袖子上有一處針腳鬆了。

examples.en: She stitched a button onto my coat.
examples.zh: 她把一顆鈕扣縫到我的外套上。

examples.en: Mom stitched the hole in my sock.
examples.zh: 媽媽把我襪子上的洞縫補起來。

examples.en: Please stitch the cloth together along the edge.
examples.zh: 請沿著邊緣把布料縫合在一起。

examples.en: He sat on a high stool at the counter.
examples.zh: 他坐在櫃檯前的高腳凳上。

examples.en: Dad stood on a stool to reach the shelf.
examples.zh: 爸爸站在凳子上去拿架子上的東西。

examples.en: We have a small wooden stool in the bathroom.
examples.zh: 我們浴室裡有一張小木凳。

examples.en: Our teacher shared a good strategy for learning vocabulary.
examples.zh: 老師分享了一個學習單字的好策略。

examples.en: The company changed its marketing strategy to attract more young customers.
examples.zh: 這家公司改變了行銷策略，以吸引更多年輕顧客。

examples.en: Chess requires patience and strategy because players must plan several moves ahead.
examples.zh: 西洋棋需要耐心與策略，因為棋手必須提前規劃好幾步。

examples.en: Swimming helps build strength in your arms and legs.
examples.zh: 游泳有助於增強手臂和腿部的力量。

examples.en: Honesty is her greatest strength and makes her a trusted friend.
examples.zh: 誠實是她最大的長處，也讓她成為值得信賴的朋友。

examples.en: The engineers tested the strength of the bridge.
examples.zh: 工程師測試了這座橋的強度。

examples.en: She cut the paper into thin strips for the art project.
examples.zh: 她把紙剪成細長條，用來做美勞作業。

examples.en: A narrow strip of grass ran along the fence.
examples.zh: 一條狹長的草地沿著圍籬延伸。

examples.en: Tear off a strip of tape and seal the box.
examples.zh: 撕下一段膠帶把箱子封好。

examples.en: Please strip the old paint from the chair before you repaint it.
examples.zh: 重新上漆前，請先把椅子上的舊漆刮掉。

examples.en: He stripped off his wet jacket before entering the house.
examples.zh: 他進屋前脫掉了濕外套。

examples.en: He began to strip the bark from the branch.
examples.zh: 他開始剝掉樹枝上的樹皮。

examples.en: The structure of this essay is clear and easy to follow.
examples.zh: 這篇文章的結構清楚，很容易理解。

examples.en: The old structure by the river was built in 1900.
examples.zh: 河邊那棟老建築建於一九〇〇年。

examples.en: Scientists study the structure of the human brain.
examples.zh: 科學家研究人類大腦的構造。

examples.en: You should structure your speech with a clear beginning and ending.
examples.zh: 你應該讓演講有清楚的開頭和結尾。

examples.en: The teacher will structure the lesson around group work.
examples.zh: 老師會以小組活動為主來安排這堂課。

examples.en: We structure our meetings so everyone can speak.
examples.zh: 我們安排會議的方式，是讓每個人都能發言。

senses.zh: 頑固的；固執的；難以去除的

examples.en: My grandfather is too stubborn to see a doctor.
examples.zh: 我爺爺太固執了，不肯去看醫生。

examples.en: The stubborn stain would not come out of my shirt.
examples.zh: 我襯衫上這塊頑固的汙漬怎麼洗也洗不掉。

examples.en: She was stubborn and refused to change her plan.
examples.zh: 她很固執，不肯改變計畫。

examples.en: The artist painted all day in her small studio.
examples.zh: 這位藝術家整天在她的小工作室裡畫畫。

examples.en: The band is recording a new song at the studio.
examples.zh: 樂團正在錄音室錄製新歌。

examples.en: He rented a studio near the MRT station.
examples.zh: 他在捷運站附近租了一間套房。

examples.en: Please put your stuff in the locker before class.
examples.zh: 上課前請把你的東西放進置物櫃。

examples.en: There is a lot of heavy stuff in this box.
examples.zh: 這個箱子裡有很多沉重的東西。

examples.en: I love the stuff you bought for the party.
examples.zh: 我很喜歡你為派對買的那些東西。

examples.en: She tried to stuff too many clothes into the suitcase.
examples.zh: 她想把太多衣服塞進行李箱。

examples.en: We stuff the turkey with rice and vegetables.
examples.zh: 我們在火雞裡塞滿米飯和蔬菜。

examples.en: He stuffed the letter into his pocket and left.
examples.zh: 他把信塞進口袋就離開了。

examples.en: Water is a substance that can be a liquid, a solid, or a gas.
examples.zh: 水是一種物質，可以是液體、固體或氣體。

examples.en: The report has style, but it lacks substance.
examples.zh: 這份報告有風格，但缺乏實質內容。

examples.en: Always read the label on any chemical substance.
examples.zh: 使用任何化學物質前，都要先閱讀標示。

examples.en: Subtract five from ten and you get five.
examples.zh: 十減五等於五。

examples.en: The store will subtract the discount from your final bill.
examples.zh: 商店會從你的總帳單中扣除折扣。

examples.en: Students learn to add and subtract in the first grade.
examples.zh: 學生在一年級就學習加法和減法。

examples.en: My family moved to a quiet suburb of Taipei last year.
examples.zh: 我們家去年搬到台北一個安靜的郊區。

examples.en: Many people who work downtown live in the suburbs.
examples.zh: 許多在市區工作的人住在郊區。

examples.en: The bus takes about an hour to reach the suburb.
examples.zh: 公車大約要一小時才會到那個郊區。

examples.en: The baby likes to suck on a soft toy.
examples.zh: 寶寶喜歡吸吮柔軟的玩具。

examples.en: Use a straw to suck up the last bit of juice.
examples.zh: 用吸管把最後一點果汁吸起來。

examples.en: This machine can suck dust out of the carpet.
examples.zh: 這台機器能把地毯裡的灰塵吸走。

examples.en: Many people suffer from headaches during the exam season.
examples.zh: 許多人在考試季節會頭痛。

examples.en: The town suffered serious damage in the storm.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮在暴風雨中受到嚴重的損害。

examples.en: I hate to see animals suffer, so I volunteer at a shelter.
examples.zh: 我不忍心看到動物受苦，所以到收容所當志工。

examples.en: We have sufficient food for the whole class.
examples.zh: 我們有足夠的食物給全班同學。

examples.en: Is one hour sufficient time to finish the test?
examples.zh: 一小時的時間足夠寫完這份考卷嗎？

examples.en: There was not sufficient light to take a good photo.
examples.zh: 光線不足，沒辦法拍出好照片。

examples.en: The school runs a program on suicide prevention for students.
examples.zh: 學校為學生辦理自殺防治的課程。

examples.en: Experts say talking openly can help prevent suicide.
examples.zh: 專家說坦誠交談有助於預防自殺。

examples.en: If you worry about suicide, please call a help line.
examples.zh: 如果你擔心有人想自殺，請撥打協談專線。

examples.en: The sum of three and four is seven.
examples.zh: 三加四的總和是七。

examples.en: She paid a large sum of money for the old piano.
examples.zh: 她花了一大筆錢買下那架舊鋼琴。

examples.en: The children are practicing simple sums in math class.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在數學課練習簡單的算術題。

examples.en: Let me sum up the main points of today's lesson.
examples.zh: 讓我來總結今天這堂課的重點。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to sum up the story in one sentence.
examples.zh: 老師要我們用一句話總結這個故事。

examples.en: These small costs sum to more than we expected.
examples.zh: 這些小開銷加起來比我們預期的還多。

examples.en: Please write a short summary of the article.
examples.zh: 請為這篇文章寫一份簡短的摘要。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a summary of the lesson at the end of class.
examples.zh: 下課前，老師為我們總結了這堂課的內容。

examples.en: Read the summary first to get the main idea.
examples.zh: 先看摘要掌握大意。

examples.en: We reached the summit just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們在日出前不久抵達山頂。

examples.en: The leaders will meet at a summit in Tokyo next month.
examples.zh: 各國領袖下個月將在東京的高峰會上會面。

examples.en: Reaching the summit was the best moment of the trip.
examples.zh: 登上山頂是這趟旅程最棒的時刻。

senses.zh: 較優越的；上等的；較高級的

examples.en: This brand makes a superior product at a fair price.
examples.zh: 這個品牌以合理的價格製造出品質較好的產品。

examples.en: Her English is superior to mine because she practices every day.
examples.zh: 她每天練習，所以英文比我好。

examples.en: The hotel offers superior service to every guest.
examples.zh: 這間飯店為每位房客提供上等的服務。

examples.en: You should report the problem to your superior.
examples.zh: 你應該把這個問題向你的上司報告。

examples.en: The new manager is my direct superior.
examples.zh: 新來的經理是我的直屬上司。

examples.en: A good superior listens to the team.
examples.zh: 好的上司會傾聽團隊的意見。

examples.en: Tall mountains surround the small village, making it difficult to reach.
examples.zh: 高山環繞這個小村莊，使人難以抵達。

examples.en: Fans surrounded the singer as she left the building.
examples.zh: 歌手走出大樓時，歌迷把她團團圍住。

examples.en: A beautiful garden surrounds the school and provides space for outdoor lessons.
examples.zh: 一座美麗的花園環繞學校，提供戶外上課的空間。

examples.en: The school did a survey about students' favorite lunches.
examples.zh: 學校做了一份學生最愛午餐的問卷調查。

examples.en: Please fill out this short survey after your visit.
examples.zh: 參觀後請填寫這份簡短的問卷。

examples.en: A survey of the land took two weeks.
examples.zh: 這片土地的測量花了兩個星期。

examples.en: The company will survey customers about the new app.
examples.zh: 公司會就新應用程式調查顧客的意見。

examples.en: He stood at the door and surveyed the crowded room.
examples.zh: 他站在門口，環視擁擠的房間。

examples.en: Engineers came to survey the site before building.
examples.zh: 工程師在興建前來勘查工地。

examples.en: The survivor of the shipwreck was found on a small island.
examples.zh: 那場船難的倖存者在一座小島上被找到。

examples.en: She is a cancer survivor who now helps other patients.
examples.zh: 她是一名癌症存活者，如今會幫助其他病人。

examples.en: Rescue teams searched the area for survivors.
examples.zh: 救難隊在該地區搜尋生還者。

examples.en: I suspect that he forgot about the meeting.
examples.zh: 我猜他忘了開會這件事。

examples.en: The teacher suspected that someone had copied the answer.
examples.zh: 老師懷疑有人抄襲了答案。

examples.en: Do you suspect something is wrong with the engine?
examples.zh: 你懷疑引擎有問題嗎？

examples.en: Police questioned a suspect about the missing bike.
examples.zh: 警方就失竊的腳踏車詢問了一名嫌疑人。

examples.en: The main suspect had a good reason to be at the shop.
examples.zh: 主要嫌疑人有正當理由出現在那間店裡。

examples.en: No suspect has been found yet, so the investigation continues.
examples.zh: 目前還沒找到嫌疑人，因此調查仍在進行。

examples.en: I have a suspicion that she already knows the secret.
examples.zh: 我懷疑她早就知道這個秘密了。

examples.en: The strange noise raised the guard's suspicion.
examples.zh: 奇怪的聲音引起警衛的懷疑。

examples.en: He looked at the stranger with suspicion.
examples.zh: 他以懷疑的眼神看著那個陌生人。

examples.en: I swear I will keep your secret.
examples.zh: 我發誓會替你保守秘密。

examples.en: The new mayor will swear to serve the city.
examples.zh: 新市長將宣誓為這座城市服務。

examples.en: Please do not swear in front of the children.
examples.zh: 請不要在孩子面前說髒話。

examples.en: Sweat ran down his face after the long run.
examples.zh: 長跑之後，汗水順著他的臉流下來。

examples.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead with a towel.
examples.zh: 她用毛巾擦掉額頭上的汗。

examples.en: The smell of sweat filled the gym.
examples.zh: 健身房裡充滿汗味。

examples.en: I always sweat a lot in the summer.
examples.zh: 我夏天總是很會流汗。

examples.en: The players began to sweat in the hot sun.
examples.zh: 球員們在大太陽下開始流汗。

examples.en: Don't sweat it; we still have plenty of time.
examples.zh: 別擔心，時間還很充裕。

examples.en: My ankle began to swell after I fell.
examples.zh: 我跌倒後，腳踝開始腫起來。

examples.en: The river will swell after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，河水會暴漲。

examples.en: The crowd swelled as the concert time came near.
examples.zh: 音樂會時間逼近，人群越聚越多。

examples.en: The boat rose and fell on the ocean swell.
examples.zh: 小船隨著海上的湧浪起伏。

examples.en: There was a swell of applause at the end.
examples.zh: 結束時響起一陣熱烈的掌聲。

examples.en: The swell of the sea made us feel sick.
examples.zh: 海上的大浪讓我們覺得很不舒服。

examples.en: The company made a swift decision to fix the problem.
examples.zh: 公司迅速做出決定來解決問題。

examples.en: The swift runner won the race easily.
examples.zh: 那位跑得很快的選手輕鬆贏得比賽。

examples.en: We were thankful for the swift reply to our email.
examples.zh: 我們很感謝我們的電子郵件獲得迅速回覆。

examples.en: The museum has an old sword from the 1600s.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏了一把十七世紀的古劍。

examples.en: Actors used a wooden sword in the school play.
examples.zh: 演員在學校的戲劇中使用木劍。

examples.en: The knight in the story carried a long sword.
examples.zh: 故事裡的騎士帶著一把長劍。

examples.en: My little brother watches cartoons on a tablet.
examples.zh: 我弟弟用平板電腦看卡通。

examples.en: The doctor told me to take one tablet after each meal.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴我每餐飯後服用一顆藥片。

examples.en: An ancient stone tablet was found near the temple.
examples.zh: 寺廟附近發現了一塊古老的石碑。

examples.en: The price tag says this jacket costs 800 dollars.
examples.zh: 價格標籤上寫著這件外套要八百元。

examples.en: Please write your name on the luggage tag.
examples.zh: 請在行李吊牌上寫下你的名字。

examples.en: Each plant has a small tag with its name.
examples.zh: 每株植物都有一個寫著名稱的小標籤。

examples.en: Please tag your friends in the photo.
examples.zh: 請在照片中標註你的朋友。

examples.en: The shop will tag every item with a price.
examples.zh: 商店會替每件商品貼上價格標籤。

examples.en: Scientists tag the birds to follow their travels.
examples.zh: 科學家為鳥類加上標記，以追蹤牠們的遷徙。

examples.en: The tailor measured my arms for the new suit.
examples.zh: 裁縫師為了新西裝量了我的手臂長度。

examples.en: My father took the pants to a tailor to shorten them.
examples.zh: 我爸爸把褲子拿去給裁縫師修短。

examples.en: She works as a tailor in a small shop.
examples.zh: 她在一間小店裡擔任裁縫師。

examples.en: The school tries to tailor lessons to each student.
examples.zh: 學校努力依每位學生的需求設計課程。

examples.en: We can tailor the trip to your needs.
examples.zh: 我們可以依你的需求量身安排行程。

examples.en: He had the jacket tailored to fit him perfectly.
examples.zh: 他把外套訂做成完全合身的樣子。

examples.en: The tame rabbit lets the children pick it up.
examples.zh: 這隻溫馴的兔子讓孩子們抱起牠。

examples.en: A tame bird sat on her shoulder.
examples.zh: 一隻馴養的鳥停在她的肩膀上。

examples.en: Wild animals are not tame, so keep your distance.
examples.zh: 野生動物並不溫馴，所以要保持距離。

examples.en: It takes patience to tame a wild horse.
examples.zh: 馴服野馬需要耐心。

examples.en: The farmer managed to tame the young dog.
examples.zh: 農夫成功馴服了那隻小狗。

examples.en: People first tried to tame wolves thousands of years ago.
examples.zh: 人類在數千年前就開始嘗試馴養狼。

examples.en: Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth.
examples.zh: 刷牙時請關上水龍頭。

examples.en: Water from the tap is safe to drink after boiling.
examples.zh: 水龍頭的水煮沸後可以安全飲用。

examples.en: I heard a soft tap on the door.
examples.zh: 我聽到輕輕的敲門聲。

examples.en: Tap the screen twice to open the app.
examples.zh: 在螢幕上輕點兩下就能開啟應用程式。

examples.en: She tapped me on the shoulder to get my attention.
examples.zh: 她輕拍我的肩膀來引起我的注意。

examples.en: The town wants to tap solar power.
examples.zh: 這個城鎮想開發太陽能。

examples.en: The soup was hot and very tasty.
examples.zh: 這碗湯又熱又好喝。

examples.en: Mom made a tasty dinner for the whole family.
examples.zh: 媽媽為全家人做了一頓美味的晚餐。

examples.en: These tasty cookies are my favorite snack.
examples.zh: 這些好吃的餅乾是我最愛的點心。

examples.en: Please do not tease your little sister about her hair.
examples.zh: 請不要拿你妹妹的頭髮取笑她。

examples.en: My friends tease me because I always sing in the shower.
examples.zh: 朋友們取笑我老是在洗澡時唱歌。

examples.en: He likes to tease the cat with a piece of string.
examples.zh: 他喜歡用一條繩子逗貓。

examples.en: The company is looking for someone with technical skills.
examples.zh: 公司正在找具備技術能力的人。

examples.en: A technical problem delayed the online class.
examples.zh: 一個技術問題使線上課程延遲了。

examples.en: The manual is full of technical terms.
examples.zh: 這份手冊充滿專業術語。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a new technique for solving math problems.
examples.zh: 老師教我們一個解數學題的新技巧。

examples.en: She uses a special painting technique to create realistic shadows.
examples.zh: 她運用一種特別的繪畫技巧，畫出逼真的陰影。

examples.en: Good study techniques can save a lot of time.
examples.zh: 好的讀書技巧能省下許多時間。

examples.en: My teenage cousin spends hours on her phone.
examples.zh: 我十幾歲的表姊花好幾個小時滑手機。

examples.en: The shop sells clothes for teenage girls.
examples.zh: 這家店販售青少女的服飾。

examples.en: Teenage students often feel pressure before exams.
examples.zh: 青少年學生在考試前常會感到壓力。

examples.en: My brother has a bad temper when he is tired.
examples.zh: 我哥哥累的時候脾氣很差。

examples.en: She tried hard not to lose her temper in class.
examples.zh: 她努力不要在課堂上發脾氣。

examples.en: Keeping your temper helps you solve problems calmly.
examples.zh: 保持冷靜有助於你平心靜氣地解決問題。

examples.en: The teacher tried to temper her words with kindness.
examples.zh: 老師試著以善意緩和她的措辭。

examples.en: Add a little sugar to temper the sour taste.
examples.zh: 加一點糖來調和酸味。

examples.en: Experience will temper his excitement and help him make realistic plans.
examples.zh: 經驗會使他不再那麼興奮，並幫助他擬定切合實際的計畫。

examples.en: This is only a temporary fix, so we need a better plan.
examples.zh: 這只是暫時的修補辦法，所以我們需要更好的計畫。

examples.en: He found a temporary job during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 他在暑假找到一份臨時工作。

examples.en: The road will have a temporary closure on Sunday.
examples.zh: 這條路星期日會暫時封閉。

examples.en: Prices tend to rise before the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期前物價往往會上漲。

examples.en: I tend to get sleepy after lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐後常常會想睡。

examples.en: She tends the garden every evening after work.
examples.zh: 她每天傍晚下班後都會照料花園。

examples.en: The beef was so tender that it melted in my mouth.
examples.zh: 這塊牛肉很嫩，入口即化。

examples.en: She gave the baby a tender kiss.
examples.zh: 她溫柔地親了寶寶一下。

examples.en: My knee is still tender after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後，我的膝蓋觸碰時仍會痛。

examples.en: The country sent a team to inspect its territory.
examples.zh: 這個國家派了一支隊伍去勘查其領土。

examples.en: Lions mark their territory to keep other animals away.
examples.zh: 獅子標記自己的地盤，以趕走其他動物。

examples.en: Space travel is still new territory for our company.
examples.zh: 太空旅行對我們公司來說仍是新領域。

examples.en: I am thankful for your help with my homework.
examples.zh: 我很感謝你幫忙我寫功課。

examples.en: They were thankful that the weather was clear for the trip.
examples.zh: 他們慶幸旅行當天天氣晴朗。

examples.en: She felt thankful to have such good friends.
examples.zh: 她很感激能有這麼好的朋友。

examples.en: Einstein's theory changed the way we see time.
examples.zh: 愛因斯坦的理論改變了我們看待時間的方式。

examples.en: In theory, the plan should work well.
examples.zh: 理論上，這個計畫應該行得通。

examples.en: My theory is that he missed the bus.
examples.zh: 我的猜測是他錯過了公車。

examples.en: A cold drink can quench your thirst on a hot day.
examples.zh: 在大熱天，一杯冷飲可以解渴。

examples.en: The runner drank water to satisfy his thirst.
examples.zh: 跑者喝水來解渴。

examples.en: She has a thirst for knowledge and reads widely every day.
examples.zh: 她渴求知識，每天都廣泛閱讀。

examples.en: She needs a needle and some red thread to fix the button.
examples.zh: 她需要針和一些紅線來縫好鈕釦。

examples.en: I lost the thread of the story during the talk.
examples.zh: 演講時我跟丟了故事的脈絡。

examples.en: A thread of light came through the curtain.
examples.zh: 一道細細的光從窗簾透進來。

examples.en: Can you thread this needle for me?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我把針穿好線嗎？

examples.en: He threaded his way through the busy crowd.
examples.zh: 他穿過擁擠的人群前進。

examples.en: She threaded the beads onto a string.
examples.zh: 她把珠子串在一條線上。

examples.en: Pollution is a serious threat to our health.
examples.zh: 汙染是對我們健康的嚴重威脅。

examples.en: The company faces a threat from new competitors.
examples.zh: 這間公司面臨新競爭者的威脅。

examples.en: Dark clouds were a threat to our picnic.
examples.zh: 烏雲對我們的野餐構成威脅。

examples.en: Heavy rain may threaten the farmers' crops.
examples.zh: 大雨可能會威脅農民的作物。

examples.en: The boss did not threaten anyone; he only gave a warning.
examples.zh: 老闆沒有威脅任何人，只是提出警告。

examples.en: Dark clouds threaten a storm this afternoon.
examples.zh: 烏雲預示今天下午會有暴風雨。

examples.en: The tide is low, so we can walk on the beach.
examples.zh: 現在潮位低，所以我們可以在海灘上走。

examples.en: Fishing boats go out when the tide comes in.
examples.zh: 漲潮時，漁船會出海。

examples.en: The tide of public opinion is changing.
examples.zh: 民意的趨勢正在改變。

examples.en: These shoes are too tight for my feet.
examples.zh: 這雙鞋對我的腳來說太緊了。

examples.en: Our schedule is tight this week because of the upcoming conference.
examples.zh: 因為即將舉行研討會，我們這星期的行程很緊湊。

examples.en: Money is tight this month, so we will eat at home.
examples.zh: 這個月手頭很緊，所以我們在家吃飯。

examples.en: Hold tight to the handle on the bus.
examples.zh: 在公車上要緊緊抓住把手。

examples.en: She closed the lid tight so nothing would spill.
examples.zh: 她把蓋子蓋緊，以免東西灑出來。

examples.en: Sleep tight, and I will see you at breakfast tomorrow.
examples.zh: 睡個好覺，我明天早餐時會見到你。

examples.en: Please tighten the screw so the shelf does not fall.
examples.zh: 請把螺絲鎖緊，這樣架子才不會掉下來。

examples.en: The government will tighten rules for food safety.
examples.zh: 政府將加強食品安全的規定。

examples.en: He tightened his belt before running to keep his pants in place.
examples.zh: 他跑步前把皮帶繫緊，以免褲子滑落。

examples.en: The workers carried the timber to the construction site.
examples.zh: 工人把木材搬到工地。

examples.en: This house is built entirely of timber from local forests.
examples.zh: 這棟房子完全採用當地森林的木材建造。

examples.en: The company sells timber to furniture makers around the world.
examples.zh: 這家公司把木材賣給世界各地的家具製造商。

examples.en: Tobacco is grown in many warm parts of the world.
examples.zh: 世界上許多溫暖的地區都種植菸草。

examples.en: The sign says tobacco products are not sold to minors.
examples.zh: 告示牌上寫著不得將菸草製品賣給未成年人。

examples.en: My grandfather gave up tobacco after he turned sixty.
examples.zh: 我祖父六十歲之後就戒菸了。

examples.en: The truck can carry up to two tons of rice.
examples.zh: 這輛卡車最多可以載運兩公噸的米。

examples.en: A blue whale weighs more than one hundred tons.
examples.zh: 一隻藍鯨重達一百多公噸。

examples.en: I have a ton of homework to finish tonight.
examples.zh: 我今晚有一大堆功課要寫完。

examples.en: Please toss the ball to your partner.
examples.zh: 請把球丟給你的搭檔。

examples.en: He tossed his bag onto the sofa and sat down.
examples.zh: 他把袋子扔到沙發上，然後坐了下來。

examples.en: I tossed and turned all night because of the heat.
examples.zh: 因為天氣熱，我整晚翻來覆去睡不著。

examples.en: The coach decided the starting team with a coin toss.
examples.zh: 教練用擲硬幣決定先發隊伍。

examples.en: Her toss of the ball was too high.
examples.zh: 她那一球丟得太高了。

examples.en: After the toss, our team chose to serve first.
examples.zh: 擲完硬幣後，我們隊選擇先發球。

examples.en: The meat was too tough to cut with a plastic knife.
examples.zh: 這塊肉太老了，用塑膠刀切不動。

examples.en: It was a tough decision, but she made the right choice.
examples.zh: 那是個艱難的決定，但她做了正確的選擇。

examples.en: The coach is tough, but he is always fair to the players.
examples.zh: 教練很嚴格，但對球員一向公平。

examples.en: Tourism is the main source of income on this island.
examples.zh: 觀光業是這座島的主要收入來源。

examples.en: The government wants to promote tourism in rural areas.
examples.zh: 政府想在鄉村地區推廣觀光。

examples.en: Tourism grew quickly after the new airport opened.
examples.zh: 新機場啟用後，觀光業迅速成長。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the night market every evening.
examples.zh: 許多觀光客每天晚上都會來逛夜市。

examples.en: The tourist asked me how to get to the museum.
examples.zh: 那位觀光客問我怎麼去博物館。

examples.en: A group of tourists took photos in front of the temple.
examples.zh: 一群觀光客在廟前拍照。

examples.en: The police tow cars that are parked in front of the gate.
examples.zh: 警察會拖吊停在大門前的車。

examples.en: A small boat towed the broken ship back to the harbor.
examples.zh: 一艘小船把故障的船拖回港口。

examples.en: My dad used a rope to tow the car out of the mud.
examples.zh: 我爸爸用繩子把車從泥巴裡拖出來。

examples.en: Our car broke down, so we called for a tow.
examples.zh: 我們的車拋錨了，所以打電話叫拖吊。

examples.en: The truck gave us a tow to the nearest garage.
examples.zh: 那輛卡車把我們拖到最近的修車廠。

examples.en: The sailboat was in tow behind the larger ship.
examples.zh: 那艘帆船被前方較大的船拖著走。

examples.en: The trader sold spices from many different countries.
examples.zh: 這位商人販售來自許多不同國家的香料。

examples.en: She works as a trader at a large bank.
examples.zh: 她在一家大銀行擔任交易員。

examples.en: Early traders traveled across the desert with camels.
examples.zh: 早期的商人帶著駱駝穿越沙漠。

examples.en: We followed the trail up to the top of the mountain.
examples.zh: 我們沿著小徑爬到山頂。

examples.en: The dog picked up the trail of a rabbit.
examples.zh: 那隻狗聞到了兔子的蹤跡。

examples.en: The trail was muddy after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，小徑變得很泥濘。

examples.en: Our team is trailing by two points at halftime.
examples.zh: 我們隊在中場休息時落後兩分。

examples.en: Her long scarf trailed behind her in the wind.
examples.zh: 她的長圍巾在風中拖在身後。

examples.en: The detective trailed the man through the crowded station.
examples.zh: 偵探在擁擠的車站裡跟著那名男子。

examples.en: Public transport is cheap and convenient in this city.
examples.zh: 這座城市的大眾運輸既便宜又方便。

examples.en: The cost of transport is included in the ticket price.
examples.zh: 交通費已包含在票價裡。

examples.en: Trains are a clean form of transport.
examples.zh: 火車是一種乾淨的運輸方式。

examples.en: Trucks transport fresh vegetables to the market every morning.
examples.zh: 卡車每天早上把新鮮蔬菜運到市場。

examples.en: The ship can transport more than two thousand cars.
examples.zh: 這艘船可以運送兩千多輛車。

examples.en: The nurse helped transport the patient to another room.
examples.zh: 護理師協助把病人送到另一間病房。

examples.en: The traveler checked the map before leaving the hotel.
examples.zh: 這位旅行者離開飯店前先看了地圖。

examples.en: Many travelers buy small gifts at the airport.
examples.zh: 許多旅客會在機場買小禮物。

examples.en: An experienced traveler packs light and plans ahead.
examples.zh: 有經驗的旅行者會輕便打包並提前規劃。

examples.en: The waiter carried a tray of drinks to our table.
examples.zh: 服務生端著一盤飲料來到我們桌邊。

examples.en: Put your lunch tray on the shelf when you finish.
examples.zh: 吃完午餐後，請把餐盤放在架子上。

examples.en: She placed the cookies on a baking tray.
examples.zh: 她把餅乾放在烤盤上。

examples.en: Online shopping is a growing trend among young people.
examples.zh: 網路購物在年輕人之間是日益盛行的趨勢。

examples.en: This color is the latest trend in fashion.
examples.zh: 這個顏色是時尚界的最新潮流。

examples.en: Sales show an upward trend this year.
examples.zh: 今年的銷售呈現上升趨勢。

examples.en: The tribe lives deep in the rainforest.
examples.zh: 這個部落住在雨林深處。

examples.en: Each tribe in the region has its own language.
examples.zh: 這個地區的每個部落都有自己的語言。

examples.en: Visitors learned about the customs of the local tribe.
examples.zh: 遊客認識了當地部落的習俗。

examples.en: The last question on the test was really tricky.
examples.zh: 考卷的最後一題真的很難。

examples.en: Parking in this narrow street is tricky.
examples.zh: 在這條窄街上停車很棘手。

examples.en: It is tricky to explain this idea in simple words.
examples.zh: 要用簡單的話解釋這個想法並不容易。

examples.en: The troops returned home after the long mission.
examples.zh: 部隊結束長期任務後返回家鄉。

examples.en: A troop of scouts camped near the lake.
examples.zh: 一隊童軍在湖邊露營。

examples.en: The government sent troops to help after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，政府派遣部隊協助救援。

examples.en: Bananas and pineapples grow in tropical countries.
examples.zh: 香蕉和鳳梨生長在熱帶國家。

examples.en: We spent our holiday on a tropical island.
examples.zh: 我們在一座熱帶島嶼上度假。

examples.en: The weather here is hot and tropical all year.
examples.zh: 這裡的天氣終年炎熱，屬於熱帶氣候。

examples.en: A squirrel ran up the trunk of the old tree.
examples.zh: 一隻松鼠沿著老樹的樹幹跑上去。

examples.en: Please put the suitcases in the trunk of the car.
examples.zh: 請把行李箱放進車子的後行李廂。

examples.en: The elephant picked up the food with its trunk.
examples.zh: 大象用牠的鼻子捲起食物。

examples.en: She gave a truthful answer to the teacher.
examples.zh: 她對老師給了誠實的答覆。

examples.en: Please be truthful about what happened at school.
examples.zh: 請誠實說出學校裡發生了什麼事。

examples.en: The report is a truthful account of the event.
examples.zh: 這份報告如實記錄了該事件。

examples.en: The little boy tugged at his mother's sleeve.
examples.zh: 小男孩拉著媽媽的袖子。

examples.en: She tugged the heavy door until it opened.
examples.zh: 她用力拉那扇沉重的門，直到它打開。

examples.en: The puppy tugged the rope with its teeth.
examples.zh: 小狗用牙齒拉扯繩子。

examples.en: I felt a tug on my fishing line.
examples.zh: 我感覺到釣線被用力拉了一下。

examples.en: Give the rope a tug to see if it is safe.
examples.zh: 拉一下繩子，看看安不安全。

examples.en: A tug pulled the large ship into the port.
examples.zh: 一艘拖船把大船拉進港口。

examples.en: I cannot get that tune out of my head.
examples.zh: 我腦子裡一直揮不去那段旋律。

examples.en: She hummed a happy tune while she cooked.
examples.zh: 她邊做菜邊哼著輕快的曲調。

examples.en: The band played a familiar tune at the end of the show.
examples.zh: 樂團在表演結束時演奏了一首熟悉的曲子。

examples.en: He tuned his guitar before the concert began.
examples.zh: 音樂會開始前，他先調好吉他的音。

examples.en: Please tune the radio to a different station.
examples.zh: 請把收音機轉到別的電台。

examples.en: The mechanic tuned the engine so it ran smoothly.
examples.zh: 技師調整了引擎，讓它運轉順暢。

examples.en: My tutor helps me with math twice a week.
examples.zh: 我的家教老師每週幫我補數學兩次。

examples.en: The school hired a tutor for students who need extra help.
examples.zh: 學校聘請了輔導老師來幫助需要額外協助的學生。

examples.en: Her tutor taught her how to write a good essay.
examples.zh: 她的家教老師教她如何寫好一篇作文。

examples.en: She tutors younger students in math at the library after school.
examples.zh: 她放學後在圖書館輔導年紀較小的學生學數學。

examples.en: He tutored his neighbor in English for two years.
examples.zh: 他替鄰居輔導英文長達兩年。

examples.en: I tutor a few students on weekends to earn extra money.
examples.zh: 我週末輔導幾位學生來賺外快。

examples.en: My twin and I look very different.
examples.zh: 我和我的雙胞胎手足長得很不一樣。

examples.en: The twins wore matching shirts to school.
examples.zh: 雙胞胎穿著一樣的上衣去學校。

examples.en: She is the younger twin by five minutes.
examples.zh: 她比雙胞胎的另一位小五分鐘。

examples.en: The hotel room has twin beds and a small balcony.
examples.zh: 這間飯店房間有兩張單人床和一個小陽台。

examples.en: The twin towers can be seen from far away.
examples.zh: 遠遠就能看到那對雙子塔。

examples.en: They are twin sisters who live in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她們是住在台北的雙胞胎姊妹。

examples.en: Twist the cap to the left to open the bottle.
examples.zh: 把瓶蓋向左轉就能打開瓶子。

examples.en: He twisted his ankle while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他打籃球時扭傷了腳踝。

examples.en: She twisted the towel to squeeze out the water.
examples.zh: 她把毛巾扭轉擠出水來。

examples.en: The story has a surprising twist at the end.
examples.zh: 這個故事的結局有個出人意料的轉折。

examples.en: Give the lid a twist and it will come off.
examples.zh: 把蓋子轉一下就會打開。

examples.en: The road makes a sharp twist near the river.
examples.zh: 這條路在河邊急轉彎。

examples.en: The workers joined a union to ask for better pay.
examples.zh: 工人加入工會，要求更好的薪水。

examples.en: The student union organizes events on campus.
examples.zh: 學生會在校園裡舉辦活動。

examples.en: The union of the two companies created a larger business.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司的合併創造出規模更大的企業。

examples.en: The whole class united to help the new student.
examples.zh: 全班同學團結起來幫助新同學。

examples.en: The two small towns decided to unite as one city.
examples.zh: 這兩個小鎮決定合併成一座城市。

examples.en: Music can unite people from different countries.
examples.zh: 音樂能把來自不同國家的人聚在一起。

examples.en: The team showed great unity during the final game.
examples.zh: 這支隊伍在決賽中展現了極大的團結。

examples.en: The festival celebrates unity among different cultures.
examples.zh: 這個節慶慶祝不同文化之間的團結。

examples.en: Our teacher spoke about the importance of unity in a group.
examples.zh: 老師談到團體中團結的重要性。

examples.en: More people are moving to urban areas for work.
examples.zh: 越來越多人為了工作搬到都市地區。

examples.en: Urban life can be noisy and fast.
examples.zh: 都市生活可能既吵雜又快速。

examples.en: The city built new parks to improve the urban environment.
examples.zh: 這座城市興建新公園來改善都市環境。

examples.en: The vacant seat on the bus was next to the window.
examples.zh: 公車上的空位在窗邊。

examples.en: There is a vacant room on the third floor.
examples.zh: 三樓有一間空房。

examples.en: The company has a vacant position in the sales team.
examples.zh: 這家公司的業務團隊有一個職缺。

examples.en: The delivery man drove a white van.
examples.zh: 送貨員開著一輛白色廂型車。

examples.en: Our family rented a van for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們一家人租了一輛廂型車去旅行。

examples.en: The musicians loaded their instruments into the van.
examples.zh: 樂手們把樂器搬上廂型車。

examples.en: The rabbit vanished into the tall grass.
examples.zh: 兔子消失在高高的草叢裡。

examples.en: My headache vanished after I took a rest.
examples.zh: 我休息之後，頭痛就消失了。

examples.en: The magician made the coin vanish from his hand.
examples.zh: 魔術師讓硬幣從他手中消失。

examples.en: The shop sells a wide variety of fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 這家店販售各式各樣的新鮮水果。

examples.en: A healthy diet needs variety to provide all the nutrients we need.
examples.zh: 健康的飲食需要多樣化，才能提供我們所需的各種營養素。

examples.en: This variety of tomato is sweet and juicy.
examples.zh: 這個品種的番茄又甜又多汁。

examples.en: We discussed various ways to save energy at home.
examples.zh: 我們討論了在家節約能源的各種方法。

examples.en: The store sells shoes in various sizes and colors.
examples.zh: 這家店販售各種尺寸與顏色的鞋子。

examples.en: He has lived in various cities across Taiwan.
examples.zh: 他住過台灣各地不同的城市。

examples.en: Prices vary from store to store, so compare them before buying.
examples.zh: 各家店的價格不一樣，所以購買前要先比價。

examples.en: The weather here can vary a lot in one day.
examples.zh: 這裡一天之內天氣可能變化很大。

examples.en: Students' test scores vary widely in this class.
examples.zh: 這個班級學生的考試成績差異很大。

examples.en: She put the roses in a glass vase.
examples.zh: 她把玫瑰花插進玻璃花瓶裡。

examples.en: The cat knocked the vase off the table.
examples.zh: 貓把花瓶從桌上撞了下來。

examples.en: This old vase was a gift from my grandmother.
examples.zh: 這個老花瓶是我祖母送的禮物。

examples.en: Only electric vehicles can enter this area.
examples.zh: 只有電動車可以進入這個區域。

examples.en: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
examples.zh: 那輛車在紅燈前停下來。

examples.en: A bicycle is the cheapest vehicle for short trips.
examples.zh: 腳踏車是短程移動最便宜的交通工具。

examples.en: The poem has four verses and each one rhymes.
examples.zh: 這首詩有四個詩節，每一節都押韻。

examples.en: She wrote a short verse on the birthday card.
examples.zh: 她在生日卡上寫了一小段詩句。

examples.en: The children sang the first verse of the song.
examples.zh: 孩子們唱了這首歌的第一段。

examples.en: The victim of the flood received help from neighbors.
examples.zh: 水災的受災戶得到了鄰居的幫助。

examples.en: Many victims of the storm lost their homes.
examples.zh: 許多暴風雨的受害者失去了家園。

examples.en: The police spoke kindly to the victim of the theft.
examples.zh: 警方對失竊案的被害人態度和善。

examples.en: The school teaches students to say no to violence.
examples.zh: 學校教導學生拒絕暴力。

examples.en: Many people want less violence on television.
examples.zh: 許多人希望電視上少一點暴力內容。

examples.en: The mayor spoke out against violence in the community.
examples.zh: 市長公開反對社區中的暴力行為。

examples.en: The film was too violent for young children.
examples.zh: 這部電影對小孩來說太暴力了。

examples.en: A violent storm hit the coast last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚一場猛烈的暴風雨襲擊了海岸。

examples.en: The teacher asked the class to avoid violent games.
examples.zh: 老師要求全班避免玩暴力的遊戲。

examples.en: She picked a small violet from the garden.
examples.zh: 她從花園裡摘了一朵小紫羅蘭。

examples.en: The sky turned a soft violet at sunset.
examples.zh: 日落時天空變成柔和的紫色。

examples.en: I painted the wall a pale violet.
examples.zh: 我把牆壁漆成淡紫色。

examples.en: She wore a violet dress to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件紫色洋裝去參加派對。

examples.en: The violet flowers bloom in early spring.
examples.zh: 紫色的花在初春盛開。

examples.en: He bought a violet scarf for his sister.
examples.zh: 他買了一條紫色圍巾給姊姊。

examples.en: The mountain is visible from my bedroom window.
examples.zh: 從我臥室的窗戶就看得到那座山。

examples.en: There was no visible damage to the car.
examples.zh: 這輛車沒有明顯的損傷。

examples.en: The sign must be clearly visible from the road.
examples.zh: 這個標誌必須在路上清楚可見。

examples.en: Reading in the dark can hurt your vision.
examples.zh: 在黑暗中看書可能傷害視力。

examples.en: The new principal has a clear vision for the school.
examples.zh: 新校長對學校有明確的願景。

examples.en: Fog limited our vision on the highway.
examples.zh: 大霧限制了我們在高速公路上的視野。

examples.en: Oranges are rich in vitamin C and make a healthy snack.
examples.zh: 柳橙富含維他命 C，是健康的點心。

examples.en: The doctor told him to take a vitamin every day.
examples.zh: 醫生要他每天吃一顆維他命。

examples.en: Milk gives children the vitamin D they need.
examples.zh: 牛奶提供孩子所需的維他命 D。

examples.en: She gave a vivid description of her trip to Japan.
examples.zh: 她生動地描述了她的日本之旅。

examples.en: The garden was full of vivid red flowers.
examples.zh: 花園裡開滿了鮮豔的紅花。

examples.en: I still have a vivid memory of my first day at school.
examples.zh: 我對第一天上學的情景仍記憶鮮明。

examples.en: The minimum wage in this country went up this year.
examples.zh: 這個國家的基本工資今年調高了。

examples.en: He earns a good wage as a factory worker.
examples.zh: 他當工廠工人，薪水不錯。

examples.en: Workers asked for a higher hourly wage.
examples.zh: 工人要求更高的時薪。

examples.en: The farmer loaded the wagon with hay.
examples.zh: 農夫把乾草裝上馬車。

examples.en: The little girl pulled her toys in a red wagon.
examples.zh: 小女孩用紅色手拉車拉著她的玩具。

examples.en: An old wagon stood outside the museum.
examples.zh: 一輛老馬車停在博物館外面。

examples.en: We wandered through the old streets after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後我們在老街上閒逛。

examples.en: Don't let the children wander away from the group.
examples.zh: 別讓孩子離開隊伍亂跑。

examples.en: His mind began to wander during the long speech.
examples.zh: 在冗長的演講中，他開始分心了。

examples.en: We sat near the fire to enjoy its warmth.
examples.zh: 我們坐在火的旁邊，享受暖意。

examples.en: The warmth of the sun made me feel sleepy.
examples.zh: 太陽的暖意讓我昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: Her warmth made every guest feel welcome.
examples.zh: 她的熱情讓每位客人都感到賓至如歸。

examples.en: The teacher warned us not to run near the pool.
examples.zh: 老師警告我們不要在泳池旁奔跑。

examples.en: The weather report warns that a typhoon is coming this weekend.
examples.zh: 氣象報告提醒本週末將有颱風來襲。

examples.en: I warned him that the sale would end soon, but he still missed it.
examples.zh: 我提醒他特價活動快結束了，但他還是錯過了。

examples.en: She rubbed some wax on the old wooden table.
examples.zh: 她在舊木桌上擦了一些蠟。

examples.en: The candle was made of natural wax.
examples.zh: 這支蠟燭是用天然的蠟做成的。

examples.en: Wax dripped down the side of the candle.
examples.zh: 蠟油沿著蠟燭的側面滴下來。

examples.en: Dad waxes the car every few months.
examples.zh: 爸爸每隔幾個月就會幫車子打蠟。

examples.en: We waxed the floor before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到達之前，我們先把地板打了蠟。

examples.en: He waxed his skis before the race.
examples.zh: 比賽前他幫滑雪板上了蠟。

examples.en: A bad cold can weaken your body.
examples.zh: 重感冒會使你的身體變虛弱。

examples.en: The storm weakened as it moved inland.
examples.zh: 暴風雨移入內陸後逐漸減弱。

examples.en: Too much noise may weaken your ability to focus.
examples.zh: 太多噪音可能會削弱你的專注力。

examples.en: The wealthy man donated money to the local school.
examples.zh: 那位富有的男士捐錢給當地的學校。

examples.en: She comes from a wealthy family in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她來自台北的一個富裕家庭。

examples.en: Wealthy countries can help poorer ones by supporting education and health care.
examples.zh: 富裕國家可以透過支持教育與醫療來幫助較貧窮的國家。

examples.en: Grandma weaves baskets from dried grass to sell at the local market.
examples.zh: 奶奶用乾草編織籃子，拿到當地市場販售。

examples.en: The workers weave cloth by hand in this village.
examples.zh: 這個村子的工人用手工織布。

examples.en: She wove a flower crown for her little sister.
examples.zh: 她替年幼的妹妹編了一個花冠。

examples.en: A spider built a web in the corner of the room.
examples.zh: 一隻蜘蛛在房間角落結了網。

examples.en: You can find the information on the web.
examples.zh: 你可以在網路上找到這項資訊。

examples.en: The morning dew made the web shine.
examples.zh: 晨露讓蜘蛛網閃閃發亮。

examples.en: Weeds are growing all over the garden.
examples.zh: 整座花園都長滿了雜草。

examples.en: We pulled the weeds out of the flower bed.
examples.zh: 我們把花圃裡的雜草拔掉。

examples.en: Weeds grow fast after a rainy week.
examples.zh: 下過一週的雨之後，雜草長得很快。

examples.en: Grandpa weeds the vegetable garden every weekend.
examples.zh: 爺爺每個週末都會替菜園除草。

examples.en: I need to weed the yard before the party.
examples.zh: 派對前我得先把院子的雜草除掉。

examples.en: They weeded the field in the cool morning.
examples.zh: 他們趁涼爽的早晨替田地除草。

examples.en: She wept when she heard the sad news.
examples.zh: 她聽到這個壞消息時哭了起來。

examples.en: The little boy wept quietly in his room.
examples.zh: 小男孩在房間裡靜靜地流淚。

examples.en: Many people wept at the end of the movie.
examples.zh: 許多人在電影結束時流下了眼淚。

examples.en: Farmers harvest wheat in early summer when the grain is ready.
examples.zh: 農夫在初夏穀粒成熟時收割小麥。

examples.en: Bread is usually made from wheat flour.
examples.zh: 麵包通常是用小麥麵粉做的。

examples.en: The field was full of golden wheat.
examples.zh: 田野裡滿是金黃色的小麥。

examples.en: The rider held a whip in her right hand.
examples.zh: 騎士右手拿著一條鞭子。

examples.en: The trainer used a whip to guide the horse.
examples.zh: 訓練員用鞭子引導那匹馬。

examples.en: An old whip hung on the wall of the barn.
examples.zh: 穀倉的牆上掛著一條舊鞭子。

examples.en: Whip the cream until it becomes thick.
examples.zh: 把鮮奶油攪打到變濃稠。

examples.en: The wind whipped the flags back and forth.
examples.zh: 風把旗子吹得來回飄動。

examples.en: She whipped out her phone to take a photo.
examples.zh: 她迅速掏出手機拍了一張照。

examples.en: The coach blew his whistle to start the game.
examples.zh: 教練吹響哨子，比賽開始。

examples.en: We heard a loud whistle from the train.
examples.zh: 我們聽到火車傳來響亮的汽笛聲。

examples.en: The referee's whistle stopped the match after a player fell.
examples.zh: 一名球員跌倒後，裁判的哨聲讓比賽暫停。

examples.en: He whistles a happy tune while he works.
examples.zh: 他邊工作邊吹著輕快的曲子。

examples.en: The kettle whistled when the water was ready.
examples.zh: 水燒開時，水壺發出了鳴笛聲。

examples.en: My brother whistled for the dog to come back.
examples.zh: 我哥哥吹口哨叫狗回來。

examples.en: The wicked witch in the story cast a spell.
examples.zh: 故事裡邪惡的女巫施了魔法。

examples.en: The wicked stepmother was jealous of the girl.
examples.zh: 壞心的繼母嫉妒那個女孩。

examples.en: Children love stories about wicked kings and brave heroes.
examples.zh: 孩子們喜歡聽邪惡國王與勇敢英雄的故事。

examples.en: Please wipe the table after dinner with a damp cloth.
examples.zh: 晚餐後請用濕布把桌子擦乾淨。

examples.en: He wiped the sweat off his forehead.
examples.zh: 他擦掉額頭上的汗水。

examples.en: I wiped the old files from my computer.
examples.zh: 我把電腦裡的舊檔案刪除了。

examples.en: Give the counter a quick wipe, please.
examples.zh: 請把檯面快速擦一下。

examples.en: I always carry wipes in my bag for my baby.
examples.zh: 我總是在包包裡帶著濕紙巾給寶寶用。

examples.en: A damp wipe cleaned the screen easily.
examples.zh: 用濕紙巾輕輕一擦就把螢幕擦乾淨了。

examples.en: My grandfather is known for his wisdom.
examples.zh: 我祖父以他的智慧聞名。

examples.en: Wisdom comes from experience as well as books.
examples.zh: 智慧來自經驗，也來自書本。

examples.en: She shared her wisdom with the young students.
examples.zh: 她把自己的智慧分享給年輕的學生。

examples.en: Please wrap the gift in red paper.
examples.zh: 請用紅色紙把禮物包起來。

examples.en: She wrapped a scarf around her neck.
examples.zh: 她把圍巾圍在脖子上。

examples.en: We wrapped the leftover pizza in foil.
examples.zh: 我們用鋁箔紙把吃剩的披薩包起來。

examples.en: Throw the plastic wrap into the trash can.
examples.zh: 把保鮮膜丟進垃圾桶。

examples.en: I ordered a chicken wrap for lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐點了一份雞肉捲餅。

examples.en: She wore a warm wrap over her dress.
examples.zh: 她在洋裝外面披了一件保暖的披肩。

examples.en: Separate the yolk from the egg white.
examples.zh: 把蛋黃和蛋白分開。

examples.en: The yolk of a fresh egg is bright yellow.
examples.zh: 新鮮雞蛋的蛋黃是鮮黃色的。

examples.en: He likes his fried egg with a soft yolk.
examples.zh: 他喜歡吃蛋黃半熟的煎蛋。

examples.en: The youngster helped the old man cross the road.
examples.zh: 那個少年幫老先生過馬路。

examples.en: Many youngsters enjoy playing online games with their friends after school.
examples.zh: 許多年輕人喜歡放學後和朋友玩線上遊戲。

examples.en: The coach taught the youngsters how to swim.
examples.zh: 教練教這群孩子怎麼游泳。

examples.en: The zipper on my jacket is stuck.
examples.zh: 我外套的拉鍊卡住了。

examples.en: Please close the zipper of your backpack.
examples.zh: 請把你後背包的拉鍊拉上。

examples.en: She fixed the broken zipper with a pin.
examples.zh: 她用別針修好了壞掉的拉鍊。

examples.en: This is a no-parking zone, so please move your car.
examples.zh: 這裡是禁止停車的區域，請把車移走。

examples.en: Students must stay in the safe zone during the drill.
examples.zh: 演習期間，學生必須待在安全區域。

examples.en: The city has a new school zone near the station.
examples.zh: 這座城市在車站附近新劃設了學校周邊交通安全區。

examples.en: The city zoned this area for new homes.
examples.zh: 市政府把這個地區劃為住宅用地。

examples.en: The land was zoned for farming only.
examples.zh: 這塊土地只劃定為農業用途。

examples.en: They zoned the park for public use.
examples.zh: 他們把這座公園劃為公共使用區。

examples.en: I added some almonds to my breakfast cereal.
examples.zh: 我在早餐麥片裡加了一些杏仁。

examples.en: The cake is topped with sliced almonds.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕上面撒了杏仁片。

examples.en: Almond milk is popular with people who avoid dairy.
examples.zh: 杏仁奶很受不食用乳製品的人歡迎。

examples.en: You need a comma after the word 'however' in this sentence.
examples.zh: 這個句子裡，在「however」後面需要加逗號。

examples.en: Our teacher showed us where to put a comma.
examples.zh: 老師示範給我們看逗號該放在哪裡。

examples.en: A comma separates items in a list.
examples.zh: 逗號用來分隔清單中的各個品項。

senses.zh: 控制器；管制員；財務主管

examples.en: He lost the game controller under the sofa.
examples.zh: 他把遊戲控制器弄丟在沙發底下了。

examples.en: The air traffic controller guided the plane to land.
examples.zh: 空中交通管制員引導飛機降落。

examples.en: The company's financial controller checks every report.
examples.zh: 公司的財務主管會審閱每一份報告。

examples.en: An apple is a countable thing, so you can say two apples.
examples.zh: 蘋果是可數的東西，所以可以說兩顆蘋果。

examples.en: Water is not countable, so we measure it in liters.
examples.zh: 水是不可數的，所以我們用公升來計量。

examples.en: The number of visitors is easily countable.
examples.zh: 訪客的人數很容易計算。

examples.en: The car dealer offered us a good price.
examples.zh: 汽車經銷商給了我們一個不錯的價格。

examples.en: My uncle is an antique dealer in Tainan.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是台南的古董商。

examples.en: The dealer handed each player five cards.
examples.zh: 發牌員發給每位玩家五張牌。

examples.en: The river deepens near the bridge, so swimmers should be careful.
examples.zh: 河水在橋附近變深，因此游泳的人應該小心。

examples.en: Working together on the school play helped deepen their friendship.
examples.zh: 一起參與校園戲劇的工作，使他們的友誼更加深厚。

examples.en: The crisis deepened as prices kept rising.
examples.zh: 隨著物價持續上漲，危機也加深了。

senses.zh: 表情豐富的；有表現力的

examples.en: She has big, expressive eyes that reveal how she feels.
examples.zh: 她有一雙大而富有表情的眼睛，能流露出她的感受。

examples.en: The dancer gave an expressive performance that moved the entire audience.
examples.zh: 那位舞者的表演很有感染力，感動了全場觀眾。

examples.en: My dog has a very expressive face.
examples.zh: 我的狗臉上的表情非常豐富。

examples.en: The child was fearful of the dark.
examples.zh: 那個孩子很怕黑。

examples.en: She felt fearful before her first speech.
examples.zh: 她在第一次演講前感到害怕。

examples.en: Many people are fearful about losing their jobs.
examples.zh: 許多人擔心會失業。

examples.en: A grasshopper jumped onto the leaf and began to eat.
examples.zh: 一隻蚱蜢跳到葉子上，開始進食。

examples.en: We saw a green grasshopper in the garden.
examples.zh: 我們在花園裡看到一隻綠色的蚱蜢。

examples.en: The grasshopper can jump far with its strong legs.
examples.zh: 蚱蜢可以靠強壯的後腿跳得很遠。

examples.en: The children played on the grassy hill.
examples.zh: 孩子們在長滿草的山坡上玩耍。

examples.en: We had a picnic on a grassy field.
examples.zh: 我們在一片草地上野餐。

examples.en: A grassy path led to the small lake.
examples.zh: 一條長滿草的小徑通往那座小湖。

senses.zh: 令人厭惡的；充滿惡意的

examples.en: He said some hateful things to his sister.
examples.zh: 他對妹妹說了一些很傷人的話。

examples.en: Bullying is a hateful act that can seriously hurt others.
examples.zh: 霸凌是令人厭惡的行為，可能會嚴重傷害他人。

examples.en: She could not forget the hateful message.
examples.zh: 她無法忘記那則充滿惡意的訊息。

examples.en: Each ticket holder can bring one guest.
examples.zh: 每位持票人可以帶一位客人。

examples.en: I bought a new pen holder for my desk.
examples.zh: 我為書桌買了一個新的筆筒。

examples.en: The cup holder in the car is too small.
examples.zh: 車上的杯架太小了。

examples.en: The little girl licked a red lollipop.
examples.zh: 小女孩舔著一支紅色棒棒糖。

examples.en: The dentist gave each kid a lollipop.
examples.zh: 牙醫給每個小孩一支棒棒糖。

examples.en: He bought a strawberry lollipop at the store.
examples.zh: 他在商店買了一支草莓口味的棒棒糖。

examples.en: My father wears a necktie to work.
examples.zh: 我父親打著領帶去上班。

examples.en: He bought a blue necktie for the interview.
examples.zh: 他為了面試買了一條藍色領帶。

examples.en: Can you help me tie my necktie?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我打領帶嗎？

senses.zh: 持續進行的；仍在進行的

examples.en: The ongoing road work causes traffic jams.
examples.zh: 持續進行的道路施工造成塞車。

examples.en: We have an ongoing project with a big client.
examples.zh: 我們正在和一位大客戶合作進行專案。

examples.en: The police said the investigation is ongoing.
examples.zh: 警方表示調查仍在進行中。

senses.zh: 愛玩的；頑皮的；開玩笑的

examples.en: The playful puppy ran around the yard.
examples.zh: 那隻頑皮的小狗在院子裡跑來跑去。

examples.en: She gave her brother a playful push.
examples.zh: 她開玩笑地推了弟弟一下。

examples.en: He is in a playful mood this morning.
examples.zh: 他今天早上玩興很濃。

examples.en: The museum has a beautiful collection of porcelain.
examples.zh: 這座博物館有一批精美的瓷器收藏。

examples.en: This cup is made of fine white porcelain.
examples.zh: 這個杯子是用上等的白瓷做成的。

examples.en: She wrapped each piece of porcelain carefully before moving house.
examples.zh: 她搬家前仔細包好每一件瓷器。

examples.en: The old house had a queer smell.
examples.zh: 那棟老房子有股怪味。

examples.en: He gave me a queer look when I asked.
examples.zh: 我開口問的時候，他古怪地看了我一眼。

examples.en: The library displayed books by queer writers during its diversity event.
examples.zh: 圖書館在多元文化活動期間展示酷兒作家的書籍。

examples.en: Use a damp rag to clean the window.
examples.zh: 用濕抹布擦窗戶。

examples.en: He wiped his hands on an old rag.
examples.zh: 他在一塊舊布上擦了擦手。

examples.en: The mechanic kept a rag in his pocket.
examples.zh: 那位技師口袋裡放著一塊抹布。

examples.en: I hope to visit Japan someday and explore its historic temples.
examples.zh: 我希望有一天能去日本，探索當地具有歷史意義的寺廟。

examples.en: Someday you will understand why I said that.
examples.zh: 有一天你會明白我為什麼那樣說。

examples.en: She dreams of opening her own bakery someday.
examples.zh: 她夢想著有一天能開一家自己的烘焙坊。

examples.en: The bread went stale after two days.
examples.zh: 麵包放了兩天就不新鮮了。

examples.en: The room smelled of stale air because the windows were closed.
examples.zh: 房間的窗戶都關著，空氣聞起來很悶濁。

examples.en: These jokes are stale; we have heard them before.
examples.zh: 這些笑話太老套了，我們以前聽過。

examples.en: The underlying cause of the problem is poor planning.
examples.zh: 問題的根本原因是規劃不佳。

examples.en: The doctor looked for an underlying illness.
examples.zh: 醫生找尋潛在的疾病。

examples.en: We need to understand the underlying idea first.
examples.zh: 我們得先理解其背後的基本概念。

examples.en: They plan to wed in the spring.
examples.zh: 他們打算在春天結婚。

examples.en: The couple wed in a small church.
examples.zh: 這對佳偶在一間小教堂裡結了婚。

examples.en: She wed her childhood friend last year.
examples.zh: 她去年嫁給了青梅竹馬的朋友。

examples.en: The guard was armed with a radio and a flashlight.
examples.zh: 警衛配備了一支無線電和一支手電筒。

examples.en: The soldiers returned to the armed forces base.
examples.zh: 士兵們回到了武裝部隊的基地。

examples.en: Armed with a map, we found the old temple.
examples.zh: 我們憑藉著一張地圖，找到了那間老廟。

examples.en: I need to change the bulb in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我得換掉廚房的燈泡。

examples.en: Plant the tulip bulbs in the fall.
examples.zh: 鬱金香的鱗莖要在秋天種下。

examples.en: The bulb burned out suddenly last night.
examples.zh: 這個燈泡昨晚突然燒壞了。

examples.en: The school keeps student records in a database.
examples.zh: 學校把學生的資料存在資料庫裡。

examples.en: She searched the database for the missing file.
examples.zh: 她在資料庫裡搜尋遺失的檔案。

examples.en: Our company is building a new customer database.
examples.zh: 我們公司正在建立新的客戶資料庫。

examples.en: My house is farther from school than yours.
examples.zh: 我家離學校比你家更遠。

examples.en: We walked farther along the beach to find a quiet spot.
examples.zh: 我們沿著海灘走得更遠，想找一個安靜的地方。

examples.en: She moved farther away from the stage.
examples.zh: 她往離舞台更遠的地方移動。

examples.en: The farther shore was hard to see.
examples.zh: 更遠的那一岸很難看清楚。

examples.en: Go to the farther end of the hall.
examples.zh: 請走到走廊較遠的那一端。

examples.en: The farther station is about ten minutes away.
examples.zh: 較遠的那個車站大約要十分鐘。

examples.en: The class is mostly girls this year.
examples.zh: 今年班上大部分是女生。

examples.en: We mostly eat rice for dinner, but sometimes we have noodles.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐大多吃米飯，但有時會吃麵。

examples.en: The park was mostly empty on Monday morning.
examples.zh: 週一早上，公園幾乎沒什麼人。

examples.en: It is freezing outside, so wear a coat.
examples.zh: 外面冷得要命，所以要穿外套。

examples.en: The water in the lake was freezing.
examples.zh: 湖裡的水冷得刺骨。

examples.en: I was freezing after waiting at the bus stop for an hour.
examples.zh: 我在公車站牌等了一個小時，冷得要命。

examples.en: The temperature fell below freezing last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚氣溫降到了冰點以下。

examples.en: Freezing can change the taste of some foods.
examples.zh: 冷凍可能會改變某些食物的味道。

examples.en: The pipes broke because of freezing during the unusually cold winter.
examples.zh: 在那個異常寒冷的冬天，水管因結冰而破裂。

examples.en: We were touched by her goodness when she helped our family.
examples.zh: 她幫助我們一家人時，我們被她的善良感動。

examples.en: The soup is full of healthy goodness.
examples.zh: 這碗湯充滿了健康的營養。

examples.en: He believes in the goodness of people.
examples.zh: 他相信人性本善。

examples.en: Goodness, I forgot my wallet and cannot pay for lunch!
examples.zh: 天啊，我忘了帶錢包，沒辦法付午餐錢！

examples.en: Goodness, it is already ten o'clock, and I haven't finished my homework!
examples.zh: 天啊，已經十點了，我還沒寫完功課！

examples.en: My goodness, you have grown so tall!
examples.zh: 我的天啊，你長這麼高了！

examples.en: It is important to be kind to oneself.
examples.zh: 對自己好是很重要的。

examples.en: One should take care of oneself when sick.
examples.zh: 生病時要好好照顧自己。

examples.en: It is hard to teach oneself a new language.
examples.zh: 自學一種新語言是很難的。

examples.en: The children built a snowman in the front yard.
examples.zh: 孩子們在前院堆了一個雪人。

examples.en: We gave the snowman a red scarf and two buttons for eyes.
examples.zh: 我們給雪人圍上紅色圍巾，還用兩顆鈕扣當眼睛。

examples.en: The snowman began to melt when the sun came out.
examples.zh: 太陽出來後，雪人開始融化了。

examples.en: Our school has a strong softball team this year.
examples.zh: 我們學校今年有一支很強的壘球隊。

examples.en: She plays softball with her classmates every Friday afternoon.
examples.zh: 她每週五下午都和同學打壘球。

examples.en: He caught the softball and threw it to second base.
examples.zh: 他接住壘球，然後把球傳給二壘。

senses.zh: 他們的；她們的；牠們的（東西）

examples.en: Our house is small, but theirs is much bigger.
examples.zh: 我們的房子很小，但他們的大多了。

examples.en: I forgot my umbrella, so I borrowed theirs.
examples.zh: 我忘了帶傘，所以借了他們的。

examples.en: Is this table ours or theirs for the school fair?
examples.zh: 這張桌子在學校園遊會是給我們用的，還是給他們用的？

senses.zh: 被接受的；公認的；普遍認可的

examples.en: Credit cards are an accepted form of payment here.
examples.zh: 在這裡，信用卡是被接受的付款方式。

examples.en: It is an accepted rule that students must wear uniforms.
examples.zh: 學生必須穿制服是公認的規定。

examples.en: The accepted answer to the question is on page ten.
examples.zh: 這個問題的公認答案在第十頁。

examples.en: Winning the science contest was a great achievement for her.
examples.zh: 贏得科學競賽對她來說是很大的成就。

examples.en: The achievement of our goal took three years of hard work.
examples.zh: 我們花了三年的努力才達成目標。

examples.en: His academic achievement improved after he started studying every night.
examples.zh: 他開始每晚讀書後，學業表現進步了。

examples.en: An adjective, such as big or happy, describes a noun.
examples.zh: 像 big 或 happy 這樣的形容詞用來描述名詞。

examples.en: Please underline the adjective in each sentence.
examples.zh: 請在每個句子中把形容詞畫上底線。

examples.en: The word quick is an adjective in this sentence.
examples.zh: 在這個句子中，quick 這個字是形容詞。

examples.en: My aged grandfather still walks in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我年邁的祖父每天早上仍在公園散步。

examples.en: The club is open to children aged ten to twelve.
examples.zh: 這個社團開放給十到十二歲的孩子。

examples.en: This shop sells aged cheese from several countries.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自多個國家的陳年起司。

examples.en: The two companies signed an agreement last week.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司上週簽了一份協議。

examples.en: We reached an agreement about where to go for the trip.
examples.zh: 我們就旅行要去哪裡達成了共識。

examples.en: There is no agreement among the students about the party date.
examples.zh: 學生們對派對日期沒有共識。

examples.en: The air-conditioned library is a cool place to study in summer.
examples.zh: 有冷氣的圖書館是夏天讀書的涼爽好地方。

examples.en: We stayed in an air-conditioned room during the heat wave.
examples.zh: 熱浪來襲時，我們待在有冷氣的房間裡。

examples.en: Is the bus air-conditioned, or should I bring a fan?
examples.zh: 這輛公車有冷氣嗎？還是我該帶一把扇子？

examples.en: Please send the package by airmail so it arrives sooner.
examples.zh: 請用航空郵寄這個包裹，這樣會比較快到。

examples.en: The airmail from Japan arrived in only four days.
examples.zh: 從日本寄來的航空郵件只花了四天就到了。

examples.en: She put an airmail sticker on the envelope.
examples.zh: 她在信封上貼了一張航空郵件標籤。

examples.en: Soda cans are usually made of aluminium.
examples.zh: 汽水罐通常是用鋁做的。

examples.en: Aluminium is light, so it is used to make airplanes.
examples.zh: 鋁很輕，所以被用來製造飛機。

examples.en: Please put the used aluminium in the recycling bin.
examples.zh: 請把用過的鋁製品放進回收桶。

examples.en: The clown made the children laugh with amusement.
examples.zh: 小丑逗得孩子們開心大笑。

examples.en: Our family went to the amusement park on Sunday.
examples.zh: 我們全家星期日去了遊樂園。

examples.en: He read comic books for amusement during the long trip.
examples.zh: 漫長的旅途中，他看漫畫書來消遣。

examples.en: The principal made an announcement about the school trip.
examples.zh: 校長宣布了關於校外教學的事。

examples.en: Please listen to the announcement at the train station.
examples.zh: 請注意聽車站的廣播通知。

examples.en: The company will make a big announcement next Monday.
examples.zh: 公司下週一將發布一項重要消息。

examples.en: The radio announcer read the weather report at seven.
examples.zh: 廣播員在七點播報了天氣預報。

examples.en: A stadium announcer told the crowd about the schedule change.
examples.zh: 體育場的播報員向群眾說明了時間表的更動。

examples.en: My uncle works as a TV announcer in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在台北擔任電視播報員。

examples.en: I downloaded a new app to learn English words.
examples.zh: 我下載了一個新的應用程式來學英文單字。

examples.en: This app shows when the next bus will arrive.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式會顯示下一班公車何時到。

examples.en: Many students use a study app on their tablets.
examples.zh: 很多學生會在平板電腦上使用學習應用程式。

examples.en: I have a dentist appointment at three o'clock.
examples.zh: 我三點有牙醫的預約。

examples.en: Please make an appointment before you visit the office.
examples.zh: 來辦公室之前，請先預約。

examples.en: The appointment of the new manager was announced yesterday.
examples.zh: 新任經理的任命昨天公布了。

examples.en: My brother and I had an argument about the TV.
examples.zh: 我哥哥和我為了電視吵了一架。

examples.en: Her argument for a longer lunch break was very clear.
examples.zh: 她主張延長午休時間的論點非常清楚。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to support each argument with facts.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們用事實來支持每一個論點。

examples.en: We made an arrangement to meet at the station at noon.
examples.zh: 我們約好中午在車站碰面。

examples.en: The flower arrangement on the table looks beautiful.
examples.zh: 桌上的插花擺設看起來很漂亮。

examples.en: Travel arrangements for the school trip are almost complete.
examples.zh: 校外教學的行程安排差不多完成了。

examples.en: The hospital has an auxiliary power system for emergencies.
examples.zh: 醫院有一套緊急時使用的備用電力系統。

examples.en: An auxiliary verb such as do or have helps the main verb.
examples.zh: 像 do 或 have 這樣的助動詞可以輔助主要動詞。

examples.en: The school added auxiliary classrooms for the new students.
examples.zh: 學校為新生增設了附屬教室。

examples.en: He used an ax to cut the firewood.
examples.zh: 他用斧頭劈柴。

examples.en: The camper kept a sharp ax in his backpack.
examples.zh: 那位露營者的背包裡放著一把鋒利的斧頭。

examples.en: Please put the ax back in the garage after you finish.
examples.zh: 用完之後，請把斧頭放回車庫。

examples.en: The city plans to ax the old bus route next year.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫明年裁撤那條老公車路線。

examples.en: The company decided to ax two hundred jobs to save money.
examples.zh: 公司決定削減兩百個職缺來節省開支。

examples.en: The TV station axed the show after only one season.
examples.zh: 電視台只播了一季就把那個節目砍掉了。

examples.en: He likes to wear baggy jeans and a big sweater.
examples.zh: 他喜歡穿寬鬆的牛仔褲和大毛衣。

examples.en: My old T-shirt is baggy after many washes.
examples.zh: 我的舊T恤洗了很多次後變得鬆垮垮的。

examples.en: The baggy coat kept her warm on the cold morning.
examples.zh: 那件寬鬆的外套讓她在寒冷的早晨很溫暖。

examples.en: Can you put a band-aid on my knee?
examples.zh: 你可以幫我的膝蓋貼一片OK繃嗎？

examples.en: She keeps a box of band-aids in her school bag.
examples.zh: 她在書包裡放了一盒OK繃。

examples.en: The nurse covered the cut with a small band-aid.
examples.zh: 護理師用一片小OK繃蓋住了傷口。

examples.en: My aunt has worked in banking for ten years.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在銀行業工作了十年。

examples.en: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills at home.
examples.zh: 網路銀行讓在家繳帳單變得很容易。

examples.en: The bank offers banking services from eight to five.
examples.zh: 這間銀行從八點到五點提供銀行業務服務。

examples.en: My dad gets a haircut at the barbershop every month.
examples.zh: 我爸爸每個月都去理髮店剪頭髮。

examples.en: There is a small barbershop next to the bookstore.
examples.zh: 書店旁邊有一家小小的理髮店。

examples.en: We waited at the barbershop until it was our turn.
examples.zh: 我們在理髮店等到輪到我們為止。

examples.en: The ancient temple was built around 500 BC.
examples.zh: 這座古老的神殿約在西元前五百年建成。

examples.en: Our history teacher said the city was founded in 753 BC.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師說，這座城市創建於西元前七五三年。

examples.en: The museum has coins that date back to 300 BC.
examples.zh: 博物館收藏了年代可追溯至西元前三百年的錢幣。

examples.en: The bird carried a worm in its beak.
examples.zh: 那隻鳥的嘴裡叼著一條蟲。

examples.en: An eagle has a strong, curved beak.
examples.zh: 老鷹有一個強而有力的彎曲鳥喙。

examples.en: The baby duck opened its small beak to ask for food.
examples.zh: 小鴨張開小小的嘴巴討食物吃。

examples.en: Bedtime for the kids is nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 孩子們的就寢時間是九點。

examples.en: Mom reads a story to my little sister at bedtime.
examples.zh: 媽媽在睡前讀故事給我妹妹聽。

examples.en: It is almost bedtime, so please turn off the TV.
examples.zh: 快到就寢時間了，請把電視關掉。

examples.en: His excuse for being late was not believable.
examples.zh: 他遲到的藉口不太可信。

examples.en: The actor made the character very believable.
examples.zh: 那位演員讓這個角色顯得非常真實可信。

examples.en: It is hard to find a believable answer to this question.
examples.zh: 很難為這個問題找到令人信服的答案。

examples.en: The baby laughed and patted his round belly.
examples.zh: 寶寶笑著拍拍他圓圓的肚子。

examples.en: I have a pain in my belly after eating too fast.
examples.zh: 我吃得太快，現在肚子痛。

examples.en: The cat lay on its back to show its soft belly.
examples.zh: 那隻貓仰躺著，露出柔軟的肚子。

examples.en: She keeps a small Bible beside her bed.
examples.zh: 她在床旁放著一本小聖經。

examples.en: This Bible has been translated into many languages.
examples.zh: 這本聖經已被譯成多種語言。

examples.en: That cookbook is the bible for every beginner in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 那本食譜是每位廚房新手的權威指南。

examples.en: We played bingo at the class party.
examples.zh: 我們在班上的派對玩了賓果遊戲。

examples.en: Grandma goes to a bingo game every Thursday night.
examples.zh: 奶奶每個星期四晚上都去玩賓果。

examples.en: He needs only one more number to win at bingo.
examples.zh: 他只差一個號碼就能在賓果遊戲中獲勝。

examples.en: Bingo! That is the answer I was looking for.
examples.zh: 答對了！這正是我在找的答案。

examples.en: Bingo! You guessed my age correctly on your first try.
examples.zh: 答對了！你第一次就猜中了我的年紀。

examples.en: Bingo, we found the missing key under the sofa.
examples.zh: 找到了，我們在沙發底下找到了不見的鑰匙。

examples.en: The little girl has blonde hair and blue eyes.
examples.zh: 那個小女孩有一頭金髮和一雙藍眼睛。

examples.en: He dyed his hair blonde for the school play.
examples.zh: 他為了學校的話劇把頭髮染成金色。

examples.en: My sister was blonde as a child, but her hair turned brown.
examples.zh: 我姊姊小時候是金髮，後來頭髮變成了棕色。

examples.en: The stray dog was thin and bony.
examples.zh: 那隻流浪狗很瘦，骨頭明顯可見。

examples.en: He has long, bony fingers that are good for playing the piano.
examples.zh: 他的手指修長、骨節分明，很適合彈鋼琴。

examples.en: This fish is too bony for small children to eat.
examples.zh: 這種魚刺太多，小孩子不適合吃。

examples.en: I made a hotel booking for our trip to Tainan.
examples.zh: 我為我們的台南之旅訂了旅館。

examples.en: The restaurant is popular, so an early booking is recommended.
examples.zh: 這家餐廳很受歡迎，建議提早預訂。

examples.en: Please check your booking details in the email.
examples.zh: 請查看電子郵件中的預訂資料。

examples.en: There is a tall bookshelf next to my desk.
examples.zh: 我的書桌旁邊有一個高高的書架。

examples.en: She put the new dictionary on the top shelf of the bookshelf.
examples.zh: 她把新字典放在書架的最上層。

examples.en: Dad built a wooden bookshelf for the living room.
examples.zh: 爸爸為客廳做了一個木頭書櫃。

examples.en: Her boyfriend gave her flowers on her birthday.
examples.zh: 她的男朋友在她生日那天送了她花。

examples.en: My sister is going to a movie with her boyfriend.
examples.zh: 我姊姊要和她的男朋友去看電影。
