examples.en: Have you met Anna's new boyfriend yet?
examples.zh: 你見過安娜的新男朋友了嗎？

examples.en: She bought a new bra at the department store.
examples.zh: 她在百貨公司買了一件新胸罩。

examples.en: Please wash the bra by hand to keep its shape.
examples.zh: 請用手洗胸罩，才能維持它的形狀。

examples.en: The shop sells a sports bra in many sizes.
examples.zh: 這家店販售多種尺寸的運動內衣。

examples.en: He got a brand-new bike for his birthday.
examples.zh: 他生日時得到一輛全新的腳踏車。

examples.en: The school opened a brand-new gym last month.
examples.zh: 學校上個月啟用了一座全新的體育館。

examples.en: My phone is brand-new, so I don't want to drop it.
examples.zh: 我的手機是全新的，所以我不想摔到它。

examples.en: Mom baked a pan of brownies for the class party.
examples.zh: 媽媽為班上的派對烤好了一盤布朗尼。

examples.en: I ate a warm brownie with vanilla ice cream.
examples.zh: 我吃了一塊搭配香草冰淇淋的熱布朗尼。

examples.en: Would you like a brownie with your coffee?
examples.zh: 你想在咖啡之外再來一塊布朗尼嗎？

examples.en: Capitalism is an economic system based on private business.
examples.zh: 資本主義是以私人企業為基礎的經濟制度。

examples.en: The teacher explained how capitalism developed in Europe.
examples.zh: 老師說明了資本主義在歐洲是如何發展起來的。

examples.en: Many countries in the world follow a form of capitalism.
examples.zh: 世界上許多國家採行某種形式的資本主義。

examples.en: She looked through the furniture catalog for a new sofa.
examples.zh: 她翻閱家具型錄想找一張新沙發。

examples.en: The library catalog is on the computer near the door.
examples.zh: 圖書館的目錄在門邊的電腦上。

examples.en: The shop mails a new catalog to customers every spring.
examples.zh: 這家店每年春天都會寄新型錄給顧客。

examples.en: The librarian will catalog all the new books this week.
examples.zh: 圖書館員這週會為所有新書編目。

examples.en: Volunteers cataloged the old photos in the museum.
examples.zh: 志工為博物館裡的舊照片登記造冊。

examples.en: We need to catalog every item before the sale.
examples.zh: 販售前，我們得把每件物品都登記造冊。

examples.en: The weather in spring is very changeable.
examples.zh: 春天的天氣非常多變。

examples.en: His mood is changeable, so it is hard to guess.
examples.zh: 他的心情多變，所以很難猜。

examples.en: The schedule is changeable if the teacher is busy.
examples.zh: 如果老師有事，這個時間表是可以更動的。

examples.en: Check-in at the hotel starts at three o'clock.
examples.zh: 旅館的入住登記從三點開始。

examples.en: The airline's check-in desk is on the second floor.
examples.zh: 航空公司的劃位櫃檯在二樓。

examples.en: Online check-in saves time before the flight.
examples.zh: 線上報到可以在搭機前節省時間。

examples.en: There was a long line at the checkout in the supermarket.
examples.zh: 超市的結帳櫃檯大排長龍。

examples.en: Checkout at the hotel is at eleven o'clock.
examples.zh: 旅館的退房時間是十一點。

examples.en: Click the checkout button to pay for your order.
examples.zh: 請按結帳鈕來付款。

examples.en: The hen is watching over her little chicks.
examples.zh: 母雞照看著牠的小雞。

examples.en: A baby chick came out of the egg this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一隻小雞從蛋裡孵出來了。

examples.en: The children fed the chicks on the farm.
examples.zh: 孩子們在農場餵小雞。

examples.en: My aunt took a class to learn about childbirth.
examples.zh: 我阿姨去上了關於生產的課程。

examples.en: Childbirth can take many hours for a first-time mother.
examples.zh: 對第一次生產的媽媽來說，分娩可能要花很多個小時。

examples.en: The hospital has a special room for childbirth.
examples.zh: 這家醫院有專門的產房。

examples.en: My neighbor is a Christian and goes to church every Sunday.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居是基督徒，每個星期天都會去教會。

examples.en: The school was started by a group of Christians in 1950.
examples.zh: 這所學校是一群基督徒在一九五○年創辦的。

examples.en: Many Christians gather to celebrate on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 許多基督徒在平安夜聚會慶祝。

examples.en: They held a Christian wedding in a small chapel.
examples.zh: 他們在一間小教堂舉行了基督教婚禮。

examples.en: She attends a Christian school near her home.
examples.zh: 她就讀家附近的一所基督教學校。

examples.en: The Christian holiday of Easter is celebrated in spring.
examples.zh: 基督教的復活節在春天慶祝。

senses.zh: 登山者；攀岩者；攀緣植物

examples.en: The climber reached the top of the mountain at noon.
examples.zh: 那位登山者在中午抵達山頂。

examples.en: A young climber practiced on the wall at the gym.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的攀岩者在健身房的岩壁上練習。

examples.en: This climber grows quickly and covers the fence with green leaves.
examples.zh: 這種攀緣植物長得很快，會用綠葉覆蓋整道圍籬。

examples.en: She drew a picture with colored pencils.
examples.zh: 她用彩色鉛筆畫了一幅圖。

examples.en: The shop sells colored paper in many bright shades.
examples.zh: 這家店賣各種鮮豔顏色的彩色紙。

examples.en: The kids threw colored balloons into the air.
examples.zh: 孩子們把彩色氣球拋向空中。

examples.en: We are busy preparing for the coming holiday.
examples.zh: 我們正忙著為即將到來的假期做準備。

examples.en: The coming week will be full of exams.
examples.zh: 接下來這個星期考試會很多。

examples.en: I'm looking forward to the coming school year.
examples.zh: 我很期待即將到來的新學年。

examples.en: The coming of spring brings warm weather.
examples.zh: 春天的來臨帶來溫暖的天氣。

examples.en: Everyone was excited about the coming of the new teacher.
examples.zh: 大家對新老師的到來都很興奮。

examples.en: The farmers welcomed the coming of the rain.
examples.zh: 農夫們歡迎雨水的到來。

examples.en: "And" and "but" are common examples of a conjunction.
examples.zh: 「and」和「but」是連接詞的常見例子。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to circle each conjunction in the sentence.
examples.zh: 老師要我們把句子裡的每個連接詞圈起來。

examples.en: The festival was held in conjunction with the school's anniversary.
examples.zh: 這場活動與學校的校慶一起舉辦。

senses.zh: 脆的；酥脆的；清爽的；乾脆俐落的

examples.en: I love the crisp skin on roast chicken.
examples.zh: 我喜歡烤雞那層酥脆的皮。

examples.en: The air was crisp and cold on the autumn morning.
examples.zh: 秋天的早晨，空氣清爽又寒冷。

examples.en: She gave a crisp answer to every question.
examples.zh: 她對每個問題都回答得很乾脆。

examples.en: He bought a bag of crisps at the kiosk.
examples.zh: 他在小販亭買了一包洋芋片。

examples.en: The kids ate crisps while watching the movie.
examples.zh: 孩子們邊看電影邊吃洋芋片。

examples.en: Do you want some crisps with your sandwich?
examples.zh: 你的三明治要配一些洋芋片嗎？

senses.zh: 十字路口；交叉口；轉捩點

examples.en: Turn left when you reach the crossroad.
examples.zh: 走到十字路口時請左轉。

examples.en: A small shop stands at the crossroad near my house.
examples.zh: 我家附近的十字路口有一間小店。

examples.en: She felt she was at a crossroads in her career.
examples.zh: 她覺得自己的職涯正處於轉捩點。

senses.zh: 騎自行車的人；單車騎士

examples.en: The cyclist stopped at the red light.
examples.zh: 那位單車騎士在紅燈前停了下來。

examples.en: Cyclists should always wear a helmet for safety.
examples.zh: 單車騎士為了安全，應該隨時戴安全帽。

examples.en: My uncle is a serious cyclist and rides every weekend.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是個認真的單車騎士，每個週末都會騎車。

examples.en: Damn, I left my keys at home again.
examples.zh: 可惡，我又把鑰匙忘在家裡了。

examples.en: Oh damn, the bus just left without us.
examples.zh: 糟了，公車剛剛沒等我們就開走了。

examples.en: Damn, we missed the last train back to town.
examples.zh: 可惡，我們錯過了回鎮上的最後一班火車。

examples.en: This damn printer is jammed again, so I cannot print the report.
examples.zh: 這台該死的印表機又卡紙了，所以我無法列印報告。

examples.en: I can't find my damn phone anywhere.
examples.zh: 我到處都找不到我那支該死的手機。

examples.en: The damn alarm didn't ring this morning.
examples.zh: 那個該死的鬧鐘今天早上沒響。

examples.en: The room is full of daylight in the morning.
examples.zh: 房間早上充滿了日光。

examples.en: We hope to reach the village before daylight fades.
examples.zh: 我們希望在天黑前抵達村莊。

examples.en: The thief was caught in broad daylight.
examples.zh: 小偷在光天化日之下被抓到。

examples.en: Please delete the old files from your computer.
examples.zh: 請把電腦裡的舊檔案刪除。

examples.en: I accidentally deleted the photo I wanted to keep.
examples.zh: 我不小心把想留著的照片刪掉了。

examples.en: You can delete a message by pressing this button.
examples.zh: 按這個按鈕就能刪除訊息。

senses.zh: 要求高的；費力的；苛求的

examples.en: She has a very demanding job in a busy hospital.
examples.zh: 她在一間繁忙的醫院裡從事一份要求很高的工作。

examples.en: Our math teacher is strict and demanding.
examples.zh: 我們的數學老師嚴格又要求很高。

examples.en: Taking care of a baby can be physically demanding.
examples.zh: 照顧嬰兒可能相當耗費體力。

examples.en: Tom is a dependable friend who always helps us.
examples.zh: 湯姆是個可靠的朋友，總是幫助我們。

examples.en: We need a dependable car for the long trip.
examples.zh: 我們需要一輛可靠的車來進行這趟長途旅行。

examples.en: The company is looking for a dependable assistant.
examples.zh: 公司正在找一位值得信賴的助理。

examples.en: The guide gave us a detailed map of the city.
examples.zh: 導遊給了我們一張詳細的市區地圖。

examples.en: Please send me a detailed report by Friday.
examples.zh: 請在週五前寄給我一份詳細的報告。

examples.en: The artist made a detailed drawing of the old temple.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家畫了一幅古廟的精細畫作。

examples.en: The development of the new park took two years.
examples.zh: 這座新公園的開發花了兩年。

examples.en: Exercise is important for a child's healthy development.
examples.zh: 運動對孩子的健康成長很重要。

examples.en: We will tell you about any new development in the case.
examples.zh: 案件若有任何新情況，我們會通知你。

senses.zh: 盡心盡力的；忠誠的；全心投入的

examples.en: She is a devoted mother of three children.
examples.zh: 她是一位對三個孩子盡心盡力的母親。

examples.en: The dog was devoted to its owner.
examples.zh: 這隻狗對牠的主人非常忠誠。

examples.en: He is devoted to his work as a teacher.
examples.zh: 他全心投入教師這份工作。

examples.en: The students practiced a short dialog in English class.
examples.zh: 學生們在英文課練習了一段簡短的對話。

examples.en: A dialog box appeared on the screen.
examples.zh: 螢幕上跳出了一個對話框。

examples.en: The two leaders held a friendly dialog about trade.
examples.zh: 兩位領導人就貿易進行了友善的對談。

examples.en: A mobile phone number in Taiwan usually has ten digits.
examples.zh: 台灣的手機號碼通常有十位數。

examples.en: Please enter the last digit of your phone number.
examples.zh: 請輸入你電話號碼的最後一個數字。

examples.en: Each digit of the code must be correct.
examples.zh: 密碼中的每個數字都必須正確。

examples.en: The new station has an elevator for disabled passengers.
examples.zh: 新車站為身心障礙的乘客設有電梯。

examples.en: The alarm was disabled during the repair work.
examples.zh: 維修期間，警報器被停用了。

examples.en: This seat is for people who are disabled.
examples.zh: 這個座位是給身心障礙者坐的。

senses.zh: 弱勢的；處於不利地位的

examples.en: The charity helps disadvantaged children go to school.
examples.zh: 這個慈善團體協助弱勢兒童上學。

examples.en: Students from disadvantaged families can apply for aid.
examples.zh: 來自弱勢家庭的學生可以申請補助。

examples.en: She worked hard to support disadvantaged groups in her town.
examples.zh: 她努力幫助家鄉的弱勢族群。

senses.zh: 失望；令人失望的人或事

examples.en: He could not hide his disappointment when he lost.
examples.zh: 他輸了之後，無法掩飾自己的失望。

examples.en: The movie was a big disappointment to us.
examples.zh: 這部電影讓我們非常失望。

examples.en: To my disappointment, the store was already closed.
examples.zh: 令我失望的是，那家店已經關門了。

examples.en: She shook her head in disapproval when she heard the plan.
examples.zh: 她聽到這項計畫時搖頭表示不贊成。

examples.en: Her parents showed their disapproval of the plan.
examples.zh: 她的父母對這項計畫表示反對。

examples.en: The mayor's decision met with public disapproval.
examples.zh: 市長的決定遭到大眾的反對。

examples.en: Many customers expressed dissatisfaction with the service.
examples.zh: 許多顧客對服務表示不滿。

examples.en: His dissatisfaction with the job made him look for a new one.
examples.zh: 他對工作不滿，所以開始找新工作。

examples.en: There is growing dissatisfaction among the students.
examples.zh: 學生之間的不滿情緒越來越高。

examples.en: There was a lot of distrust between the two teams.
examples.zh: 這兩支隊伍之間有很深的不信任。

examples.en: Her distrust of strangers kept her safe.
examples.zh: 她對陌生人的戒心讓她保持安全。

examples.en: The scandal caused public distrust of the company.
examples.zh: 這起醜聞引起大眾對該公司的不信任。

examples.en: I distrust people who never tell the truth.
examples.zh: 我不信任從不說實話的人。

examples.en: Many shoppers distrust online reviews that offer only praise.
examples.zh: 許多購物者不信任那些只有讚美的網路評論。

examples.en: He began to distrust his partner after the mistake.
examples.zh: 出錯之後，他開始不信任他的夥伴。

examples.en: Are you dressed yet? We have to leave now.
examples.zh: 你衣服穿好了嗎？我們現在得出門了。

examples.en: She was dressed in a long red coat.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件紅色長大衣。

examples.en: The kids were dressed up as animals for the party.
examples.zh: 孩子們穿著動物裝扮去參加派對。

examples.en: A duckling followed its mother across the pond.
examples.zh: 一隻小鴨跟著媽媽游過池塘。

examples.en: The farmer raised a few ducklings in the yard.
examples.zh: 農夫在院子裡養了幾隻小鴨。

examples.en: The little duckling was covered in soft yellow feathers.
examples.zh: 那隻小鴨身上覆蓋著柔軟的黃色羽毛。

examples.en: Her monthly earnings are not high, but she saves a lot.
examples.zh: 她每月的收入不高，但存了很多錢。

examples.en: The company reported strong earnings this year.
examples.zh: 這家公司今年公布了亮眼的盈餘。

examples.en: He spends most of his earnings on books.
examples.zh: 他把大部分收入花在買書上。

examples.en: It is hard to find employment in a small town.
examples.zh: 在小鎮上很難找到工作。

examples.en: The company offers full-time employment to new graduates.
examples.zh: 這家公司提供應屆畢業生全職工作。

examples.en: Please fill in your employment history on the form.
examples.zh: 請在表格上填寫你的工作經歷。

examples.en: Thank you for your encouragement during the exam.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在考試期間的鼓勵。

examples.en: The coach gave the team words of encouragement.
examples.zh: 教練對全隊說了鼓勵的話。

examples.en: With her teacher's encouragement, she joined the contest.
examples.zh: 在老師的鼓勵下，她參加了比賽。

examples.en: Reading novels gives me great enjoyment after a busy day.
examples.zh: 忙碌一天後，閱讀小說帶給我很大的樂趣。

examples.en: The children shouted with enjoyment on the swings.
examples.zh: 孩子們在鞦韆上開心地大叫。

examples.en: She did the volunteer work for her own enjoyment.
examples.zh: 她做志工是為了自己的樂趣。

examples.en: The enlargement of the photo took only a few minutes.
examples.zh: 照片的放大只花了幾分鐘。

examples.en: The city plans an enlargement of the airport.
examples.zh: 市政府計畫擴建機場。

examples.en: She hung an enlargement of the picture on the wall.
examples.zh: 她把那張照片的放大版掛在牆上。

examples.en: The famous entertainer sang at the school festival.
examples.zh: 那位知名藝人在學校園遊會上唱歌。

examples.en: Street entertainers filled the square with music.
examples.zh: 街頭表演者讓廣場充滿了音樂。

examples.en: He dreams of becoming a TV entertainer.
examples.zh: 他夢想成為電視藝人。

examples.en: Movies are my favorite form of entertainment.
examples.zh: 電影是我最喜愛的娛樂方式。

examples.en: The hotel offers live entertainment every night.
examples.zh: 這間旅館每晚都有現場娛樂表演。

examples.en: The entertainment industry employs many young people.
examples.zh: 娛樂產業雇用了許多年輕人。

examples.en: The gym has new exercise equipment for its members.
examples.zh: 這間健身房有供會員使用的新運動器材。

examples.en: We checked all the camera equipment before the trip.
examples.zh: 出發旅行前，我們檢查了所有相機設備。

examples.en: The school bought some science equipment for the lab.
examples.zh: 學校為實驗室買了一些科學器材。

examples.en: The two plans are essentially the same.
examples.zh: 這兩個計畫基本上是一樣的。

examples.en: He is essentially a shy person, despite his confident appearance.
examples.zh: 儘管他看起來很有自信，但本質上是個害羞的人。

examples.en: The report is essentially finished, but a few details need checking.
examples.zh: 這份報告大致上完成了，但還有幾個細節需要檢查。

examples.en: This bag is strong enough for everyday use.
examples.zh: 這個包包夠堅固，可以日常使用。

examples.en: We learned some everyday English phrases in class.
examples.zh: 我們在課堂上學了一些日常英語用語。

examples.en: Traffic jams are part of everyday life in the city.
examples.zh: 塞車是都市日常生活的一部分。

examples.en: The train arrives at exactly nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 火車正好在九點整抵達。

examples.en: That is exactly what I wanted to say.
examples.zh: 那正是我想說的。

examples.en: "Exactly!" the teacher said with a smile.
examples.zh: 「沒錯！」老師笑著說。

examples.en: The kids jumped up and down with excitement.
examples.zh: 孩子們興奮得又蹦又跳。

examples.en: There was great excitement before the concert.
examples.zh: 演唱會開始前現場氣氛非常興奮。

examples.en: The trip was full of excitement for the students.
examples.zh: 這趟旅行對學生來說充滿了刺激。

examples.en: Our class went on an excursion to the science museum.
examples.zh: 我們班到科學博物館校外教學。

examples.en: The hotel offers a boat excursion to the island.
examples.zh: 這間旅館提供前往小島的乘船遊覽。

examples.en: They took a day excursion to the mountains.
examples.zh: 他們到山上做了一日遊。

examples.en: The explorer spent years studying the rain forest.
examples.zh: 這位探險家花了好幾年研究雨林。

examples.en: Early explorers sailed across the ocean in wooden ships.
examples.zh: 早期的探險家乘著木船橫渡海洋。

examples.en: My little brother wants to be an explorer when he grows up.
examples.zh: 我弟弟長大後想當探險家。

examples.en: Farming is an important job in this area.
examples.zh: 農業在這個地區是很重要的工作。

examples.en: Her grandparents earned a living by farming.
examples.zh: 她的祖父母靠務農維生。

examples.en: Modern farming uses many kinds of machines.
examples.zh: 現代農業使用許多種機器。

senses.zh: 有缺陷的；故障的；錯誤的

examples.en: The shop replaced my faulty phone for free.
examples.zh: 店家免費換掉了我有瑕疵的手機。

examples.en: A faulty wire caused the lights to go out.
examples.zh: 一條有問題的電線讓燈熄滅了。

examples.en: His faulty reasoning led to the wrong answer.
examples.zh: 他錯誤的推理導致答案有誤。

examples.en: Heavy rain caused flooding in several streets.
examples.zh: 大雨造成好幾條街道淹水。

examples.en: The town suffers from flooding every summer.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮每年夏天都受水患之苦。

examples.en: Flooding closed the road to the mountain village.
examples.zh: 淹水使通往山村的道路封閉了。

examples.en: She wiped the sweat from her forehead.
examples.zh: 她擦掉額頭上的汗水。

examples.en: The nurse put a hand on my forehead to check for a fever.
examples.zh: 護理師把手放在我的額頭上，檢查有沒有發燒。

examples.en: He hit his forehead on the low door.
examples.zh: 他的額頭撞到了低矮的門。

examples.en: No one could foresee the heavy rain that day.
examples.zh: 沒有人能預料到那天會下大雨。

examples.en: Experts foresee a rise in prices next year.
examples.zh: 專家預料明年物價會上漲。

examples.en: I did not foresee any problems with the plan.
examples.zh: 我沒有預見這項計畫會有任何問題。

examples.en: My grandfather is getting more forgetful with age.
examples.zh: 我爺爺隨著年紀增長越來越健忘。

examples.en: I am so forgetful that I often lose my keys.
examples.zh: 我很健忘，常常弄丟鑰匙。

examples.en: My forgetful classmate keeps a list of homework in her notebook.
examples.zh: 我那位健忘的同學會在筆記本上列出作業清單。

examples.en: Please put the milk back in the fridge.
examples.zh: 請把牛奶放回冰箱。

examples.en: There is nothing to eat in the fridge.
examples.zh: 冰箱裡沒有東西可以吃。

examples.en: We bought a new fridge for the kitchen.
examples.zh: 我們為廚房買了一台新冰箱。

examples.en: It was a frosty morning, so we wore thick coats.
examples.zh: 那是個結霜的早晨，所以我們穿了厚外套。

examples.en: The grass was white and frosty when we left the house.
examples.zh: 我們離開屋子時，草地白茫茫地結了一層霜。

examples.en: She gave him a frosty look and walked away.
examples.zh: 她冷冷地看了他一眼就走開了。

examples.en: The lake was frozen all winter, so boats could not cross it.
examples.zh: 這座湖整個冬天都結著冰，因此船隻無法橫越湖面。

examples.en: I bought some frozen vegetables at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 我在超市買了一些冷凍蔬菜。

examples.en: My hands are frozen after the long walk.
examples.zh: 走了那麼久，我的雙手都凍僵了。

examples.en: She has a full-time job at a bank.
examples.zh: 她在銀行有一份全職工作。

examples.en: He is a full-time student at the university.
examples.zh: 他是這所大學的全時學生。

examples.en: The shop needs two full-time workers to serve its customers.
examples.zh: 這家店需要兩名全職員工來服務顧客。

examples.en: She works full-time at the library near the train station.
examples.zh: 她在火車站附近的圖書館全職工作。

examples.en: My mother studies full-time and works at night.
examples.zh: 我媽媽全時就讀，晚上還要工作。

examples.en: Are you going to teach full-time next year?
examples.zh: 你明年要全職教書嗎？

examples.en: The hotel is fully booked this weekend.
examples.zh: 這間旅館這個週末已經全部訂滿了。

examples.en: I fully understand your concern about the new school rules.
examples.zh: 我完全理解你對新校規的擔憂。

examples.en: The battery is fully charged now and ready for use.
examples.zh: 電池現在已經充飽了，可以使用了。

examples.en: The gambler lost all his money at the casino.
examples.zh: 那名賭徒在賭場輸光了所有的錢。

examples.en: Her uncle was a gambler and often owed money.
examples.zh: 她的叔叔是個賭徒，常常欠錢。

examples.en: A good investor is not a gambler.
examples.zh: 好的投資人不是賭徒。

examples.en: He took his girlfriend to the movies on Saturday.
examples.zh: 他星期六帶女朋友去看電影。

examples.en: My brother's girlfriend is very friendly to everyone she meets.
examples.zh: 我哥哥的女朋友對她遇到的每個人都非常友善。

examples.en: She went shopping with her girlfriend at the department store.
examples.zh: 她和女性友人一起到百貨公司逛街。

examples.en: In the story, the goddess of love helps the young hero.
examples.zh: 在故事裡，愛神幫助了年輕的英雄。

examples.en: The ancient Greeks built a temple for the goddess.
examples.zh: 古希臘人為這位女神蓋了一座神殿。

examples.en: The singer was called a goddess by her fans.
examples.zh: 這位歌手被粉絲稱為女神。

examples.en: Her first grandchild was born in the spring.
examples.zh: 她的第一個孫輩在春天出生。

examples.en: Grandma bakes cookies whenever her grandchild comes to visit.
examples.zh: 只要她的孫輩來訪，阿嬤就會烤餅乾。

examples.en: Each grandchild received a red envelope at the New Year dinner.
examples.zh: 每位孫輩在新年晚餐上都收到一個紅包。

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small village near the sea.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在海邊的一個小村莊。

examples.en: A grandparent often helps take care of young children.
examples.zh: 祖父母常常幫忙照顧年幼的孩子。

examples.en: On weekends, we visit our grandparents and have lunch together.
examples.zh: 週末我們會去探望祖父母，一起吃午餐。

examples.en: Your help has greatly improved our project.
examples.zh: 你的幫忙大大改善了我們的專案。

examples.en: The price of rice has greatly increased this year.
examples.zh: 今年米價大幅上漲。

examples.en: We greatly appreciate your quick reply to our email.
examples.zh: 我們非常感謝你迅速回覆我們的電子郵件。

examples.en: Children must be with a grown-up when they enter the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子進入泳池時必須有大人陪同。

examples.en: The grown-ups talked in the kitchen while the kids played outside.
examples.zh: 大人們在廚房聊天，孩子們則在外面玩。

examples.en: Ask a grown-up for help if you cannot find the exit.
examples.zh: 如果找不到出口，就請大人幫忙。

examples.en: She has two grown-up sons who live abroad.
examples.zh: 她有兩個已成年的兒子住在國外。

examples.en: He is only twelve, but he acts very grown-up.
examples.zh: 他才十二歲，但表現得非常成熟。

examples.en: It is time to make a grown-up decision about your future.
examples.zh: 是時候為你的未來做一個成熟的決定了。

examples.en: We stopped for water halfway up the mountain.
examples.zh: 我們爬到半山腰時停下來喝水。

examples.en: The bus broke down halfway between the two cities.
examples.zh: 公車在兩座城市的中途拋錨了。

examples.en: She left the meeting halfway through the presentation.
examples.zh: 她在簡報進行到一半時離開了會議。

examples.en: The halfway point of the hike is a small temple.
examples.zh: 健行路線的中間點是一座小廟。

examples.en: We reached the halfway mark of the exam in thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 我們花了三十分鐘就寫到考試的一半。

examples.en: The runners cheered when they passed the halfway line.
examples.zh: 跑者們越過中間線時歡呼起來。

examples.en: She put her wallet and keys in her handbag.
examples.zh: 她把錢包和鑰匙放進手提包裡。

examples.en: This leather handbag is on sale at the department store.
examples.zh: 這個皮製手提包在百貨公司特價中。

examples.en: A small umbrella fits easily inside her handbag.
examples.zh: 一把小傘很容易就放進她的手提包裡。

examples.en: My sister is a hardworking student who studies every night.
examples.zh: 我姊姊是個勤奮的學生，每晚都讀書。

examples.en: The company is looking for a hardworking assistant to join the team.
examples.zh: 公司正在找一位勤奮的助理加入團隊。

examples.en: Our hardworking neighbors cleaned the street after the festival.
examples.zh: 我們勤奮的鄰居們在慶典後打掃了街道。

examples.en: Returning the shoes without a receipt was a big hassle.
examples.zh: 沒有收據要退鞋子真是很麻煩。

examples.en: Taking the MRT saves us the hassle of finding a parking space.
examples.zh: 搭捷運讓我們省去找停車位的麻煩。

examples.en: Booking online is easy and without any hassle.
examples.zh: 線上訂位很簡單，一點也不麻煩。

examples.en: My parents keep hassling me about my grades.
examples.zh: 我爸媽一直為了成績煩我。

examples.en: Please don't hassle the clerk about the price; it is fixed.
examples.zh: 請不要為了價格去煩店員，這是固定價格。

examples.en: He felt hassled by the constant phone calls from the office.
examples.zh: 辦公室不斷打來的電話讓他覺得很煩。

examples.en: The headmaster gave a short speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在開幕典禮上發表了簡短的演說。

examples.en: Our headmaster greets students at the school gate every morning.
examples.zh: 我們的校長每天早上在校門口迎接學生。

examples.en: The parents asked the headmaster about the new school rules.
examples.zh: 家長們向校長詢問新的校規。

examples.en: I wear headphones on the MRT so I can listen to music.
examples.zh: 我在捷運上戴耳機聽音樂。

examples.en: These headphones are comfortable enough to wear all day.
examples.zh: 這副耳機舒適到可以整天戴著。

examples.en: Please use headphones in the library so you do not disturb others.
examples.zh: 請在圖書館使用耳機，以免打擾他人。

senses.zh: 頭戴式耳機；耳機麥克風

examples.en: The customer service agent wore a headset during the call.
examples.zh: 客服人員通話時戴著耳機麥克風。

examples.en: I need a new headset for my online English class.
examples.zh: 我需要一副新的耳機麥克風來上線上英語課。

examples.en: My headset has a built-in microphone, so I can join video meetings.
examples.zh: 我的頭戴式耳機有內建麥克風，所以可以參加視訊會議。

examples.en: She felt deep heartbreak when her best friend moved away.
examples.zh: 她最好的朋友搬走時，她感到非常心碎。

examples.en: The movie is about love and heartbreak in a small town.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述小鎮中的愛情與心碎。

examples.en: It took him months to recover from the heartbreak of the breakup.
examples.zh: 他花了好幾個月才從分手的傷痛中走出來。

senses.zh: 天堂般的；美妙的；天上的

examples.en: The cake tasted heavenly, and everyone asked for a second slice.
examples.zh: 這個蛋糕美味極了，每個人都想再吃一片。

examples.en: We spent a heavenly weekend at a hot spring hotel.
examples.zh: 我們在溫泉旅館度過了美好的週末。

examples.en: Astronomers study heavenly bodies such as stars and planets.
examples.zh: 天文學家研究恆星和行星等天體。

senses.zh: 隱藏的；隱蔽的；不為人知的

examples.en: We found a hidden path behind the old school building.
examples.zh: 我們在舊校舍後面發現了一條隱蔽的小路。

examples.en: There are no hidden fees when you buy tickets online.
examples.zh: 線上購票沒有任何隱藏費用。

examples.en: Her hidden talent for singing surprised the whole class.
examples.zh: 她不為人知的歌唱才能讓全班都嚇了一跳。

examples.en: Many people in Taipei live in a high-rise near the MRT station.
examples.zh: 許多台北人住在捷運站附近的高樓大廈裡。

examples.en: A new high-rise is being built across from our school.
examples.zh: 我們學校對面正在興建一棟新的高樓。

examples.en: From the top of the high-rise, we could see the whole city.
examples.zh: 從高樓頂端，我們可以看到整座城市。

examples.en: She works in a high-rise office building in the city center.
examples.zh: 她在市中心的一棟高層辦公大樓工作。

examples.en: The high-rise apartments along the river have great views.
examples.zh: 河岸旁的高樓公寓視野很棒。

examples.en: We stayed in a high-rise hotel with a view of the bay.
examples.zh: 我們住在一間能看到海灣的高樓飯店。

examples.en: Airport staff practice what to do if a hijacker appears on a plane.
examples.zh: 機場人員會演練飛機上出現劫機者時該怎麼做。

examples.en: The movie is about a pilot who talks to a hijacker.
examples.zh: 這部電影講的是一位和劫機者交談的機師。

examples.en: Police said the hijacker had surrendered without hurting anyone.
examples.zh: 警方表示劫機者已投降，沒有傷害任何人。

examples.en: The hikers stopped to rest by the stream.
examples.zh: 健行者們停下來在溪邊休息。

examples.en: A friendly hiker showed us the way to the top.
examples.zh: 一位親切的登山客為我們指了通往山頂的路。

examples.en: Experienced hikers carry plenty of water and a map.
examples.zh: 有經驗的健行者會帶足夠的水和一張地圖。

examples.en: Honestly, I did not understand the teacher's question.
examples.zh: 老實說，我沒聽懂老師的問題。

examples.en: She answered all the interview questions honestly.
examples.zh: 她誠實地回答了所有面試問題。

examples.en: He honestly believes that practice is the key to success.
examples.zh: 他真心相信練習是成功的關鍵。

examples.en: Hopefully, the rain will stop before the baseball game starts.
examples.zh: 希望雨能在棒球比賽開始前停。

examples.en: "Will you come tomorrow?" she asked hopefully.
examples.zh: 「你明天會來嗎？」她滿懷希望地問。

examples.en: We will hopefully arrive in Tainan before noon.
examples.zh: 我們希望能在中午前抵達台南。

examples.en: She missed two weeks of school because of a serious illness.
examples.zh: 她因為一場重病缺課了兩週。

examples.en: A good diet can help prevent illness.
examples.zh: 良好的飲食有助於預防疾病。

examples.en: The doctor said the illness was not contagious.
examples.zh: 醫生說這種疾病不會傳染。

examples.en: This hotel offers every imaginable service for its guests.
examples.zh: 這間飯店為旅客提供所有想得到的服務。

examples.en: It was the worst traffic jam imaginable.
examples.zh: 那是你所能想像最嚴重的塞車。

examples.en: It is hardly imaginable that a small shop could sell so many books in a day.
examples.zh: 很難想像一家小店一天能賣出這麼多書。

examples.en: Please call me immediately if you need any help.
examples.zh: 如果需要幫忙，請立刻打電話給我。

examples.en: The students stood up immediately when the teacher walked in.
examples.zh: 老師走進來時，學生們立刻起立。

examples.en: The coffee shop is immediately next to the bookstore.
examples.zh: 那家咖啡店就緊鄰書店。

senses.zh: 冷淡的；不帶個人情感的

examples.en: The email from the company sounded cold and impersonal.
examples.zh: 公司寄來的電子郵件讀起來冷淡又不帶感情。

examples.en: Big city hospitals can feel impersonal to new patients.
examples.zh: 大城市的醫院對新病患來說可能顯得冷冰冰的。

examples.en: Writers usually use an impersonal tone in formal reports.
examples.zh: 寫作者通常在正式報告中使用客觀中立的語氣。

examples.en: Your English has shown great improvement this semester.
examples.zh: 你的英文這學期進步很多。

examples.en: The city plans several improvements to the bus system.
examples.zh: 市府計畫對公車系統做幾項改善。

examples.en: There is still room for improvement in our service.
examples.zh: 我們的服務仍有改進的空間。

examples.en: Online shopping is becoming increasingly popular in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 網路購物在台灣越來越受歡迎。

examples.en: The weather grew increasingly cold as we climbed higher.
examples.zh: 我們爬得越高，天氣就越來越冷。

examples.en: She felt increasingly nervous before the speech.
examples.zh: 演講前她越來越緊張。

examples.en: India is a large country in South Asia.
examples.zh: 印度是南亞的一個大國。

examples.en: My cousin is planning a trip to India next spring.
examples.zh: 我的表哥計畫明年春天去印度旅行。

examples.en: Our teacher showed us a map of India in class.
examples.zh: 老師在課堂上給我們看了印度的地圖。

examples.en: Readers use clues in the story to make an inference.
examples.zh: 讀者利用故事中的線索做出推論。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to draw an inference from the chart.
examples.zh: 老師要我們從圖表中得出一個推論。

examples.en: Scientists base each inference on careful observation.
examples.zh: 科學家根據仔細的觀察做出每項推論。

examples.en: The party was informal, so everyone wore jeans.
examples.zh: 這場派對很隨興，所以大家都穿牛仔褲。

examples.en: This email sounds too informal for a job application.
examples.zh: 這封電子郵件對求職來說聽起來太隨便了。

examples.en: We had an informal chat with the manager over lunch.
examples.zh: 我們在午餐時和經理進行了一場輕鬆的閒聊。

senses.zh: 消息靈通的；知情的；有充分依據的

examples.en: She is well informed about current events.
examples.zh: 她對時事瞭若指掌。

examples.en: Make an informed choice before you buy a new phone.
examples.zh: 買新手機之前，先做出有根據的選擇。

examples.en: Parents were kept informed about changes to the school schedule.
examples.zh: 家長們隨時獲知學校課表的變動。

examples.en: Buying a house is usually the biggest investment in a person's life.
examples.zh: 買房子通常是一個人一生中最大的一筆投資。

examples.en: The company made a large investment in new software last year.
examples.zh: 這家公司去年在新軟體上投入了大筆資金。

examples.en: Learning English is a good investment in your future.
examples.zh: 學英文是對你未來的一項好投資。

examples.en: Investors were pleased with the company's new profit report.
examples.zh: 投資人對公司新的獲利報告感到滿意。

examples.en: A young investor should learn about risk first.
examples.zh: 年輕的投資人應該先了解風險。

examples.en: The startup is looking for an investor to support its new app.
examples.zh: 這家新創公司正在尋找投資人來支持它的新應用程式。

examples.en: Air is invisible, but we can feel it when the wind blows.
examples.zh: 空氣看不見，但風吹時我們能感覺到它。

examples.en: In the story, a magic cloak makes the boy invisible.
examples.zh: 故事裡，一件魔法斗篷讓男孩隱形了。

examples.en: Tiny germs are invisible to the human eye.
examples.zh: 微小的細菌是人眼看不見的。

examples.en: The bus driver kindly helped the old man find his seat.
examples.zh: 公車司機親切地幫老先生找座位。

examples.en: Kindly turn off your phones during the movie.
examples.zh: 電影放映期間請關閉手機。

examples.en: She smiled kindly and offered us some tea.
examples.zh: 她親切地微笑，並請我們喝茶。

examples.en: The kindly old doctor treated all his patients like family.
examples.zh: 這位和藹的老醫生把所有病人都當成家人。

examples.en: She has a kindly face that makes children feel safe.
examples.zh: 她有一張和藹的臉，讓孩子們感到安心。

examples.en: A kindly neighbor gave us a ride home.
examples.zh: 一位親切的鄰居載我們回家。

examples.en: Thank you for your kindness during my stay in Taipei.
examples.zh: 謝謝你在我待在台北期間的親切照顧。

examples.en: The teacher treated every student with kindness and patience.
examples.zh: 老師以親切和耐心對待每一位學生。

examples.en: A small act of kindness can make someone's day.
examples.zh: 一個小小的善舉就能讓人開心一整天。

examples.en: The lavatory is at the end of the corridor.
examples.zh: 洗手間在走廊的盡頭。

examples.en: Please ask the flight attendant if the lavatory is free.
examples.zh: 請詢問空服員洗手間目前是否空著。

examples.en: The lavatory in this café is clean and well lit.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡店的洗手間乾淨又明亮。

examples.en: Dr. Lin is a leading expert on ocean life.
examples.zh: 林博士是海洋生物的權威專家。

examples.en: Taiwan is a leading producer of computer chips.
examples.zh: 台灣是電腦晶片的主要生產地之一。

examples.en: Heavy rain was the leading cause of the delay.
examples.zh: 大雨是延誤的主要原因。

examples.en: A volunteer handed me a leaflet about the school festival.
examples.zh: 一位志工遞給我一張校慶的傳單。

examples.en: The leaflet explains how to use the new bike-sharing system.
examples.zh: 這份小冊子說明如何使用新的共享單車系統。

examples.en: Please read the leaflet in the box before taking the medicine.
examples.zh: 服藥前請先閱讀盒內的說明書。

examples.en: She is a quick learner who picks up new words easily.
examples.zh: 她學得很快，很容易就學會新單字。

examples.en: Many adult learners take evening English classes.
examples.zh: 許多成年學習者會上夜間英文課。

examples.en: This app is designed for beginner learners of Japanese.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式是為初學日文的學習者設計的。

examples.en: A healthy lifestyle includes regular exercise and enough sleep.
examples.zh: 健康的生活方式包括規律運動和充足的睡眠。

examples.en: Moving to the countryside changed their lifestyle completely.
examples.zh: 搬到鄉下徹底改變了他們的生活方式。

examples.en: This magazine shares ideas about food, travel, and city lifestyle.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌分享關於美食、旅遊和都會生活方式的點子。

examples.en: Many students feel loneliness when they first live away from home.
examples.zh: 許多學生剛離家生活時會感到孤單。

examples.en: The old man talked to his cat to ease his loneliness.
examples.zh: 老先生對著他的貓說話來排解寂寞。

examples.en: Joining a club is a good way to fight loneliness.
examples.zh: 加入社團是對抗孤單的好方法。

examples.en: The two schools have a long-standing friendship.
examples.zh: 這兩所學校有著長久的友誼。

examples.en: Traffic is a long-standing problem in this part of the city.
examples.zh: 交通是這個城區由來已久的問題。

examples.en: Eating dumplings on New Year's Eve is a long-standing family tradition.
examples.zh: 除夕夜吃水餃是一項由來已久的家庭傳統。

examples.en: This job offers long-term security and a good salary.
examples.zh: 這份工作提供長期的保障和不錯的薪水。

examples.en: We need a long-term plan to save water.
examples.zh: 我們需要一個節約用水的長期計畫。

examples.en: Too much screen time may cause long-term damage to your eyes.
examples.zh: 螢幕使用時間過長可能對眼睛造成長期的傷害。

examples.en: A large lorry blocked the narrow road in front of our school.
examples.zh: 一輛大貨車堵住了我們學校前面的窄路。

examples.en: The lorry delivered fresh vegetables to the market at dawn.
examples.zh: 這輛貨車在黎明時把新鮮蔬菜送到市場。

examples.en: The driver parked his lorry beside the warehouse and unloaded the boxes.
examples.zh: 司機把他的貨車停在倉庫旁邊，並卸下箱子。

examples.en: Lychee is a sweet, juicy fruit that people love in summer.
examples.zh: 荔枝是一種香甜多汁的水果，人們夏天很愛吃。

examples.en: She peeled a lychee and gave it to her little brother.
examples.zh: 她剝了一顆荔枝給弟弟。

examples.en: We bought a bag of fresh lychees from the fruit stand.
examples.zh: 我們在水果攤買了一袋新鮮的荔枝。

examples.en: This company is a famous maker of bicycles.
examples.zh: 這家公司是知名的腳踏車製造商。

examples.en: The maker of this toy gives a one-year guarantee.
examples.zh: 這個玩具的製造商提供一年保固。

examples.en: The makers of the app promise to fix the bug soon.
examples.zh: 這個應用程式的開發者承諾很快會修正錯誤。

examples.en: Plastic is a man-made material that takes years to break down.
examples.zh: 塑膠是一種人造材料，需要很多年才會分解。

examples.en: This man-made lake is a popular place for picnics.
examples.zh: 這座人工湖是很受歡迎的野餐地點。

examples.en: Some man-made fibers dry faster than cotton.
examples.zh: 有些人造纖維比棉乾得更快。

examples.en: The workload is heavy this week, but it is still manageable.
examples.zh: 這週工作量很大，但還應付得來。

examples.en: Dividing the project into small tasks makes it more manageable.
examples.zh: 把專案分成小任務會讓它更容易處理。

examples.en: A class of twenty students is a manageable size for one teacher.
examples.zh: 二十個學生的班級對一位老師來說是可掌握的規模。

examples.en: Good time management helps students finish their homework.
examples.zh: 良好的時間管理能幫助學生完成作業。

examples.en: The hotel management apologized for the noise last night.
examples.zh: 飯店管理階層為昨晚的噪音道歉。

examples.en: She studies business management at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學修讀企業管理。

examples.en: The manager sent a memorandum about the new office rules.
examples.zh: 經理發出了一份關於新辦公室規定的內部公告。

examples.en: Please read the memorandum before tomorrow's meeting.
examples.zh: 請在明天的會議前閱讀這份備忘錄。

examples.en: The two companies signed a memorandum of understanding yesterday.
examples.zh: 這兩家公司昨天簽署了合作備忘錄。

examples.en: We usually have lunch at midday in the school cafeteria.
examples.zh: 我們通常中午在學校餐廳吃午餐。

examples.en: The sun is hottest at midday in summer.
examples.zh: 夏天正午的太陽最熱。

examples.en: The shop closes for an hour around midday.
examples.zh: 這家店在中午前後會休息一小時。

examples.en: My middle-aged neighbor jogs around the park every morning.
examples.zh: 我那位中年鄰居每天早上都繞著公園慢跑。

examples.en: The survey asked middle-aged adults about their sleep habits.
examples.zh: 這項調查詢問中年人的睡眠習慣。

examples.en: A middle-aged man at the counter helped us choose a gift.
examples.zh: 櫃檯一位中年男士幫我們挑選禮物。

examples.en: I ordered a strawberry milkshake with my burger.
examples.zh: 我點了一杯草莓奶昔配漢堡。

examples.en: The milkshake was so thick that I could hardly use the straw.
examples.zh: 這杯奶昔太濃稠，我幾乎無法用吸管喝。

examples.en: Would you like a chocolate milkshake or a cup of tea?
examples.zh: 你想要巧克力奶昔還是一杯茶？

examples.en: We walked along the beach in the moonlight.
examples.zh: 我們在月光下沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: The moonlight came through the window and lit the room.
examples.zh: 月光從窗戶照進來，照亮了房間。

examples.en: The lake looked silver under the moonlight.
examples.zh: 湖面在月光下看起來一片銀白。

examples.en: My grandfather has a gray moustache and wears a straw hat.
examples.zh: 我爺爺留著灰色的小鬍子，戴著一頂草帽。

examples.en: He shaved off his moustache before the job interview.
examples.zh: 他在面試前把小鬍子刮掉了。

examples.en: The actor wore a fake moustache in the school play.
examples.zh: 那位演員在學校的戲劇裡貼了假的小鬍子。

examples.en: The classroom has movable desks, so we can change the layout.
examples.zh: 這間教室有可移動的課桌，所以我們可以改變座位排法。

examples.en: A movable wall divides the large hall into two rooms.
examples.zh: 一道活動隔牆把大廳分成兩間房間。

examples.en: These movable shelves are easy to push around the store.
examples.zh: 這些可移動的架子很容易在店裡推動。

examples.en: The naturalist spent ten years studying birds in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這位博物學家花了十年在山裡研究鳥類。

examples.en: Our class listened to a naturalist talk about wild flowers.
examples.zh: 我們班聽一位博物學家講野花。

examples.en: As a young naturalist, she kept a notebook of every insect she saw.
examples.zh: 身為年輕的自然研究者，她把看到的每一種昆蟲都記在筆記本裡。

examples.en: The naval base is located on the east coast of the island.
examples.zh: 海軍基地位於島嶼的東岸。

examples.en: Her father is a naval officer who often travels abroad.
examples.zh: 她的父親是海軍軍官，經常出國。

examples.en: Tourists can visit the naval museum on weekends.
examples.zh: 遊客週末可以參觀海軍博物館。

examples.en: Expensive shoes are not necessarily better than cheap ones.
examples.zh: 昂貴的鞋子不一定比便宜的好。

examples.en: A high score does not necessarily mean you understand the lesson.
examples.zh: 分數高不一定代表你理解了這一課。

examples.en: The clerk said the sale would not necessarily last until Sunday.
examples.zh: 店員說這次特賣不一定會持續到星期日。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to be kind to the newcomer in our class.
examples.zh: 老師請我們對班上的新同學友善一點。

examples.en: As a newcomer to the office, she asked many questions.
examples.zh: 身為辦公室的新人，她問了很多問題。

examples.en: The club welcomes every newcomer with a free snack.
examples.zh: 社團會用一份免費點心歡迎每位新成員。

examples.en: The newscaster read the weather report in a calm voice.
examples.zh: 新聞主播用平穩的聲音播報天氣。

examples.en: My aunt works as a newscaster for a local television station.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在一家地方電視台擔任新聞主播。

examples.en: The newscaster thanked the viewers and ended the program.
examples.zh: 新聞主播感謝觀眾後結束了節目。

examples.en: The test was difficult; nonetheless, most students passed.
examples.zh: 這次考試很難，儘管如此，大多數學生還是及格了。

examples.en: It rained all day. We had a great time nonetheless.
examples.zh: 雨下了一整天，我們仍然玩得很開心。

examples.en: The price is low, but the quality is nonetheless excellent.
examples.zh: 價格低廉，但品質依然極佳。

examples.en: We took a nonstop flight from Taipei to Tokyo.
examples.zh: 我們搭乘從台北直飛東京的直達班機。

examples.en: The nonstop noise from the street kept me awake.
examples.zh: 街上不停的噪音讓我睡不著。

examples.en: There is a nonstop bus to the airport every thirty minutes.
examples.zh: 每三十分鐘就有一班直達機場的公車。

examples.en: The band played nonstop for two hours.
examples.zh: 樂團不停地演奏了兩個小時。

examples.en: We talked nonstop all the way home.
examples.zh: 我們一路聊個不停直到回家。

examples.en: This train runs nonstop from the city to the airport.
examples.zh: 這班火車從市區直達機場。

examples.en: The wind is blowing from the northeast now.
examples.zh: 現在風從東北方吹來。

examples.en: Our hotel is in the northeast of the city.
examples.zh: 我們的飯店位在市區的東北部。

examples.en: Heavy rain is expected in the northeast this weekend.
examples.zh: 預計本週末東北部會下大雨。

examples.en: The northeast coast is famous for its rocky cliffs.
examples.zh: 東北海岸以岩石峭壁聞名。

examples.en: We live in the northeast corner of the island.
examples.zh: 我們住在島嶼的東北角。

examples.en: A northeast wind brought cool air to the area.
examples.zh: 東北風為這個地區帶來涼爽的空氣。

examples.en: The storm is moving toward the northwest.
examples.zh: 風暴正朝西北方移動。

examples.en: Our school is in the northwest of the town.
examples.zh: 我們學校在鎮上的西北部。

examples.en: Farmers in the northwest are waiting for the spring rain.
examples.zh: 西北部的農夫正在等待春雨。

examples.en: The northwest side of the mountain gets less sun.
examples.zh: 山的西北側日照比較少。

examples.en: They bought a house in a northwest suburb of the city.
examples.zh: 他們在城市的西北郊區買了一間房子。

examples.en: A cold northwest wind blew across the field.
examples.zh: 一陣冰冷的西北風吹過田野。

examples.en: The word happiness is a noun, but the word happy is an adjective.
examples.zh: happiness 這個字是名詞，而 happy 是形容詞。

examples.en: Please underline every noun in the sentence.
examples.zh: 請把句子中的每個名詞畫上底線。

examples.en: A noun can be the subject of a sentence.
examples.zh: 名詞可以當作句子的主詞。

examples.en: She plans to study nursing at a medical university.
examples.zh: 她打算在醫學大學學護理。

examples.en: Nursing is a hard job, but it helps many people.
examples.zh: 護理是一份辛苦的工作，卻能幫助許多人。

examples.en: My sister has worked in nursing for more than ten years.
examples.zh: 我姊姊從事護理工作已經超過十年。

examples.en: My grandmother lives in a nursing home near the park.
examples.zh: 我奶奶住在公園附近的護理之家。

examples.en: The nursing staff were kind to every patient.
examples.zh: 護理人員對每位病人都很親切。

examples.en: He is a nursing student at the local college.
examples.zh: 他是當地學院的護理系學生。

examples.en: This backpack is made of strong nylon.
examples.zh: 這個後背包是用堅韌的尼龍做的。

examples.en: She bought a pair of nylon socks for the trip.
examples.zh: 她為這趟旅行買了一雙尼龍襪。

examples.en: Nylon dries faster than cotton after you wash it.
examples.zh: 尼龍洗過後比棉乾得快。

examples.en: Oh, I forgot to bring my umbrella.
examples.zh: 噢，我忘了帶傘。

examples.en: Oh, that's a great idea! Let's try it.
examples.zh: 哦，這個點子真棒！我們試試看吧。

examples.en: Oh, are you the new teacher from Canada?
examples.zh: 哦，你就是從加拿大來的新老師嗎？

examples.en: She dreams of winning an Olympic medal one day.
examples.zh: 她夢想有一天能贏得奧運獎牌。

examples.en: The Olympic Games are held every four years.
examples.zh: 奧運會每四年舉辦一次。

examples.en: Our swimming coach is a former Olympic athlete.
examples.zh: 我們的游泳教練是前奧運選手。

senses.zh: 單方面的；一面倒的；片面的

examples.en: The game was one-sided, and our team won easily.
examples.zh: 這場比賽呈現一面倒，我們隊輕鬆獲勝。

examples.en: It is unfair to make a one-sided decision without asking others.
examples.zh: 不問別人就單方面做決定是不公平的。

examples.en: His one-sided story did not tell us what really happened.
examples.zh: 他片面的說法並沒有告訴我們實際發生了什麼事。

examples.en: Could you pass me the can opener?
examples.zh: 可以把開罐器遞給我嗎？

examples.en: There is a bottle opener in the second drawer.
examples.zh: 第二個抽屜裡有一支開瓶器。

examples.en: The singer was the opener for tonight's concert.
examples.zh: 這位歌手是今晚演唱會的開場表演者。

examples.en: The opening of the new library was on Monday.
examples.zh: 新圖書館在星期一開幕。

examples.en: There is a small opening in the fence for the cat.
examples.zh: 圍籬上有一個給貓進出的小開口。

examples.en: The company has an opening for a sales assistant.
examples.zh: 這家公司有一個業務助理的職缺。

examples.en: The opening scene of the movie was very funny.
examples.zh: 這部電影的開場一幕非常有趣。

examples.en: Our opening hours are from nine to six.
examples.zh: 我們的營業時間是九點到六點。

examples.en: The principal gave an opening speech at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在典禮上致開場詞。

examples.en: You ought to drink more water on hot days.
examples.zh: 天氣熱的時候，你應該多喝水。

examples.en: We ought to leave now if we want to catch the train.
examples.zh: 如果想趕上火車，我們現在就該出發了。

examples.en: Students ought not to be late for class.
examples.zh: 學生不應該上課遲到。

examples.en: The doctor told him that he was a little overweight.
examples.zh: 醫生告訴他體重有點過重。

examples.en: My suitcase was overweight, so I paid an extra fee.
examples.zh: 我的行李箱超重，所以多付了一筆費用。

examples.en: Eating too many sweets can make children overweight.
examples.zh: 吃太多甜食可能讓孩子變得過重。

examples.en: We watched the sunset over the Pacific coast.
examples.zh: 我們在太平洋沿岸看日落。

examples.en: Many islands in the Pacific region are popular with tourists.
examples.zh: 太平洋地區的許多島嶼很受遊客歡迎。

examples.en: The ship will cross the Pacific Ocean next month.
examples.zh: 這艘船下個月將橫越太平洋。

examples.en: She has a part-time job at a bookstore.
examples.zh: 她在書店有一份兼職工作。

examples.en: Many college students look for part-time work in the summer.
examples.zh: 許多大學生在暑假找兼職工作。

examples.en: The café needs a part-time cook on weekends.
examples.zh: 這家咖啡廳週末需要一位兼職廚師。

examples.en: He works part-time so that he can study at night.
examples.zh: 他兼職工作，這樣晚上就能讀書。

examples.en: My mother teaches part-time at a language school.
examples.zh: 我媽媽在語言學校兼課。

examples.en: Would you like to work part-time or full-time?
examples.zh: 你想兼職還是全職工作？

examples.en: In the phrase a broken window, the word broken is a participle.
examples.zh: 在「a broken window」這個詞組中，broken 是一個分詞。

examples.en: A present participle usually ends in ing.
examples.zh: 現在分詞通常以 ing 結尾。

examples.en: Our English teacher explained how to use a participle.
examples.zh: 英文老師說明了如何使用分詞。

examples.en: I am particularly interested in the history of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 我對台灣的歷史特別感興趣。

examples.en: The weather was not particularly good during our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行期間天氣不是特別好。

examples.en: Wear warm clothes, particularly if you go out at night.
examples.zh: 要穿暖一點，尤其是在晚上外出的時候。

examples.en: We accept payment by credit card or cash.
examples.zh: 我們接受信用卡或現金付款。

examples.en: The first payment is due on the fifth of next month.
examples.zh: 第一期款項在下個月五日到期。

examples.en: Please make your payment by bank transfer before Friday.
examples.zh: 請在星期五之前以銀行轉帳付款。

examples.en: A pink petal fell onto my notebook.
examples.zh: 一片粉紅色的花瓣落在我的筆記本上。

examples.en: This flower has five white petals around a yellow center.
examples.zh: 這朵花有五片白色花瓣圍著黃色的花心。

examples.en: Children threw rose petals along the path at the wedding.
examples.zh: 孩子們在婚禮上沿路撒玫瑰花瓣。

examples.en: The postal service will be closed on Monday.
examples.zh: 郵政服務星期一休息。

examples.en: Please write your postal code on the envelope.
examples.zh: 請在信封上寫下你的郵遞區號。

examples.en: A postal worker delivered the package to our door.
examples.zh: 一位郵務人員把包裹送到我們家門口。

senses.zh: 無力的；無能為力的；無權的

examples.en: I felt powerless when I could not help my friend.
examples.zh: 當我幫不上朋友的忙時，我覺得無能為力。

examples.en: The villagers were powerless against the flood.
examples.zh: 村民在洪水面前無能為力。

examples.en: Since the visitor had no ticket, the guard was powerless to admit him.
examples.zh: 由於訪客沒有票，警衛無權讓他進入。

examples.en: Walking to school is preferable to taking a crowded bus.
examples.zh: 走路上學比搭擁擠的公車更好。

examples.en: A quiet room is preferable for studying.
examples.zh: 安靜的房間比較適合讀書。

examples.en: Fresh fruit is preferable to candy as a snack.
examples.zh: 新鮮水果比糖果更適合當點心。

examples.en: The manager is presently in a meeting.
examples.zh: 經理目前正在開會。

examples.en: My brother is presently studying in Canada.
examples.zh: 我哥哥目前在加拿大讀書。

examples.en: The doctor will see you presently, so please take a seat.
examples.zh: 醫生很快就會幫你看診，請先坐下。

examples.en: The teacher gave the class no punishment for the noise.
examples.zh: 老師沒有因為吵鬧而處罰全班。

examples.en: Cleaning the classroom was his punishment for being late.
examples.zh: 打掃教室是他遲到的處罰。

examples.en: A fair punishment should match the mistake.
examples.zh: 公平的處罰應該與過錯相當。

examples.en: She is a qualified teacher with five years of experience.
examples.zh: 她是有五年經驗的合格教師。

examples.en: Only qualified drivers may rent a car here.
examples.zh: 只有合格的駕駛人才能在這裡租車。

examples.en: We are looking for a qualified nurse to join our clinic.
examples.zh: 我們正在找一位合格的護理師加入診所。

examples.en: My uncle rarely eats meat because he prefers fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 我叔叔很少吃肉，因為他比較喜歡新鮮蔬菜。

examples.en: It rarely snows in southern Taiwan, except in the high mountains.
examples.zh: 台灣南部除了高山地區以外，很少下雪。

examples.en: She rarely complains about her homework, even when it is difficult.
examples.zh: 她很少抱怨功課，即使功課很難也是如此。

examples.en: This magazine has more than ten thousand readers.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌有一萬多名讀者。

examples.en: My little sister is a fast reader.
examples.zh: 我妹妹閱讀速度很快。

examples.en: The library offers books for young readers.
examples.zh: 圖書館提供適合年輕讀者的書。

examples.en: She readily agreed to help us with the party.
examples.zh: 她欣然同意幫我們辦派對。

examples.en: Fresh fruit is readily available at the night market.
examples.zh: 夜市裡很容易買到新鮮水果。

examples.en: He readily admitted that he had made a mistake.
examples.zh: 他很爽快地承認自己犯了錯。

examples.en: Reading before bed helps me fall asleep.
examples.zh: 睡前閱讀幫助我入睡。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a reading list for the summer.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一份暑假閱讀書單。

examples.en: The thermometer reading was thirty-seven degrees when the nurse checked.
examples.zh: 護理師檢查時，溫度計的讀數是三十七度。

examples.en: The town plans to rebuild the old bridge.
examples.zh: 鎮上打算重建那座老橋。

examples.en: After the fire, they had to rebuild their shop.
examples.zh: 火災後，他們必須重建自己的店。

examples.en: It took two years to rebuild the school.
examples.zh: 重建這所學校花了兩年時間。

examples.en: Are you related to the new teacher?
examples.zh: 你和新來的老師有親戚關係嗎？

examples.en: Please read the related articles on the school website.
examples.zh: 請閱讀學校網站上的相關文章。

examples.en: Stress is closely related to poor sleep.
examples.zh: 壓力與睡眠不佳密切相關。

examples.en: The test was relatively easy this time.
examples.zh: 這次的考試相對簡單。

examples.en: Rent in this area is relatively cheap.
examples.zh: 這一帶的房租相對便宜。

examples.en: Our team is relatively new, but we are learning fast.
examples.zh: 我們的團隊相對較新，但我們學得很快。

examples.en: I called him repeatedly, but he did not answer.
examples.zh: 我打了好幾次電話給他，他都沒接。

examples.en: The teacher repeatedly told us to check our answers.
examples.zh: 老師再三叮嚀我們要檢查答案。

examples.en: The song was played repeatedly on the radio.
examples.zh: 這首歌在廣播中被重複播放。

examples.en: A passport is a basic requirement for traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 護照是出國旅行的基本要求。

examples.en: Students must meet all the requirements before they graduate.
examples.zh: 學生畢業前必須符合所有要求。

examples.en: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
examples.zh: 這份工作要求兩年經驗。

senses.zh: 焦躁不安的；靜不下來的

examples.en: The children grew restless during the long bus ride.
examples.zh: 孩子們在漫長的公車旅程中變得坐立不安。

examples.en: I felt restless the night before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前一晚我覺得靜不下心。

examples.en: The restless dog walked around the room all evening.
examples.zh: 那隻靜不下來的狗整個晚上都在房間裡走來走去。

examples.en: The festival gives families a chance to reunite.
examples.zh: 這個節日讓家人有機會團聚。

examples.en: The old friends were happy to reunite after ten years.
examples.zh: 這些老朋友隔了十年重聚，十分開心。

examples.en: The program helped reunite the lost dog with its owner.
examples.zh: 這個計畫幫助走失的狗與主人重逢。

examples.en: Please rewrite your essay and fix the spelling mistakes.
examples.zh: 請重寫你的作文並訂正拼字錯誤。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to rewrite the sentence in the past tense.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們把這個句子改寫成過去式。

examples.en: He had to rewrite the report before the meeting.
examples.zh: 他必須在會議前重寫那份報告。

examples.en: The rider waved to the crowd as she passed.
examples.zh: 騎士經過時向群眾揮手。

examples.en: Every rider on the bus must wear a seat belt.
examples.zh: 公車上的每位乘客都必須繫上安全帶。

examples.en: A young rider led the horse into the field.
examples.zh: 一位年輕的騎士把馬牽進田野。

examples.en: Running is a good way to stay healthy.
examples.zh: 跑步是保持健康的好方法。

examples.en: He goes running in the park every weekend.
examples.zh: 他每個週末都去公園跑步。

examples.en: Running shoes should fit well and feel comfortable.
examples.zh: 跑鞋應該合腳又舒適。

examples.en: We have running water in every room of the hotel.
examples.zh: 我們飯店的每間客房都有自來水。

examples.en: She bought a pair of running shorts for gym class.
examples.zh: 她為體育課買了一條跑步短褲。

examples.en: The running stream cooled our feet on the hot day.
examples.zh: 那條流動的小溪在大熱天讓我們的腳涼快起來。

examples.en: The news of the school closing will sadden many students.
examples.zh: 學校即將關閉的消息會讓許多學生難過。

examples.en: It saddens me to see my old neighborhood change so much.
examples.zh: 看到我的老社區變了這麼多，我覺得很難過。

examples.en: Please do not sadden your grandmother by missing her birthday dinner.
examples.zh: 請不要錯過外婆的生日晚餐，免得讓她傷心。

examples.en: Several countries agreed to impose a sanction on the company.
examples.zh: 幾個國家同意對這家公司實施制裁。

examples.en: The club needs the principal's sanction before it can hold the event.
examples.zh: 這個社團要辦活動前，需要校長的許可。

examples.en: A trade sanction can hurt ordinary people as well as governments.
examples.zh: 貿易制裁可能傷害一般人民，也會傷害政府。

examples.en: The school will not sanction students leaving class early.
examples.zh: 學校不准許學生提早離開教室。

examples.en: The committee voted to sanction the new travel plan.
examples.zh: 委員會投票批准了新的旅遊計畫。

examples.en: Our manager refused to sanction the extra spending on decorations.
examples.zh: 我們經理拒絕批准額外的裝飾費用。

examples.en: There is an old saying that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 有句古老的諺語說熟能生巧。

examples.en: My grandfather has a saying for every situation.
examples.zh: 我爺爺對每種情況都有一句俗話。

examples.en: The saying "better late than never" is very common in English.
examples.zh: 「遲到總比不到好」這句話在英文裡很常見。

examples.en: I bumped into an old schoolmate at the train station.
examples.zh: 我在火車站巧遇一位老同學。

examples.en: My schoolmate lent me her notes after I was sick.
examples.zh: 我生病後，同學把筆記借給我。

examples.en: He still keeps in touch with a few schoolmates from junior high.
examples.zh: 他仍和幾位國中同學保持聯絡。

examples.en: We spent the weekend at the seaside with our cousins.
examples.zh: 我們和表兄弟姊妹在海邊度過週末。

examples.en: The hotel is located right by the seaside.
examples.zh: 這間旅館就位在海邊。

examples.en: Many tourists visit the seaside town in summer.
examples.zh: 許多遊客在夏天造訪這個海濱小鎮。

examples.en: She bought a second-hand bicycle for only fifty dollars.
examples.zh: 她只花五十元買了一輛二手腳踏車。

examples.en: This shop sells second-hand books at low prices.
examples.zh: 這家店以低價販售二手書。

examples.en: This second-hand account of the accident may not be accurate.
examples.zh: 這份轉述的事故經過可能不正確。

examples.en: He bought the camera second-hand from a friend.
examples.zh: 他向朋友買了這台二手相機。

examples.en: I learned about the plan second-hand through my classmate.
examples.zh: 我是透過同學間接得知這項計畫的。

examples.en: They usually buy furniture second-hand to save money.
examples.zh: 他們通常買二手家具來省錢。

examples.en: The two companies reached a settlement after months of talks.
examples.zh: 兩家公司經過數月談判後達成和解。

examples.en: Early settlements grew up along the river.
examples.zh: 早期的定居地沿著河流發展起來。

examples.en: Please wait for the final settlement of your bill.
examples.zh: 請等候您帳單的最後結算。

examples.en: The setup of the new printer took only ten minutes.
examples.zh: 新印表機的設置只花了十分鐘。

examples.en: Her desk setup includes two screens and a small lamp.
examples.zh: 她的書桌配置包括兩個螢幕和一盞小檯燈。

examples.en: The setup for tomorrow's meeting is already finished.
examples.zh: 明天會議的場地安排已經完成了。

examples.en: The shining stars made the night sky beautiful.
examples.zh: 閃亮的星星讓夜空變得很美。

examples.en: She gave us a shining example of hard work.
examples.zh: 她為我們樹立了努力工作的傑出榜樣。

examples.en: The children ran toward the shining lake.
examples.zh: 孩子們跑向波光粼粼的湖。

examples.en: My brother is short-sighted and wears glasses all day.
examples.zh: 我弟弟近視，整天都戴眼鏡。

examples.en: It would be short-sighted to ignore the cost of repairs.
examples.zh: 忽視維修費用是很短視的。

examples.en: The manager made a short-sighted decision about the budget.
examples.zh: 經理對預算做了一個短視的決定。

examples.en: This short-term loan must be paid back within a month.
examples.zh: 這筆短期貸款必須在一個月內還清。

examples.en: She found a short-term job during the summer vacation.
examples.zh: 她在暑假找到一份短期工作。

examples.en: The short-term effects of the medicine are mild.
examples.zh: 這種藥的短期效果很溫和。

examples.en: We took a shortcut through the park to get to school.
examples.zh: 我們穿過公園走捷徑去學校。

examples.en: There is no shortcut to learning a new language.
examples.zh: 學習一種新語言沒有捷徑。

examples.en: Press this keyboard shortcut to save your file quickly.
examples.zh: 按這個鍵盤快捷鍵就能快速存檔。

examples.en: Her sickness kept her at home for a whole week.
examples.zh: 她的病讓她在家待了一整個星期。

examples.en: Many people get motion sickness on long bus rides.
examples.zh: 許多人搭長途公車時會暈車。

examples.en: Regular exercise can help prevent sickness and improve your health.
examples.zh: 規律運動有助於預防疾病並改善健康。

examples.en: The kitchen was smoky after the toast burned.
examples.zh: 吐司烤焦後，廚房煙霧瀰漫。

examples.en: I like the smoky flavor of this grilled fish.
examples.zh: 我喜歡這條烤魚的煙燻味。

examples.en: We left the smoky room and opened a window.
examples.zh: 我們離開煙霧瀰漫的房間，並打開窗戶。

examples.en: The town lies in the south-east of the country.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮位於該國的東南部。

examples.en: Clouds are moving in from the south-east.
examples.zh: 雲層正從東南方飄來。

examples.en: Our hotel is in the south-east of the city.
examples.zh: 我們的旅館位於市區東南部。

examples.en: The south-east coast is famous for its beaches.
examples.zh: 東南海岸以海灘聞名。

examples.en: A south-east wind brought warm rain to the coastal villages.
examples.zh: 東南風為沿海村莊帶來了溫暖的雨。

examples.en: We took the south-east exit from the highway.
examples.zh: 我們從高速公路的東南出口下去。

examples.en: Rain is expected in the south-west tonight.
examples.zh: 預計今晚西南部會下雨。

examples.en: The farm is in the south-west of the island.
examples.zh: 這座農場位於島的西南部。

examples.en: Birds fly to the south-west in autumn.
examples.zh: 秋天時，鳥兒飛往西南方。

examples.en: The south-west corner of the room is very bright.
examples.zh: 房間的西南角非常明亮。

examples.en: A south-west wind cooled the afternoon air.
examples.zh: 西南風使午後的空氣變涼爽。

examples.en: They live in a small town on the south-west coast of England.
examples.zh: 他們住在英格蘭西南海岸的一個小鎮。

examples.en: This hospital has a specialized unit for children.
examples.zh: 這家醫院有專門的兒童病房。

examples.en: He needs specialized training to repair these machines.
examples.zh: 他需要專門的訓練才能修理這些機器。

examples.en: The store sells specialized tools for bakers.
examples.zh: 這家店販售烘焙師專用的工具。

examples.en: My cousin is a talented sportsperson who trains every day.
examples.zh: 我表哥是個有天分的運動員，每天都訓練。

examples.en: A good sportsperson respects the rules and the other players.
examples.zh: 好的運動員會尊重規則和其他選手。

examples.en: The school invited a famous sportsperson to give a talk.
examples.zh: 學校邀請了一位知名運動員來演講。

examples.en: The old house has a wide wooden staircase.
examples.zh: 這棟老房子有一座寬敞的木製樓梯。

examples.en: Please do not leave bags on the staircase.
examples.zh: 請不要把袋子放在樓梯上。

examples.en: Our classroom is at the top of the staircase.
examples.zh: 我們的教室就在樓梯頂端。

examples.en: The company released a statement about the delay.
examples.zh: 公司發表了一份關於延誤的聲明。

examples.en: Please check your bank statement every month.
examples.zh: 請每個月核對您的銀行對帳單。

examples.en: The witness changed her statement after thinking again.
examples.zh: 證人重新考慮後更改了她的陳述。

examples.en: Their apartment building has twelve storeys and two elevators.
examples.zh: 他們的公寓大樓有十二層樓和兩部電梯。

examples.en: We live on the third storey of this building.
examples.zh: 我們住在這棟大樓的三樓。

examples.en: The library has only one storey and stands near the park.
examples.zh: 這間圖書館只有一層樓，位於公園附近。

senses.zh: 說故事的人；講故事的人

examples.en: The storyteller made the children laugh at the library.
examples.zh: 說故事的人在圖書館逗得孩子們哈哈大笑。

examples.en: My grandmother is a wonderful storyteller who keeps us entertained.
examples.zh: 我外婆是個很會說故事的人，總能讓我們聽得開心。

examples.en: The festival invited a storyteller from another country.
examples.zh: 這個慶典邀請了一位來自外國的說書人。

examples.en: The doctor wanted to reduce the patient's suffering.
examples.zh: 醫生想減輕病人的痛苦。

examples.en: Donations can help ease the suffering of people after floods.
examples.zh: 捐款可以幫助減輕水災後人們的苦難。

examples.en: There was a lot of suffering during the long drought.
examples.zh: 漫長的乾旱期間有許多苦難。

examples.en: Tourists like to sunbathe on the beach in summer.
examples.zh: 遊客夏天喜歡在海灘做日光浴。

examples.en: You should not sunbathe for too long without sunscreen.
examples.zh: 沒擦防曬乳就不該曬太久的太陽。

examples.en: We sunbathed by the pool all afternoon.
examples.zh: 我們整個下午都在泳池邊做日光浴。

examples.en: Sunlight came through the window and warmed the room.
examples.zh: 陽光從窗戶照進來，讓房間變暖和。

examples.en: Plants need sunlight and water to grow.
examples.zh: 植物需要陽光和水才能生長。

examples.en: Too much sunlight can hurt your skin.
examples.zh: 曬太多陽光會傷害皮膚。

examples.en: We woke up early to watch the sunrise.
examples.zh: 我們一大早起床看日出。

examples.en: The farmers start work at sunrise to avoid the midday heat.
examples.zh: 農夫們在日出時開始工作，以避開正午的酷熱。

examples.en: The sky turned pink just before sunrise.
examples.zh: 日出前，天空變成粉紅色。

examples.en: The sunset over the sea was beautiful.
examples.zh: 海上的夕陽很美。

examples.en: We had dinner on the beach at sunset.
examples.zh: 我們在日落時於海灘吃晚餐。

examples.en: Please come home before sunset so we can have dinner together.
examples.zh: 請在日落前回家，這樣我們就能一起吃晚餐。

examples.en: She is a strong supporter of the recycling program.
examples.zh: 她是回收計畫的堅定支持者。

examples.en: Thousands of supporters cheered for the home team.
examples.zh: 數千名球迷為主場球隊加油。

examples.en: The charity thanked every supporter for the help.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構感謝每一位支持者的幫助。

examples.en: You will surely enjoy this movie if you like funny stories.
examples.zh: 如果你喜歡有趣的故事，一定會喜歡這部電影。

examples.en: Surely you remember our meeting last week.
examples.zh: 你想必記得我們上週的會面。

examples.en: The bus will surely arrive soon, so let us wait here.
examples.zh: 公車一定很快就會到，所以我們就在這裡等吧。

examples.en: Mom put a white tablecloth on the dining table.
examples.zh: 媽媽在餐桌上鋪了一條白色桌布。

examples.en: I spilled juice on the tablecloth while reaching for my plate.
examples.zh: 我伸手拿盤子時，把果汁灑在桌布上了。

examples.en: This tablecloth has a pattern of small red flowers.
examples.zh: 這條桌布有紅色小花的圖案。

examples.en: She pinned the poster to the board with a tack.
examples.zh: 她用圖釘把海報釘在布告欄上。

examples.en: I stepped on a tack and hurt my foot.
examples.zh: 我踩到圖釘，腳受傷了。

examples.en: The company decided to try a different tack this year.
examples.zh: 公司今年決定嘗試不同的方針。

examples.en: Please tack the notice on the wall.
examples.zh: 請把通知用圖釘釘在牆上。

examples.en: The teacher tacked a map to the board.
examples.zh: 老師把地圖釘在黑板上。

examples.en: She tacked the hem before sewing it properly.
examples.zh: 她在正式縫好之前，先把衣物的摺邊暫時縫住。

examples.en: The library has a reading room for teens.
examples.zh: 圖書館有一間青少年閱讀室。

examples.en: Many teens spend hours on their phones every evening.
examples.zh: 許多青少年每天晚上花好幾個小時在手機上。

examples.en: A group of teens volunteered at the animal shelter.
examples.zh: 一群青少年在動物收容所當志工。

examples.en: The store sells teen fashion at fair prices.
examples.zh: 這家店以合理的價格販售青少年服飾。

examples.en: She loves reading teen novels about friendship and school life.
examples.zh: 她喜歡讀關於友誼與校園生活的青少年小說。

examples.en: The program helps teen students learn career skills.
examples.zh: 這個計畫幫助青少年學生學習職場技能。

examples.en: The final game will be televised across the country.
examples.zh: 決賽將透過電視向全國轉播。

examples.en: The speech was televised live on Friday night.
examples.zh: 這場演講已於星期五晚上透過電視現場轉播。

examples.en: Not every school event is televised on the local news.
examples.zh: 並非每場學校活動都會在地方電視新聞上播出。

examples.en: Careful thinking will help you solve the problem.
examples.zh: 仔細思考會幫你解決這個問題。

examples.en: Her way of thinking is very creative.
examples.zh: 她的思維方式非常有創意。

examples.en: After some quick thinking, he found the answer.
examples.zh: 經過一番快速思考後，他找到了答案。

examples.en: A thunderstorm is coming, so we should go inside.
examples.zh: 雷雨要來了，我們應該進屋裡。

examples.en: The thunderstorm woke me up last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚的雷雨把我吵醒了。

examples.en: Flights were delayed because of the thunderstorm.
examples.zh: 班機因為雷雨而延誤。

examples.en: Please buy a tube of toothpaste at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 請在超市買一條牙膏。

examples.en: Put a small amount of toothpaste on your brush.
examples.zh: 在牙刷上擠一點牙膏。

examples.en: This toothpaste has a fresh mint flavor.
examples.zh: 這款牙膏有清新的薄荷味。

examples.en: New workers must finish a week of training.
examples.zh: 新進員工必須完成一週的培訓。

examples.en: The team's training starts at six every morning.
examples.zh: 球隊的訓練每天早上六點開始。

examples.en: She took a training course on first aid.
examples.zh: 她參加了一個急救訓練課程。

examples.en: Traveling by train is cheaper than flying.
examples.zh: 搭火車旅行比搭飛機便宜。

examples.en: She loves traveling to new countries with her family.
examples.zh: 她喜歡和家人到新的國家旅行。

examples.en: Traveling alone taught him to be independent.
examples.zh: 獨自旅行讓他學會獨立。

examples.en: A traveling circus came to our town.
examples.zh: 一個巡迴馬戲團來到我們鎮上。

examples.en: He packed a traveling bag for the trip.
examples.zh: 他為這趟旅行收拾了一個旅行袋。

examples.en: The traveling exhibition will visit five cities.
examples.zh: 這個巡迴展覽將到五座城市展出。

examples.en: Tulips bloom in the garden every spring.
examples.zh: 鬱金香每年春天都會在花園裡盛開。

examples.en: She gave her teacher a bunch of red tulips.
examples.zh: 她送給老師一束紅色鬱金香。

examples.en: The farm is famous for its colorful tulip fields.
examples.zh: 這座農場以色彩繽紛的鬱金香花田聞名。

examples.en: My grandfather still writes letters on an old typewriter.
examples.zh: 我爺爺仍然用一台舊打字機寫信。

examples.en: The museum has a typewriter from the 1950s.
examples.zh: 博物館有一台一九五〇年代的打字機。

examples.en: The typewriter made a loud sound with every key.
examples.zh: 每按一個鍵，打字機就發出很大的聲響。

examples.en: The office hired a fast typist to enter the data.
examples.zh: 辦公室僱了一位打字很快的打字員來輸入資料。

examples.en: She worked as a typist before becoming a manager.
examples.zh: 她在成為經理之前當過打字員。

examples.en: A good typist can type without looking at the keys.
examples.zh: 好的打字員不用看鍵盤就能打字。

examples.en: The mall has an underground parking lot.
examples.zh: 這間購物中心有地下停車場。

examples.en: Underground water supplies the whole village during the dry season.
examples.zh: 旱季期間，地下水供應整個村莊。

examples.en: We walked through an underground passage to the station.
examples.zh: 我們穿過一條地下通道走到車站。

examples.en: In London, many people take the underground to work.
examples.zh: 在倫敦，許多人搭地鐵上班。

examples.en: The London underground was crowded during rush hour.
examples.zh: 倫敦地鐵在尖峰時段很擁擠。

examples.en: We got off the underground in Paris near the museum.
examples.zh: 我們在巴黎的博物館附近下了地鐵。

examples.en: The cables are buried underground to protect them from strong winds.
examples.zh: 電纜埋在地下，以免受到強風損害。

examples.en: Moles live underground and dig long tunnels.
examples.zh: 鼴鼠住在地下並挖很長的隧道。

examples.en: The workers went underground to fix the pipes.
examples.zh: 工人們到地下去修理水管。

examples.en: She has a good understanding of basic math.
examples.zh: 她對基礎數學有很好的理解。

examples.en: Thank you for your patience and understanding.
examples.zh: 謝謝您的耐心與體諒。

examples.en: The two teams reached an understanding about the schedule.
examples.zh: 兩支隊伍就時程達成了共識。

examples.en: My teacher was understanding when I handed in my homework late.
examples.zh: 我晚交作業時，老師很體諒。

examples.en: He is an understanding friend who always listens.
examples.zh: 他是個善解人意的朋友，總是願意傾聽。

examples.en: Our boss was very understanding about the family emergency.
examples.zh: 老闆對那次家庭緊急狀況非常體諒。

examples.en: The diver took underwater photos of the coral.
examples.zh: 潛水員拍了珊瑚的水中照片。

examples.en: We visited an underwater museum on our trip.
examples.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了一座水下博物館。

examples.en: The underwater world is full of colorful fish.
examples.zh: 水中世界充滿了色彩繽紛的魚。

examples.en: He can swim underwater for almost a minute.
examples.zh: 他可以在水中游將近一分鐘。

examples.en: Turtles stay underwater for a long time.
examples.zh: 烏龜可以在水下待很久。

examples.en: The camera still works underwater, so we can photograph the fish.
examples.zh: 這台相機在水下仍然可以使用，因此我們能拍攝魚群。

senses.zh: 體重過輕的；重量不足的

examples.en: The doctor said the baby was slightly underweight.
examples.zh: 醫生說這個嬰兒體重稍微過輕。

examples.en: Being underweight can affect your health and make you feel tired.
examples.zh: 體重過輕可能影響健康，並使你感到疲倦。

examples.en: Some of the boxes were found to be underweight.
examples.zh: 有些箱子被發現重量不足。

examples.en: We received an unexpected visit from our uncle.
examples.zh: 我們意外地迎來了叔叔的來訪。

examples.en: The test results were unexpected, so the teacher checked them again.
examples.zh: 測驗結果出乎意料，因此老師又檢查了一次。

examples.en: An unexpected storm forced us to cancel the picnic.
examples.zh: 一場突如其來的暴風雨迫使我們取消野餐。

senses.zh: 未知的；不知名的；陌生的

examples.en: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
examples.zh: 起火原因仍然不明。

examples.en: An unknown number called me three times last night.
examples.zh: 有個不知名的號碼昨晚打給我三次。

examples.en: She felt nervous about traveling to an unknown city.
examples.zh: 她對前往陌生的城市感到緊張。

examples.en: Unlike his brother, he enjoys quiet evenings at home.
examples.zh: 和他哥哥不同，他喜歡在家度過安靜的夜晚。

examples.en: Unlike last year, this summer is very rainy.
examples.zh: 和去年不同，今年夏天雨很多。

examples.en: The new phone is unlike any I have used before.
examples.zh: 這支新手機和我以前用過的都不一樣。

examples.en: The two sisters are quite unlike in personality.
examples.zh: 這兩姊妹的個性截然不同。

examples.en: The results of the two tests were very unlike.
examples.zh: 兩次測驗的結果非常不同。

examples.en: Although they were twins, they were quite unlike in appearance.
examples.zh: 雖然他們是雙胞胎，但外貌相當不同。

senses.zh: 未動過的；未受影響的；原封不動的

examples.en: The food on his plate was untouched.
examples.zh: 他盤子裡的食物原封不動。

examples.en: The island remains untouched by tourism because visitors need special permits.
examples.zh: 這座島因為遊客需要特別許可，仍未受到觀光的影響。

examples.en: She left the letter untouched on the desk.
examples.zh: 她把信原封不動地留在書桌上。

senses.zh: 不尋常的；罕見的；獨特的

examples.en: It is unusual for him to be late for school.
examples.zh: 他上學遲到是很不尋常的。

examples.en: She has an unusual hobby of collecting old keys.
examples.zh: 她有收集舊鑰匙這個獨特的嗜好。

examples.en: We saw an unusual bird near the lake.
examples.zh: 我們在湖邊看到一隻罕見的鳥。

examples.en: This old umbrella is useless because it has a big hole in it.
examples.zh: 這把舊雨傘破了個大洞，所以一點用也沒有。

examples.en: It is useless to argue with him when he is in a bad mood.
examples.zh: 他心情不好的時候跟他爭論是沒有用的。

examples.en: My phone is useless without a charger, so I always carry one.
examples.zh: 沒有充電器，我的手機就派不上用場，所以我總是帶著一個。

examples.en: A verb tells us what someone or something does.
examples.zh: 動詞告訴我們某人或某物做了什麼。

examples.en: Please underline the verb in each sentence on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 請在練習紙上的每個句子中，把動詞劃上底線。

examples.en: The verb in this sentence is in the past tense.
examples.zh: 這個句子裡的動詞是過去式。

examples.en: My grandparents danced a waltz at their anniversary party.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母在結婚紀念派對上跳了一支華爾茲。

examples.en: The band played a slow waltz while the guests found their seats.
examples.zh: 賓客入座時，樂團演奏了一首慢速的華爾茲。

examples.en: She learned to dance the waltz in a class at the community center.
examples.zh: 她在社區活動中心的課程裡學會了跳華爾茲。

examples.en: They waltzed across the floor to the soft music.
examples.zh: 他們隨著輕柔的音樂在舞池中跳著華爾茲。

examples.en: The couple waltzed around the room at the school dance.
examples.zh: 那對情侶在學校舞會上繞著會場跳華爾茲。

examples.en: He waltzed into the office ten minutes late as if nothing had happened.
examples.zh: 他遲到十分鐘，若無其事地晃進辦公室。

examples.en: The museum has an exhibit about ancient warfare and its weapons.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一個關於古代戰爭及其武器的展覽。

examples.en: Modern warfare depends heavily on technology and information.
examples.zh: 現代戰爭非常依賴科技與資訊。

examples.en: Our history teacher explained how warfare changed during the twentieth century.
examples.zh: 我們的歷史老師說明了戰爭方式在二十世紀如何改變。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a warning about the upcoming exam.
examples.zh: 老師就即將到來的考試向我們提出了警告。

examples.en: There is a warning sign near the wet floor.
examples.zh: 濕滑的地板旁邊有一個警示標誌。

examples.en: The weather bureau issued a typhoon warning this morning.
examples.zh: 氣象局今天早上發布了颱風警報。

examples.en: The driver saw a warning light on the dashboard and stopped the car.
examples.zh: 駕駛看到儀表板上的警示燈亮了，就把車停下來。

examples.en: Please read the warning label before you use this medicine.
examples.zh: 使用這種藥之前，請先閱讀警告標示。

examples.en: A loud warning bell rang when the train was about to leave.
examples.zh: 火車即將離站時，響起了響亮的警示鈴聲。

examples.en: A large warship entered the harbor early in the morning.
examples.zh: 一艘大型軍艦在清晨駛進了港口。

examples.en: The museum lets visitors tour an old warship from the last century.
examples.zh: 這間博物館讓遊客參觀上個世紀留下來的一艘舊軍艦。

examples.en: Each warship carries a crew of hundreds of sailors.
examples.zh: 每艘軍艦都載有數百名水手。

senses.zh: 洗滌；待洗衣物；洗好的衣物

examples.en: Washing the dishes is my job after dinner.
examples.zh: 晚餐後洗碗是我的工作。

examples.en: Mom hung the washing on the balcony to dry.
examples.zh: 媽媽把洗好的衣物晾在陽台上。

examples.en: There is a pile of washing in the basket by the door.
examples.zh: 門邊的籃子裡有一堆待洗的衣物。

examples.en: The watchman checks every door of the building at night.
examples.zh: 警衛每天晚上都會檢查大樓的每一道門。

examples.en: A night watchman greeted us at the gate of the factory.
examples.zh: 一位夜間警衛在工廠大門口向我們打招呼。

examples.en: The old watchman has worked at this school for thirty years.
examples.zh: 這位老警衛已經在這所學校工作三十年了。

examples.en: She is a well-known singer in Taiwan and Japan.
examples.zh: 她是在台灣和日本都很有名的歌手。

examples.en: This restaurant is well-known for its beef noodle soup.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳以牛肉麵聞名。

examples.en: It is a well-known fact that exercise keeps you healthy.
examples.zh: 運動能讓人保持健康是眾所周知的事實。

examples.en: Many westerners visit Taiwan to try the night market food.
examples.zh: 許多西方人來台灣品嚐夜市小吃。

examples.en: The tour guide explained local customs to a group of westerners.
examples.zh: 導遊向一群西方人解說當地的習俗。

examples.en: A westerner in our class is learning to write Chinese characters.
examples.zh: 我們班上的一位西方人正在學寫中文字。

examples.en: You can choose whichever you like from the menu.
examples.zh: 你可以從菜單中選任何你喜歡的。

examples.en: Take whichever is closer to the door.
examples.zh: 拿離門比較近的那一個。

examples.en: Whichever wins the game will get a small prize.
examples.zh: 不論哪一個贏得比賽，都會得到一份小獎品。

examples.en: Whichever bus you take, you will arrive at the station.
examples.zh: 不論你搭哪一班公車，都會到達車站。

examples.en: Whichever color you pick, I will paint the wall for you.
examples.zh: 不論你選哪一種顏色，我都會幫你粉刷牆壁。

examples.en: Use whichever pen is on the desk to sign the form.
examples.zh: 用桌上任何一支筆在表格上簽名。

examples.en: The fans cheered wildly when the team scored.
examples.zh: 球隊得分時，球迷瘋狂地歡呼。

examples.en: The price of vegetables changed wildly after the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風過後，蔬菜的價格劇烈波動。

examples.en: The little boy waved his arms wildly to get our attention.
examples.zh: 小男孩拚命揮動雙臂，想引起我們的注意。

examples.en: A willow tree grows beside the pond in the park.
examples.zh: 公園池塘邊長著一棵柳樹。

examples.en: The long branches of the willow moved gently in the wind.
examples.zh: 柳樹的長枝條在風中輕輕擺動。

examples.en: This basket is made from willow, so it is light and strong.
examples.zh: 這個籃子是用柳木做的，所以又輕又堅固。

examples.en: The wizard in the story lives in a tall tower.
examples.zh: 故事裡的巫師住在一座高塔裡。

examples.en: Kids dressed up as wizards for the school party.
examples.zh: 孩子們為學校派對打扮成巫師。

examples.en: He is a computer wizard who can fix almost any problem.
examples.zh: 他是個電腦奇才，幾乎什麼問題都能解決。

examples.en: My mother is a working woman who leaves home at seven.
examples.zh: 我的母親是上班族，七點就出門。

examples.en: We need a working knowledge of English for this job.
examples.zh: 這份工作需要具備實用的英文能力。

examples.en: The working hours at the store are from nine to six.
examples.zh: 這間店的工作時間是從九點到六點。

examples.en: The working of this machine is easy to understand.
examples.zh: 這台機器的運作方式很容易理解。

examples.en: Working at the bakery helped her save money for school.
examples.zh: 在麵包店工作幫她存下了學費。

examples.en: The students studied the inner workings of a clock.
examples.zh: 學生們研究了時鐘的內部運作原理。

examples.en: The singer has a worldwide fan club with millions of members.
examples.zh: 這位歌手有一個擁有數百萬名會員的全球粉絲俱樂部。

examples.en: The company plans a worldwide sale next month.
examples.zh: 這間公司計畫在下個月舉辦全球大特賣。

examples.en: Climate change is a worldwide problem that needs everyone's help.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷是需要大家共同努力的全球性問題。

senses.zh: 在世界各地；遍及全球地

examples.en: This movie is shown worldwide, from Taipei to New York.
examples.zh: 這部電影在世界各地上映，從台北到紐約都看得到。

examples.en: The company sells its shoes worldwide through its online store.
examples.zh: 這家公司透過網路商店把鞋子賣到世界各地。

examples.en: Her books are read worldwide by students and teachers.
examples.zh: 世界各地的學生和老師都閱讀她的書。

examples.en: I need new shoes because my old ones are very worn.
examples.zh: 我需要新鞋，因為舊鞋已經非常破舊了。

examples.en: The worn carpet in the hall was replaced last week.
examples.zh: 走廊上破舊的地毯上週被換掉了。

examples.en: After the long trip, she looked worn and a little sleepy.
examples.zh: 經過長途旅行，她看起來疲憊又有點想睡。

examples.en: The old coin turned out to be worthless.
examples.zh: 那枚舊硬幣結果一文不值。

examples.en: He felt worthless after failing the driving test.
examples.zh: 他沒通過駕照考試後，覺得自己沒有價值。

examples.en: A broken ticket is worthless once the concert is over.
examples.zh: 音樂會結束後，破損的票券就毫無價值了。

examples.en: Wow, this view from the mountain is amazing!
examples.zh: 哇，從山上看出去的景色太棒了！

examples.en: Wow, you finished the whole book in one day?
examples.zh: 哇，你一天就看完整本書了？

examples.en: Wow, that was the best pizza I have ever had.
examples.zh: 哇，那是我吃過最好吃的披薩。

examples.en: We used red wrapping paper for the birthday gift.
examples.zh: 我們用紅色包裝紙包生日禮物。

examples.en: Please remove the plastic wrapping before you heat the food.
examples.zh: 加熱食物前，請先拆掉塑膠包裝。

examples.en: The wrapping of the box was torn when it arrived.
examples.zh: 盒子送到時，包裝已經破了。

examples.en: Her writing is clear and easy to read.
examples.zh: 她的文筆清楚，讀起來很輕鬆。

examples.en: Writing a diary every night helps me practice English.
examples.zh: 每晚寫日記幫助我練習英文。

examples.en: The teacher praised the writing of the new student.
examples.zh: 老師稱讚那位新同學的作品。

examples.en: He is writing an email to his manager right now.
examples.zh: 他現在正在寫一封電子郵件給經理。

examples.en: The children are writing their names on the cards.
examples.zh: 孩子們正在卡片上寫自己的名字。

examples.en: She spent the whole evening writing a letter to her friend.
examples.zh: 她花了一整晚寫信給朋友。

examples.en: You need written permission from your parents to join the trip.
examples.zh: 你需要父母的書面同意才能參加這次旅行。

examples.en: The written test will be held on Friday morning.
examples.zh: 筆試將在週五早上舉行。

examples.en: Please give all new staff a copy of the written rules.
examples.zh: 請給所有新進員工一份書面規定。

examples.en: This song was written by a famous Taiwanese musician.
examples.zh: 這首歌是一位知名的台灣音樂人寫的。

examples.en: Have you written your name on the form yet?
examples.zh: 你已經把名字寫在表格上了嗎？

examples.en: She has written three letters to her grandmother this month.
examples.zh: 她這個月已經寫了三封信給外婆。

examples.en: The doctor took an x-ray of my arm.
examples.zh: 醫生幫我的手臂照了X光。

examples.en: The x-ray showed that the bone was not broken.
examples.zh: X光片顯示骨頭沒有斷。

examples.en: Airport staff use an x-ray machine to check bags.
examples.zh: 機場人員使用X光機檢查行李。

examples.en: The nurse will x-ray your chest this afternoon.
examples.zh: 護士今天下午會幫你的胸部照X光。

examples.en: The dentist decided to x-ray my teeth.
examples.zh: 牙醫決定幫我的牙齒照X光。

examples.en: They x-ray every package before it goes on the plane.
examples.zh: 每件包裹上飛機之前，他們都會用X光檢查。

examples.en: We have a biology class every Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 我們每週二早上有生物課。

examples.en: She wants to study biology at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她想在台北的大學讀生物學。

examples.en: Our biology teacher showed us a plant under the microscope.
examples.zh: 生物老師讓我們用顯微鏡觀察一株植物。

examples.en: The teacher wrote a kind comment on my essay.
examples.zh: 老師在我的作文上寫了一則親切的評語。

examples.en: Please leave a comment below the video.
examples.zh: 請在影片下方留言。

examples.en: He made no comment about the new rules.
examples.zh: 他對新規定沒有做任何評論。
