examples.en: Many people commented on her beautiful voice.
examples.zh: 許多人都稱讚她優美的歌聲。

examples.en: The mayor refused to comment on the plan.
examples.zh: 市長拒絕就這項計畫發表意見。

examples.en: Students are asked to comment on the school lunch menu.
examples.zh: 學生被要求對學校的午餐菜單提出意見。

examples.en: The bus slowed down at the sharp curve in the road.
examples.zh: 公車在道路的急彎處減速。

examples.en: The graph shows a curve that goes up and then down.
examples.zh: 這張圖表顯示一條先上升再下降的曲線。

examples.en: She drew a smooth curve with a pencil.
examples.zh: 她用鉛筆畫了一條平滑的曲線。

examples.en: The river curves around the small village.
examples.zh: 這條河彎彎曲曲地繞過小村莊。

examples.en: The road curves to the left after the bridge.
examples.zh: 過了橋之後，道路向左彎。

examples.en: Her lips curved into a smile when she saw the gift.
examples.zh: 她看到禮物時，雙唇彎起，露出了微笑。

examples.en: She is a diligent student who studies every night.
examples.zh: 她是個勤奮的學生，每天晚上都讀書。

examples.en: The diligent staff cleaned the whole office before noon.
examples.zh: 勤快的員工在中午前就把整間辦公室打掃乾淨了。

examples.en: Being diligent will help you reach your goals.
examples.zh: 勤奮會幫助你達成目標。

senses.zh: 外交官；善於圓融處事的人

examples.en: The diplomat met with leaders from three countries.
examples.zh: 這位外交官和三個國家的領袖會面。

examples.en: Her father works as a diplomat in the embassy.
examples.zh: 她的父親在大使館擔任外交官。

examples.en: You must be a good diplomat to solve this problem without fighting.
examples.zh: 要不起衝突就解決這個問題，你得是個圓融的人。

examples.en: Please don't embarrass me in front of my friends.
examples.zh: 請不要在我朋友面前讓我難堪。

examples.en: The question seemed to embarrass the shy student.
examples.zh: 這個問題似乎讓那位害羞的學生很尷尬。

examples.en: He tried not to embarrass his sister at the party.
examples.zh: 他盡量不在派對上讓妹妹覺得丟臉。

examples.en: We had a fantastic time at the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 上週末我們在海邊玩得很開心。

examples.en: The new teacher gave a fantastic speech to the class.
examples.zh: 新老師對全班發表了一場精彩的演說。

examples.en: That is a fantastic idea for the school festival.
examples.zh: 那對校慶來說是個很棒的點子。

examples.en: Einstein was a genius who changed modern science.
examples.zh: 愛因斯坦是改變現代科學的天才。

examples.en: My little brother is a math genius.
examples.zh: 我弟弟是個數學天才。

examples.en: The painting shows the genius of the young artist.
examples.zh: 這幅畫展現了這位年輕藝術家的才華。

examples.en: Her story inspired many students to work harder.
examples.zh: 她的故事激勵了許多學生更努力。

examples.en: The beautiful scenery inspired him to write a poem.
examples.zh: 美麗的風景讓他有靈感寫了一首詩。

examples.en: A good teacher can inspire children to love reading.
examples.zh: 好老師能啟發孩子熱愛閱讀。

examples.en: The maximum for this elevator is eight people.
examples.zh: 這部電梯的上限是八個人。

examples.en: We can invite a maximum of ten guests.
examples.zh: 我們最多可以邀請十位客人。

examples.en: The temperature reached its maximum at noon.
examples.zh: 氣溫在中午達到最高點。

examples.en: The maximum speed on this road is sixty kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 這條路的最高時速是六十公里。

examples.en: Please do not go over the maximum weight for your luggage.
examples.zh: 請不要超過行李的最大重量限制。

examples.en: The room has a maximum capacity of fifty people.
examples.zh: 這間房間最多可容納五十人。

examples.en: The mechanic fixed our car in less than an hour.
examples.zh: 技工不到一小時就修好了我們的車。

examples.en: My uncle works as a mechanic at a motorcycle shop.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一間機車行當技工。

examples.en: Ask the mechanic to check the brakes before the trip.
examples.zh: 出遊前請技工檢查煞車。

examples.en: Physics explains why things fall to the ground.
examples.zh: 物理學解釋了東西為什麼會掉到地上。

examples.en: I have a physics test on Thursday.
examples.zh: 我星期四有物理考試。

examples.en: Our physics teacher did an experiment with magnets.
examples.zh: 我們的物理老師用磁鐵做了一個實驗。

examples.en: We recycle paper, bottles, and cans at home.
examples.zh: 我們在家裡回收紙張、瓶子和鐵罐。

examples.en: The school asks students to recycle their old notebooks.
examples.zh: 學校請學生回收他們的舊筆記本。

examples.en: You can recycle this plastic bag at the supermarket.
examples.zh: 你可以在超市回收這個塑膠袋。

examples.en: Please revise your essay before you hand it in.
examples.zh: 交作業之前，請先修改你的作文。

examples.en: The company will revise its schedule next month.
examples.zh: 公司下個月會修訂時程表。

examples.en: I need to revise for the English exam this weekend.
examples.zh: 我這個週末得為英文考試複習。

examples.en: The heavy rain ruined our picnic plans.
examples.zh: 大雨毀了我們的野餐計畫。

examples.en: Don't ruin the surprise by telling her about the party.
examples.zh: 別把派對的事告訴她，以免破壞驚喜。

examples.en: Too much salt can ruin a good soup.
examples.zh: 太多鹽會毀掉一碗好湯。

examples.en: The old castle is now a ruin on the hill.
examples.zh: 那座古堡現在成了山丘上的廢墟。

examples.en: Tourists visit the ruins of the ancient city.
examples.zh: 遊客參觀這座古城的遺跡。

examples.en: The storm left the farm in ruin.
examples.zh: 暴風雨讓農場一片殘破。

examples.en: He is too stingy to buy his friends a drink.
examples.zh: 他小氣到不肯請朋友喝飲料。

examples.en: Don't be stingy with your time when someone needs help.
examples.zh: 別人需要幫忙時，不要吝嗇你的時間。

examples.en: My stingy uncle never gives anyone a gift.
examples.zh: 我那個小氣的叔叔從來不送任何人禮物。

examples.en: We do an experiment in chemistry class every week.
examples.zh: 我們每週都在化學課做實驗。

examples.en: She studied chemistry because she loves science.
examples.zh: 她因為熱愛科學而研讀化學。

examples.en: The chemistry of soap helps it remove oil from our hands.
examples.zh: 肥皂的化學性質能幫助去除手上的油污。

examples.en: My brother and I share the housework on Sundays.
examples.zh: 我和哥哥週日一起分擔家事。

examples.en: Doing housework can be a good way to exercise.
examples.zh: 做家事也是一種不錯的運動方式。

examples.en: She finished her housework before she went out.
examples.zh: 她做完家事才出門。

examples.en: The scenery along the east coast is beautiful.
examples.zh: 東部海岸沿線的風景很美。

examples.en: We took many photos of the mountain scenery.
examples.zh: 我們拍了許多山景照片。

examples.en: The scenery for the school play was painted by the students.
examples.zh: 學校話劇的布景是學生畫的。

examples.en: My neighbor decided to adopt a puppy from the shelter.
examples.zh: 我的鄰居決定從收容所領養一隻小狗。

examples.en: The school will adopt a new reading program next year.
examples.zh: 學校明年將採用新的閱讀計畫。

examples.en: The couple adopted a baby girl last spring.
examples.zh: 那對夫妻去年春天收養了一個女嬰。

examples.en: Please put the cups back in the kitchen cabinet.
examples.zh: 請把杯子放回廚房的櫃子裡。

examples.en: The medicine is in the bathroom cabinet.
examples.zh: 藥放在浴室的櫃子裡。

examples.en: The prime minister met with the cabinet this morning.
examples.zh: 首相今天早上和內閣會面。

examples.en: Three generations of my family live in this house.
examples.zh: 我們家有三代人住在這棟房子裡。

examples.en: Young people of this generation use smartphones every day.
examples.zh: 這一代的年輕人每天使用智慧型手機。

examples.en: The generation of electricity from wind is growing fast.
examples.zh: 利用風力發電的規模正快速成長。

examples.en: The price includes everything, including breakfast and the tour.
examples.zh: 這個價格什麼都含，包括早餐和導覽。

examples.en: Five students, including my best friend, joined the club.
examples.zh: 包括我最要好的朋友在內，有五名學生加入了社團。

examples.en: We visited many places in Japan, including Kyoto and Osaka.
examples.zh: 我們在日本去了許多地方，包括京都和大阪。

examples.en: Please do not abandon your pet when you move away.
examples.zh: 搬家時請不要遺棄你的寵物。

examples.en: The team had to abandon the game because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雨，球隊不得不放棄比賽。

examples.en: They abandoned the old plan and made a new one.
examples.zh: 他們放棄了舊計畫，擬定了新的計畫。

examples.en: I have absolute trust in my best friend.
examples.zh: 我對我最要好的朋友有絕對的信任。

examples.en: The test needs absolute silence, so please turn off your phones.
examples.zh: 考試需要絕對的安靜，所以請關掉手機。

examples.en: It was an absolute pleasure to meet you.
examples.zh: 能見到你真是無比榮幸。

examples.en: A sponge can absorb a lot of water.
examples.zh: 海綿可以吸收很多水。

examples.en: Plants absorb sunlight through their leaves to make their own food.
examples.zh: 植物透過葉片吸收陽光，製造自身所需的養分。

examples.en: The children were absorbed in the story and did not move.
examples.zh: 孩子們全神貫注在故事裡，動也不動。

examples.en: Love and freedom are abstract ideas that are hard to draw.
examples.zh: 愛與自由是很難畫出來的抽象概念。

examples.en: The museum has an abstract painting made of colorful lines.
examples.zh: 這間博物館有一幅由彩色線條構成的抽象畫。

examples.en: It is hard for young children to understand abstract words.
examples.zh: 年幼的孩子很難理解抽象的詞彙。

examples.en: Please write a short abstract of your report.
examples.zh: 請為你的報告寫一份簡短的摘要。

examples.en: The abstract at the top of the paper explains the main idea.
examples.zh: 論文開頭的摘要說明了主要想法。

examples.en: The artist's latest abstract was sold for a high price.
examples.zh: 那位藝術家最新的抽象作品賣出了高價。
